qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(y^2 - 25\)
qs.s: \(y^2 - 25\) is a difference of squares, \((y)^2 - (5)^2\), which factors completely as \((y - 5)(y + 5)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(m^2 - 64\)
qs.s: \(m^2 - 64\) is a difference of squares, \((m)^2 - (8)^2\), which factors completely as \((m - 8)(m + 8)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(a^2 - 49\)
qs.s: \(a^2 - 49\) is a difference of squares, \((a)^2 - (7)^2\), which factors completely as \((a - 7)(a + 7)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(p^2 - 100\)
qs.s: \(p^2 - 100\) is a difference of squares, \((p)^2 - (10)^2\), which factors completely as \((p - 10)(p + 10)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(x^2 - 9\)
qs.s: \(x^2 - 9\) is a difference of squares, \((x)^2 - (3)^2\), which factors completely as \((x - 3)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(3y^2 - 48\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3\) to get \(3(y^2 - 16)\), then factor the difference of squares to obtain \(3(y - 4)(y + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(x^4 - 81\)
qs.s: \(x^4 - 81\) factors as the difference of squares \((x^2 - 9)(x^2 + 9)\), and factoring \(x^2 - 9\) gives \((x^2 + 9)(x - 3)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(16z^4 - 1\)
qs.s: \(16z^4 - 1\) factors as the difference of squares \((4z^2 - 1)(4z^2 + 1)\), and factoring the first binomial again completely gives \((4z^2 + 1)(2z - 1)(2z + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(25a^2 - 49b^2\)
qs.s: \(25a^2 - 49b^2\) is a difference of squares, \((5a)^2 - (7b)^2\), which factors into \((5a - 7b)(5a + 7b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9x^2 - 16\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) with \(a = 3x\) and \(b = 4\) to get \((3x - 4)(3x + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16a^2 - 9\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) with \(a = 4a\) and \(b = 3\) to get \((4a - 3)(4a + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(36x^2 - 25\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) with \(a = 6x\) and \(b = 5\) to get \((6x - 5)(6x + 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25y^2 - 4\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) with \(a = 5y\) and \(b = 2\) to get \((5y - 2)(5y + 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49m^2 - 1\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) with \(a = 7m\) and \(b = 1\) to get \((7m - 1)(7m + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49x^4 - 16y^2\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula with \(a = 7x^2\) and \(b = 4y\), the expression factors directly into \((7x^2 - 4y)(7x^2 + 4y)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(p^2 - 81\)
qs.s: Since \(81 = 9^2\), applying the difference of squares formula gives \(p^2 - 81 = (p - 9)(p + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(x^2 - 49\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\), we write \(x^2 - 49\) as \(x^2 - 7^2 = (x - 7)(x + 7)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(t^2 - 100\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula with \(100 = 10^2\), we factor \(t^2 - 100\) as \((t - 10)(t + 10)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(w^2 - 9\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\), we factor \(w^2 - 9\) as \((w - 3)(w + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(5x^3 - 45x\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of \(5x\) to get \(5x(x^2 - 9)\). Then factor the difference of squares to obtain \(5x(x - 3)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(16x^4 - 1\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(16x^4 - 1\) as \((4x^2)^2 - 1^2\), which factors into \((4x^2 - 1)(4x^2 + 1)\). Factoring the difference of squares \(4x^2 - 1\) further gives \((4x^2 + 1)(2x - 1)(2x + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(25x^2 - 64y^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(25x^2 - 64y^2\) as \((5x)^2 - (8y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula gives \((5x - 8y)(5x + 8y)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(3a^2 - 48\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of \(3\) to get \(3(a^2 - 16)\). Then factor the difference of squares to obtain \(3(a - 4)(a + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9w^2 - 64\)
qs.s: Write the binomial as \((3w)^2 - 8^2\). Using the difference of squares formula yields \((3w - 8)(3w + 8)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(4x^2 - 49\)
qs.s: Recognize \(4x^2 - 49\) as a difference of squares, \((2x)^2 - 7^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) gives \((2x - 7)(2x + 7)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16m^2 - 25\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(16m^2 - 25\) as \((4m)^2 - 5^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares formula gives \((4m - 5)(4m + 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49k^2 - 1\)
qs.s: Recognize \(49k^2 - 1\) as \((7k)^2 - 1^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula produces \((7k - 1)(7k + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(36p^2 - 121\)
qs.s: Express \(36p^2 - 121\) as \((6p)^2 - 11^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares formula yields \((6p - 11)(6p + 11)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(y^4 - 81\)
qs.s: First factor \(y^4 - 81\) as a difference of squares to obtain \((y^2 + 9)(y^2 - 9)\). Since \(y^2 - 9\) is also a difference of squares, factor it further to get \((y^2 + 9)(y - 3)(y + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(48a^2 - 75b^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of 3 to obtain \(3(16a^2 - 25b^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares to get \(3(4a - 5b)(4a + 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(20x^3 - 45x\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(5x\) to get \(5x(4x^2 - 9)\). Then factor \(4x^2 - 9\) as a difference of squares to get \(5x(2x - 3)(2x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16m^4 - 81\)
qs.s: First factor \(16m^4 - 81\) as \((4m^2 + 9)(4m^2 - 9)\). Then factor the difference of squares \(4m^2 - 9\) to obtain \((4m^2 + 9)(2m - 3)(2m + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25 - 16x^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the binomial as \(5^2 - (4x)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula, \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\), gives \((5 - 4x)(5 + 4x)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16 - 25p^2\)
qs.s: Express the binomial as \(4^2 - (5p)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula gives \((4 - 5p)(4 + 5p)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9 - 49y^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the binomial as \(3^2 - (7y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula gives \((3 - 7y)(3 + 7y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(64 - 81w^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \(8^2 - (9w)^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares formula gives \((8 - 9w)(8 + 9w)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(1 - 36m^2\)
qs.s: Express the terms as squares: \(1^2 - (6m)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula yields \((1 - 6m)(1 + 6m)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16 - 81m^4\)
qs.s: Factor as a difference of squares to get \((4 - 9m^2)(4 + 9m^2)\). Then, factor the first binomial again as a difference of squares to obtain \((2 - 3m)(2 + 3m)(4 + 9m^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(48 - 75x^2\)
qs.s: First, factor out the greatest common factor of \(3\) to get \(3(16 - 25x^2)\). Then, factor the difference of squares to obtain \(3(4 - 5x)(4 + 5x)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2 - 32z^4\)
qs.s: First, factor out the greatest common factor of \(2\) to get \(2(1 - 16z^4)\). Then, apply the difference of squares formula twice to completely factor the expression into \(2(1 - 2z)(1 + 2z)(1 + 4z^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25a^4 - 144b^2\)
qs.s: Recognize the binomial as a difference of squares, \((5a^2)^2 - (12b)^2\). Applying the formula \(u^2 - v^2 = (u - v)(u + v)\) gives \((5a^2 - 12b)(5a^2 + 12b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(45n - 20n^3\)
qs.s: First, factor out the common monomial factor \(5n\) to get \(5n(9 - 4n^2)\). Then, apply the difference of squares formula to factor \(9 - 4n^2\), giving \(5n(3 - 2n)(3 + 2n)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(25 - 4m^4\)
qs.s: Express \(25 - 4m^4\) as \((5)^2 - (2m^2)^2\). Using the difference of squares identity yields \((5 - 2m^2)(5 + 2m^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(49 - 36x^4\)
qs.s: Express \(49 - 36x^4\) as \((7)^2 - (6x^2)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) gives \((7 - 6x^2)(7 + 6x^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(9 - 64y^4\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(9 - 64y^4\) as \((3)^2 - (8y^2)^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares gives \((3 - 8y^2)(3 + 8y^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(1 - 100w^4\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(1 - 100w^4\) as \((1)^2 - (10w^2)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula gives \((1 - 10w^2)(1 + 10w^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(81 - 49p^4\)
qs.s: Express \(81 - 49p^4\) as \((9)^2 - (7p^2)^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares gives \((9 - 7p^2)(9 + 7p^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(625x^4 - 16y^4\)
qs.s: Factoring the difference of squares yields \((25x^2 - 4y^2)(25x^2 + 4y^2)\), and factoring \(25x^2 - 4y^2\) completely gives \((5x - 2y)(5x + 2y)(25x^2 + 4y^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(81 - 16z^4\)
qs.s: First factor as a difference of squares: \(81 - 16z^4 = (9 - 4z^2)(9 + 4z^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares \(9 - 4z^2\) further to obtain \((3 - 2z)(3 + 2z)(9 + 4z^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(1 - c^8\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares successively: \(1 - c^8 = (1 - c^4)(1 + c^4) = (1 - c^2)(1 + c^2)(1 + c^4) = (1 - c)(1 + c)(1 + c^2)(1 + c^4)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(48 - 243w^4\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3\) to get \(3(16 - 81w^4)\). Then factor \(16 - 81w^4\) into \((4 - 9w^2)(4 + 9w^2)\), and factor \(4 - 9w^2\) further into \((2 - 3w)(2 + 3w)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(2a^5 - 32a\)
qs.s: Factor out the common monomial factor \(2a\) to obtain \(2a(a^4 - 16)\), then apply the difference of squares twice to get \(2a(a - 2)(a + 2)(a^2 + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(64p^2 - 25q^2\)
qs.s: Express \(64p^2 - 25q^2\) as \((8p)^2 - (5q)^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares formula yields \((8p + 5q)(8p - 5q)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25x^2 - 4y^2\)
qs.s: Write \(25x^2 - 4y^2\) as \((5x)^2 - (2y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\) gives \((5x + 2y)(5x - 2y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(4m^2 - 81n^2\)
qs.s: Recognize \(4m^2 - 81n^2\) as \((2m)^2 - (9n)^2\). Using \(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\), this factors into \((2m + 9n)(2m - 9n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49a^2 - 36b^2\)
qs.s: Express \(49a^2 - 36b^2\) as \((7a)^2 - (6b)^2\). Using the difference of squares formula, it factors as \((7a + 6b)(7a - 6b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(100u^2 - 49v^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(100u^2 - 49v^2\) as \((10u)^2 - (7v)^2\). By the difference of squares formula, it factors into \((10u + 7v)(10u - 7v)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^5 - 48xy^4\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(3x\) to obtain \(3x(x^4 - 16y^4)\). Applying the difference of squares formula twice yields \(3x(x^2 + 4y^2)(x + 2y)(x - 2y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(50a^5b - 72ab^3\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(2ab\) to get \(2ab(25a^4 - 36b^2)\). Then recognize \(25a^4 - 36b^2\) as \((5a^2)^2 - (6b)^2\) and factor to get \(2ab(5a^2 + 6b)(5a^2 - 6b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49x^2y^2 - 144z^2\)
qs.s: Recognize the binomial as a difference of squares \((7xy)^2 - (12z)^2\). Applying \(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\) gives \((7xy + 12z)(7xy - 12z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(81m^4 - 16n^4\)
qs.s: Factor as a difference of squares to get \((9m^2 + 4n^2)(9m^2 - 4n^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares \(9m^2 - 4n^2\) further to obtain \((9m^2 + 4n^2)(3m + 2n)(3m - 2n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(20x^2 - 125y^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of \(5\) to get \(5(4x^2 - 25y^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares to obtain \(5(2x + 5y)(2x - 5y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(100u^4 - 9v^6\)
qs.s: Express the terms as squares: \((10u^2)^2 - (3v^3)^2\). Factoring using the difference of squares formula yields \((10u^2 - 3v^3)(10u^2 + 3v^3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49a^6 - 16b^4\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(49a^6 - 16b^4\) as \((7a^3)^2 - (4b^2)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula, \(A^2 - B^2 = (A - B)(A + B)\), yields \((7a^3 - 4b^2)(7a^3 + 4b^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(36x^2 - 121y^4\)
qs.s: Rewrite the binomial as \((6x)^2 - (11y^2)^2\). Using the difference of squares formula gives \((6x - 11y^2)(6x + 11y^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9m^8 - 64n^2\)
qs.s: Write the expression as \((3m^4)^2 - (8n)^2\). Using the difference of squares identity, it factors as \((3m^4 - 8n)(3m^4 + 8n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(64c^4 - 25d^6\)
qs.s: Write \(64c^4 - 25d^6\) as \((8c^2)^2 - (5d^3)^2\). Applying the difference of squares identity results in \((8c^2 - 5d^3)(8c^2 + 5d^3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(12a^2b^6 - 27\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor of \(3\) to obtain \(3(4a^2b^6 - 9)\). Factoring the difference of squares gives \(3(2ab^3 - 3)(2ab^3 + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(50u^4v^2 - 72\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor of \(2\) to get \(2(25u^4v^2 - 36)\). Then factor the resulting difference of squares as \(2(5u^2v - 6)(5u^2v + 6)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(45x^8y^2 - 5\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(5\) to obtain \(5(9x^8y^2 - 1)\). Then factor the difference of squares to get \(5(3x^4y - 1)(3x^4y + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(20x^2y^4 - 45\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(5\) to get \(5(4x^2y^4 - 9)\). Then apply the difference of squares formula to obtain \(5(2xy^2 - 3)(2xy^2 + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(18m^2n^4 - 2\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor of \(2\) to get \(2(9m^2n^4 - 1)\). Then apply the difference of squares formula to obtain \(2(3mn^2 - 1)(3mn^2 + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(5m^4n^4 - 405\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(5\) to get \(5(m^4n^4 - 81)\). Factoring the difference of squares twice gives \(5(m^2n^2 + 9)(m^2n^2 - 9) = 5(m^2n^2 + 9)(mn - 3)(mn + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(64x^6 - 4x^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(4x^2\) to get \(4x^2(16x^4 - 1)\). Apply the difference of squares formula repeatedly to get \(4x^2(4x^2 + 1)(4x^2 - 1) = 4x^2(4x^2 + 1)(2x - 1)(2x + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2x^4y - 512y\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(2y\) to get \(2y(x^4 - 256)\). Factoring the difference of squares twice yields \(2y(x^2 + 16)(x^2 - 16) = 2y(x^2 + 16)(x - 4)(x + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^5y - 48xy^5\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3xy\) to get \(3xy(x^4 - 16y^4)\). Factoring the difference of squares twice gives \(3xy(x^2 + 4y^2)(x^2 - 4y^2) = 3xy(x^2 + 4y^2)(x - 2y)(x + 2y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(32x^2 - 2y^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(2\) to get \(2(16x^2 - y^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares to get \(2(4x - y)(4x + y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(48p^2 - 75q^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(3\) to get \(3(16p^2 - 25q^2)\). Then factor using the difference of squares formula to obtain \(3(4p - 5q)(4p + 5q)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(18a^2 - 50b^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(2\) to obtain \(2(9a^2 - 25b^2)\). Then apply the difference of squares formula to get \(2(3a - 5b)(3a + 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(12m^2 - 27n^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(3\) to get \(3(4m^2 - 9n^2)\). Factoring the difference of squares yields \(3(2m - 3n)(2m + 3n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(45x^2 - 5y^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(5\) to get \(5(9x^2 - y^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares to obtain \(5(3x - y)(3x + y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2x^4 - 32y^4\)
qs.s: Factor out \(2\) to get \(2(x^4 - 16y^4) = 2(x^2 - 4y^2)(x^2 + 4y^2)\). Then factor the difference of squares \(x^2 - 4y^2\) again to obtain \(2(x - 2y)(x + 2y)(x^2 + 4y^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(5x^5 - 80xy^4\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(5x\) to get \(5x(x^4 - 16y^4) = 5x(x^2 - 4y^2)(x^2 + 4y^2)\). Factoring \(x^2 - 4y^2\) completely yields \(5x(x - 2y)(x + 2y)(x^2 + 4y^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(162a^5 - 2ab^4\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(2a\) to get \(2a(81a^4 - b^4) = 2a(9a^2 - b^2)(9a^2 + b^2)\). Then factor \(9a^2 - b^2\) as a difference of squares to get \(2a(3a - b)(3a + b)(9a^2 + b^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(12a^3b - 75ab^3\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common monomial factor \(3ab\) to get \(3ab(4a^2 - 25b^2)\). Factoring the difference of squares gives \(3ab(2a - 5b)(2a + 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-32a^3 + 50ab^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the negative common factor \(-2a\) to obtain \(-2a(16a^2 - 25b^2)\). Factoring the resulting difference of squares gives \(-2a(4a - 5b)(4a + 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(b^4 - 81\)
qs.s: Factor \(b^4 - 81\) as \((b^2 - 9)(b^2 + 9)\), then factor the difference of squares \(b^2 - 9\) as \((b - 3)(b + 3)\) to get \((b - 3)(b + 3)(b^2 + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(c^4 - 256\)
Factor the binomial completely: \(u^4 - v^4\)
qs.s: Factor \(u^4 - v^4\) as \((u^2 - v^2)(u^2 + v^2)\), then factor the difference of squares \(u^2 - v^2\) as \((u - v)(u + v)\) to obtain \((u - v)(u + v)(u^2 + v^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(y^4 - 16\)
qs.s: Factor \(y^4 - 16\) as the difference of squares \((y^2 - 4)(y^2 + 4)\), then factor \(y^2 - 4\) as \((y - 2)(y + 2)\) to obtain \((y - 2)(y + 2)(y^2 + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(d^4 - 625\)
Factor the binomial completely: \(16x^4 - 81\)
qs.s: Factor \(16x^4 - 81\) as \((4x^2 - 9)(4x^2 + 9)\), then factor the difference of squares \(4x^2 - 9\) as \((2x - 3)(2x + 3)\) to get \((2x - 3)(2x + 3)(4x^2 + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(5x^4 - 80\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(5\) to get \(5(x^4 - 16)\), then factor \(x^4 - 16\) as \((x^2 - 4)(x^2 + 4) = (x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4)\) to obtain \(5(x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(81a^4 - 16b^4\)
qs.s: Factor \(81a^4 - 16b^4\) as \((9a^2 - 4b^2)(9a^2 + 4b^2)\), then factor the difference of squares \(9a^2 - 4b^2\) into \((3a - 2b)(3a + 2b)\) to get \((3a - 2b)(3a + 2b)(9a^2 + 4b^2)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(2x^5 - 32x\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(2x\) to obtain \(2x(x^4 - 16)\), then factor \(x^4 - 16\) as \((x^2 - 4)(x^2 + 4) = (x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4)\) to yield \(2x(x - 2)(x + 2)(x^2 + 4)\).

qs.q: Factor the binomial completely: \(x^8 - 1\)
qs.s: Repeatedly factor using the difference of squares formula: \(x^8 - 1 = (x^4 - 1)(x^4 + 1) = (x^2 - 1)(x^2 + 1)(x^4 + 1) = (x - 1)(x + 1)(x^2 + 1)(x^4 + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^2 + 4\)
qs.s: The expression \(x^2 + 4\) is a sum of squares, not a difference of squares. Since a sum of squares cannot be factored over the real numbers, it cannot be factored.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(m^2 + 36\)
qs.s: The expression \(m^2 + 36\) is a sum of squares. It has no common factors and cannot be factored further over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(y^2 + 9\)
qs.s: The binomial \(y^2 + 9\) is a sum of squares. Because the difference of squares formula does not apply to a sum of squares, it cannot be factored over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(b^2 + 25\)
qs.s: Since \(b^2 + 25\) is the sum of two squares with no common factors, it cannot be factored over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(a^2 + 16\)
qs.s: The expression \(a^2 + 16\) is a sum of squares rather than a difference of squares. Therefore, it cannot be factored into linear binomials over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^2 + 48\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of 3 to obtain \(3(x^2 + 16)\). Because \(x^2 + 16\) is a sum of squares, it cannot be factored further over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(4x^2 + 25y^2\)
qs.s: The expression \(4x^2 + 25y^2\) is a sum of squares with no common factors. Because the difference of squares identity only applies to subtractions, this binomial cannot be factored over the real numbers.

qs.q: Factor completely: \((c + 9)^2 - d^2\)
qs.s: Applying the difference of squares formula with \(A = c + 9\) and \(B = d\) yields \((c + 9 + d)(c + 9 - d)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 4)^2 - y^2\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) with \(A = x + 4\) and \(B = y\), we obtain \((x + 4 + y)(x + 4 - y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((p - 5)^2 - q^2\)
qs.s: Using \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) with \(A = p - 5\) and \(B = q\), the factored form is \((p - 5 + q)(p - 5 - q)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m + 7)^2 - n^2\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) with \(A = m + 7\) and \(B = n\), we get \((m + 7 + n)(m + 7 - n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a - 3)^2 - b^2\)
qs.s: Applying the difference of squares identity \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) with \(A = a - 3\) and \(B = b\) gives \((a - 3 + b)(a - 3 - b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3(x + 1)^2 - 12y^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3\) to get \(3[(x + 1)^2 - 4y^2]\), then apply the difference of squares formula to obtain \(3(x + 1 + 2y)(x + 1 - 2y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^2 - (y - 6)^2\)
Factor completely: \((2x + 5)^2 - 9y^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula with \(A = 2x + 5\) and \(B = 3y\) to obtain \((2x + 5 + 3y)(2x + 5 - 3y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 4)^2 - (y - 3)^2\)
Factor completely: \((3x + 1)^2 - (2y - 5)^2\)
Factor completely: \(25 - (x + 5)^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([5 - (x + 5)][5 + (x + 5)]\). Simplifying each factor gives \((5 - x - 5)(5 + x + 5) = -x(x + 10)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 4)^2 - 16\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([(x + 4) - 4][(x + 4) + 4]\). Simplifying gives \((x)(x + 8) = x(x + 8)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 5)^2 - 16\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([(x + 5) - 4][(x + 5) + 4]\). Combining constants gives \((x + 1)(x + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9 - (x + 3)^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([3 - (x + 3)][3 + (x + 3)]\). Simplifying each factor gives \((3 - x - 3)(3 + x + 3) = -x(x + 6)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x - 2)^2 - 9\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([(x - 2) - 3][(x - 2) + 3]\). Combining constants gives \((x - 5)(x + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((3x + 2)^2 - (2x - 1)^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([(3x + 2) - (2x - 1)][(3x + 2) + (2x - 1)]\). Simplifying each factor yields \((3x + 2 - 2x + 1)(3x + 2 + 2x - 1) = (x + 3)(5x + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(4(x - 2)^2 - 9\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \([2(x - 2)]^2 - 3^2\) and factor as \([2(x - 2) - 3][2(x - 2) + 3]\). Expanding inside the brackets gives \((2x - 4 - 3)(2x - 4 + 3) = (2x - 7)(2x - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3(x + 4)^2 - 75\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor 3 to get \(3[(x + 4)^2 - 25]\). Then apply the difference of squares: \(3[(x + 4) - 5][(x + 4) + 5] = 3(x - 1)(x + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(64 - (3x + 8)^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([8 - (3x + 8)][8 + (3x + 8)]\). Simplifying yields \((8 - 3x - 8)(8 + 3x + 8) = -3x(3x + 16)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2x + 1)^2 - (x - 3)^2\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares formula: \([(2x + 1) - (x - 3)][(2x + 1) + (x - 3)]\). Distribute the negative sign and combine like terms to get \((2x + 1 - x + 3)(2x + 1 + x - 3) = (x + 4)(3x - 2)\).

exercises.name: Factor expressions with common binomial factors or compound terms

qs.q: Factor completely: \((y - 5)^2 + 11(y - 5) + 24\)
qs.s: Let \(u = y - 5\), transforming the expression to \(u^2 + 11u + 24 = (u + 3)(u + 8)\). Replacing \(u\) with \(y - 5\) yields \((y - 5 + 3)(y - 5 + 8) = (y - 2)(y + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3)^2 - 2(x + 3) - 35\)
qs.s: Treat \((x + 3)\) as a single variable \(u\) to get \(u^2 - 2u - 35 = (u - 7)(u + 5)\). Substitute \(x + 3\) back for \(u\) to obtain \((x + 3 - 7)(x + 3 + 5) = (x - 4)(x + 8)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-2(5x + 1)y^2 - 6(5x + 1)y + 80(5x + 1)\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(-2(5x + 1)\) to get \(-2(5x + 1)(y^2 + 3y - 40)\). Factoring \(y^2 + 3y - 40\) gives \(-2(5x + 1)(y + 8)(y - 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(k^3(r + s) - 9k^2(r + s) + 20k(r + s)\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(k(r + s)\) to obtain \(k(r + s)(k^2 - 9k + 20)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(k(r + s)(k - 4)(k - 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(y^3(m + n) - 7y^2(m + n) + 12y(m + n)\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(y(m + n)\) to get \(y(m + n)(y^2 - 7y + 12)\). Then factor the quadratic trinomial to obtain \(y(m + n)(y - 3)(y - 4)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(p^3(u + v) - 5p^2(u + v) - 14p(u + v)\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(p(u + v)\) to obtain \(p(u + v)(p^2 - 5p - 14)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial yields \(p(u + v)(p - 7)(p + 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(a^3(x - y) + 2a^2(x - y) - 15a(x - y)\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(a(x - y)\) to obtain \(a(x - y)(a^2 + 2a - 15)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(a(x - y)(a + 5)(a - 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^3(c - d) + 8x^2(c - d) + 12x(c - d)\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(x(c - d)\) to get \(x(c - d)(x^2 + 8x + 12)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial yields \(x(c - d)(x + 2)(x + 6)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-2x^3(3m + n) - 10x^2(3m + n) + 48x(3m + n)\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(-2x(3m + n)\) to obtain \(-2x(3m + n)(x^2 + 5x - 24)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(-2x(3m + n)(x + 8)(x - 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 5)^2 - 3(x + 5) - 28\)
qs.s: Treat \((x + 5)\) as a single variable \(u\) to get \(u^2 - 3u - 28 = (u - 7)(u + 4)\). Substituting \(x + 5\) back for \(u\) yields \((x + 5 - 7)(x + 5 + 4) = (x - 2)(x + 9)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^4(a + 2b) - 15x^3(a + 2b) - 72x^2(a + 2b)\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(3x^2(a + 2b)\) to get \(3x^2(a + 2b)(x^2 - 5x - 24)\). Then factor the quadratic trinomial into \((x - 8)(x + 3)\), giving \(3x^2(a + 2b)(x - 8)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2a - b)^2 + 4c(2a - b) - 21c^2\)
qs.s: Treat \(2a - b\) as a variable \(u\). Then \(u^2 + 4cu - 21c^2\) factors into \((u + 7c)(u - 3c)\), which gives \((2a - b + 7c)(2a - b - 3c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3y)^2 - 9a(x + 3y) + 20a^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x + 3y\). The expression becomes \(u^2 - 9au + 20a^2 = (u - 4a)(u - 5a)\), and substituting back gives \((x + 3y - 4a)(x + 3y - 5a)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m + 4n)^2 - 11k(m + 4n) + 18k^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = m + 4n\). Factoring \(u^2 - 11ku + 18k^2\) gives \((u - 2k)(u - 9k)\), which becomes \((m + 4n - 2k)(m + 4n - 9k)\) upon substitution.

qs.q: Factor completely: \((3p - q)^2 - 5w(3p - q) - 14w^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = 3p - q\). The quadratic \(u^2 - 5wu - 14w^2\) factors into \((u - 7w)(u + 2w)\), yielding \((3p - q - 7w)(3p - q + 2w)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((r - 5s)^2 + 10t(r - 5s) + 24t^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = r - 5s\). The expression \(u^2 + 10tu + 24t^2\) factors into \((u + 4t)(u + 6t)\), which gives \((r - 5s + 4t)(r - 5s + 6t)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3(x - 2y)^2 - 21a(x - 2y) + 36a^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3\) to get \(3[(x - 2y)^2 - 7a(x - 2y) + 12a^2]\). Then factor the trinomial using \(u = x - 2y\) to obtain \(3(x - 2y - 3a)(x - 2y - 4a)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2x - 3y)^2 - 19a(2x - 3y) + 48a^2\)
qs.s: Treat \(2x - 3y\) as \(u\). The factors of \(48a^2\) that add to \(-19a\) are \(-3a\) and \(-16a\), which gives \((2x - 3y - 3a)(2x - 3y - 16a)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x - 4)^2 - 5(x - 4) - 24\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x - 4\). Factoring \(u^2 - 5u - 24\) gives \((u - 8)(u + 3)\), and substituting \(x - 4\) back for \(u\) simplifies to \((x - 4 - 8)(x - 4 + 3) = (x - 12)(x - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-(2x + y)^2 + 3a(2x + y) + 28a^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(-1\) to get \(-[(2x + y)^2 - 3a(2x + y) - 28a^2]\). Treating \(2x + y\) as a single variable yields \(-(2x + y - 7a)(2x + y + 4a)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2k(a + 3b)^2 - 16ck(a + 3b) - 40c^2k\)
qs.s: Factor out the common monomial \(2k\) to obtain \(2k[(a + 3b)^2 - 8c(a + 3b) - 20c^2]\), then factor the compound quadratic to get \(2k(a + 3b - 10c)(a + 3b + 2c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2a + b)^2 + (6ac + 3bc) - 10c^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(3c\) from the middle terms to get \((2a + b)^2 + 3c(2a + b) - 10c^2\). Letting \(u = 2a + b\), factor the trinomial \(u^2 + 3cu - 10c^2 = (u + 5c)(u - 2c)\) and substitute back to obtain \((2a + b + 5c)(2a + b - 2c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a - 2b)^2 + (3ac - 6bc) - 18c^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(3c\) from \((3ac - 6bc)\) to obtain \((a - 2b)^2 + 3c(a - 2b) - 18c^2\). Letting \(u = a - 2b\), factor \(u^2 + 3cu - 18c^2 = (u + 6c)(u - 3c)\) and substitute back to get \((a - 2b + 6c)(a - 2b - 3c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((4x + 3y)^2 + (4xz + 3yz) - 20z^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(z\) from \((4xz + 3yz)\) to get \((4x + 3y)^2 + z(4x + 3y) - 20z^2\). Factor the trinomial with \((4x + 3y)\) as the base term to obtain \((4x + 3y + 5z)(4x + 3y - 4z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2x - 5y)^2 - (6xz - 15yz) - 10z^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(-3z\) from the middle terms to write the expression as \((2x - 5y)^2 - 3z(2x - 5y) - 10z^2\). Factoring the trinomial gives \(((2x - 5y) - 5z)((2x - 5y) + 2z) = (2x - 5y - 5z)(2x - 5y + 2z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3y)^2 + (4xz + 12yz) - 21z^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the middle terms as \(4z(x + 3y)\) so the expression becomes \((x + 3y)^2 + 4z(x + 3y) - 21z^2\). Treating \((x + 3y)\) as a single variable, factor the quadratic to get \((x + 3y + 7z)(x + 3y - 3z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((5a - 3b)^2 + (50ac - 30bc) - 144c^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \((5a - 3b)^2 + 10c(5a - 3b) - 144c^2\). Factoring the trinomial using factors of \(-144\) that sum to \(10\) yields \(((5a - 3b) + 18c)((5a - 3b) - 8c) = (5a - 3b + 18c)(5a - 3b - 8c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((2x - 3y)^2 - (40xz - 60yz) + 96z^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(-20z\) from the middle terms to obtain \((2x - 3y)^2 - 20z(2x - 3y) + 96z^2\). Find factors of \(96\) that add to \(-20\), which are \(-12\) and \(-8\), giving \((2x - 3y - 12z)(2x - 3y - 8z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((r + 1)^2 - 2s(r + 1) + s^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = r + 1\). The expression becomes \(u^2 - 2su + s^2 = (u - s)^2\). Substituting back gives \((r - s + 1)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a - 5)^2 - 2b(a - 5) + b^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = a - 5\). The expression becomes \(u^2 - 2bu + b^2 = (u - b)^2\). Substituting back gives \((a - b - 5)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3)^2 + 2y(x + 3) + y^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x + 3\). The expression becomes \(u^2 + 2yu + y^2 = (u + y)^2\). Substituting back gives \((x + y + 3)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((p - 2)^2 + 2q(p - 2) + q^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = p - 2\). The expression becomes \(u^2 + 2qu + q^2 = (u + q)^2\). Substituting back gives \((p + q - 2)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m + 6)^2 - 2n(m + 6) + n^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = m + 6\). The expression becomes \(u^2 - 2nu + n^2 = (u - n)^2\). Substituting back gives \((m - n + 6)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((u - 4)^2 + 6v(u - 4) + 9v^2\)
qs.s: Let \(k = u - 4\). The expression becomes \(k^2 + 6vk + 9v^2 = (k + 3v)^2\). Substituting \(k = u - 4\) yields \((u + 3v - 4)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a + 5)^2 + 2(a + 5)(b - 2) + (b - 2)^2\)
qs.s: This matches the form \(u^2 + 2uv + v^2 = (u + v)^2\) with \(u = a + 5\) and \(v = b - 2\). Adding the binomials and combining like terms yields \(((a + 5) + (b - 2))^2 = (a + b + 3)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((c + 2)^2 + 7d(c + 2) + 12d^2\)
qs.s: Let \(k = c + 2\). Factoring the trinomial gives \(k^2 + 7dk + 12d^2 = (k + 3d)(k + 4d)\). Replacing \(k\) with \(c + 2\) results in \((c + 3d + 2)(c + 4d + 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((w - 1)^2 - 2z(w - 1) - 8z^2\)
qs.s: Let \(k = w - 1\). The trinomial factors as \(k^2 - 2zk - 8z^2 = (k - 4z)(k + 2z)\). Substituting \(k = w - 1\) gives \((w - 4z - 1)(w + 2z - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3(x - 2)^2 - 6y(x - 2) + 3y^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor 3 to get \(3[(x - 2)^2 - 2y(x - 2) + y^2]\). Factoring the perfect square trinomial inside the brackets gives \(3(x - y - 2)^2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((p - 1)^2 + 4q(p - 1) + 3q^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = p - 1\). The trinomial \(u^2 + 4qu + 3q^2\) factors into \((u + 3q)(u + q)\), which gives \((p + 3q - 1)(p + q - 1)\) after back-substitution.

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3)^2 + 2y(x + 3) - 3y^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x + 3\). The expression becomes \(u^2 + 2yu - 3y^2 = (u + 3y)(u - y)\), which gives \((x + 3y + 3)(x - y + 3)\) after substituting back.

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x - 4)^2 - 5y(x - 4) + 6y^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x - 4\). Factoring \(u^2 - 5yu + 6y^2\) yields \((u - 2y)(u - 3y)\), which becomes \((x - 2y - 4)(x - 3y - 4)\) when substituting \(x - 4\) back for \(u\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m + 5)^2 - 2n(m + 5) - 8n^2\)
qs.s: Treat \(m + 5\) as a single variable \(u\) to get \(u^2 - 2nu - 8n^2 = (u - 4n)(u + 2n)\). Substituting \(m + 5\) back for \(u\) results in \((m - 4n + 5)(m + 2n + 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a - 2)^2 - 3b(a - 2) - 4b^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = a - 2\). The expression becomes \(u^2 - 3bu - 4b^2 = (u - 4b)(u + b)\), which simplifies to \((a - 4b - 2)(a + b - 2)\) upon replacing \(u\) with \(a - 2\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + 3y)^2 - 7z(x + 3y) - 18z^2\)
qs.s: Treat the binomial \(x + 3y\) as \(u\). The expression factors as \(u^2 - 7zu - 18z^2 = (u - 9z)(u + 2z)\), which gives \((x + 3y - 9z)(x + 3y + 2z)\) upon replacing \(u\) with \(x + 3y\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x - 1)^2 + 4(y + 2)(x - 1) - 12(y + 2)^2\)
qs.s: Let \(u = x - 1\) and \(v = y + 2\) to factor \(u^2 + 4uv - 12v^2\) as \((u + 6v)(u - 2v)\). Substituting back and expanding gives \([(x - 1) + 6(y + 2)][(x - 1) - 2(y + 2)] = (x + 6y + 11)(x - 2y - 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3(x - 2)^2 + 15y(x - 2) - 42y^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(3\) to get \(3[(x - 2)^2 + 5y(x - 2) - 14y^2]\). Letting \(u = x - 2\), the bracketed expression factors as \((u + 7y)(u - 2y)\), giving \(3(x + 7y - 2)(x - 2y - 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(5z(x - 3)^2 - 10yz(x - 3) - 75y^2z\)
qs.s: Factor out the common monomial \(5z\) to obtain \(5z[(x - 3)^2 - 2y(x - 3) - 15y^2]\). Factoring the quadratic in \((x - 3)\) gives \(5z(x - 3 - 5y)(x - 3 + 3y)\), or \(5z(x - 5y - 3)(x + 3y - 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-2(a + 4)^2 - 6b(a + 4) + 56b^2\)
qs.s: Factor out \(-2\) to get \(-2[(a + 4)^2 + 3b(a + 4) - 28b^2]\). Treating \(a + 4\) as a variable gives \(-2(a + 4 + 7b)(a + 4 - 4b)\), which simplifies to \(-2(a + 7b + 4)(a - 4b + 4)\).

exercises.name: Factor difference of squares of grouped trinomials

qs.q: Factor completely: \((y^2 - 12y + 36) - 16z^2\)
qs.s: Rewrite the trinomial as \((y - 6)^2\) to obtain \((y - 6)^2 - (4z)^2\). Applying the difference of squares gives \((y - 6 + 4z)(y - 6 - 4z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((p^2 + 14p + 49) - 36q^2\)
qs.s: Factor the perfect square trinomial as \((p + 7)^2\), giving \((p + 7)^2 - (6q)^2\). By the difference of squares, this factors into \((p + 7 + 6q)(p + 7 - 6q)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 + 10x + 25) - 9y^2\)
qs.s: Factor the perfect square trinomial as \((x + 5)^2\), giving \((x + 5)^2 - (3y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares yields \((x + 5 + 3y)(x + 5 - 3y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m^2 + 4m + 4) - n^2\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomial as \((m + 2)^2\) to obtain \((m + 2)^2 - n^2\). Using the difference of squares gives \((m + 2 + n)(m + 2 - n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a^2 - 8a + 16) - 25b^2\)
qs.s: Recognize that \(a^2 - 8a + 16 = (a - 4)^2\), which gives \((a - 4)^2 - (5b)^2\). Factoring as a difference of squares produces \((a - 4 + 5b)(a - 4 - 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 - 16xy + 64y^2) - 81z^2\)
qs.s: Recognize that \(x^2 - 16xy + 64y^2 = (x - 8y)^2\). Then apply the difference of squares to \((x - 8y)^2 - (9z)^2\) to obtain \((x - 8y + 9z)(x - 8y - 9z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49z^2 - (x^2 + 10x + 25)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \((7z)^2 - (x + 5)^2\). Applying the difference of squares gives \([7z + (x + 5)][7z - (x + 5)]\), which simplifies to \((7z + x + 5)(7z - x - 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2(x^2 - 12x + 36) - 50y^2\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor of 2 to get \(2[(x^2 - 12x + 36) - 25y^2]\). Recognizing the perfect square trinomial gives \(2[(x - 6)^2 - (5y)^2]\), which factors into \(2(x - 6 + 5y)(x - 6 - 5y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a^2 - 14a + 49) - (b^2 + 4b + 4)\)
qs.s: Write the expression as \((a - 7)^2 - (b + 2)^2\). Using the difference of squares gives \([(a - 7) + (b + 2)][(a - 7) - (b + 2)]\), which simplifies to \((a + b - 5)(a - b - 9)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 + 8x + 16) - (y^2 - 6y + 9)\)
qs.s: Write each trinomial as a square to get \((x + 4)^2 - (y - 3)^2\). Applying the difference of squares gives \([(x + 4) + (y - 3)][(x + 4) - (y - 3)]\), which simplifies to \((x + y + 1)(x - y + 7)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((m^2 + 10mn + 25n^2) - 36p^2\)
qs.s: Recognize the trinomial as \((m + 5n)^2\) and apply the difference of squares formula to obtain \((m + 5n - 6p)(m + 5n + 6p)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 - 8xy + 16y^2) - 25z^2\)
qs.s: The trinomial factors as \((x - 4y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) yields \((x - 4y - 5z)(x - 4y + 5z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((16u^2 - 24uv + 9v^2) - 49w^2\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomial as \((4u - 3v)^2\), then apply the difference of squares to get \((4u - 3v - 7w)(4u - 3v + 7w)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((25a^2 + 20ab + 4b^2) - 9c^2\)
qs.s: The expression inside the parentheses is the perfect square \((5a + 2b)^2\). Factoring the difference of squares gives \(((5a + 2b) - 3c)((5a + 2b) + 3c) = (5a + 2b - 3c)(5a + 2b + 3c)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((9x^2 + 6xy + y^2) - 16z^2\)
qs.s: Recognize that \(9x^2 + 6xy + y^2 = (3x + y)^2\) is a perfect square trinomial. Applying the difference of squares gives \((3x + y)^2 - (4z)^2 = (3x + y - 4z)(3x + y + 4z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2(x^2 - 14xy + 49y^2) - 72z^2\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor of 2 to get \(2[(x^2 - 14xy + 49y^2) - 36z^2]\). Then factor the perfect square trinomial and apply the difference of squares to obtain \(2(x - 7y - 6z)(x - 7y + 6z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((49x^2 - 84xy + 36y^2) - 144z^2\)
qs.s: Recognize the trinomial as \((7x - 6y)^2\) and the last term as \((12z)^2\). Factoring as a difference of squares yields \((7x - 6y - 12z)(7x - 6y + 12z)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((16x^2 + 40xy + 25y^2) - (9a^2 - 12ab + 4b^2)\)
qs.s: Write each grouped trinomial as a perfect square: \((4x + 5y)^2 - (3a - 2b)^2\). Applying the difference of squares and distributing the negative sign yields \((4x + 5y - 3a + 2b)(4x + 5y + 3a - 2b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((25x^2 - 60xy + 36y^2) - (64a^2 - 80ab + 25b^2)\)
qs.s: Both groups are perfect square trinomials, giving \((5x - 6y)^2 - (8a - 5b)^2\). Applying the difference of squares and distributing the negative sign gives \((5x - 6y - 8a + 5b)(5x - 6y + 8a - 5b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(100w^2 - (9x^2 + 24xy + 16y^2)\)
qs.s: Recognize the trinomial as \((3x + 4y)^2\), giving the difference of squares \((10w)^2 - (3x + 4y)^2\). Distributing the negative sign in the first factor gives \((10w - 3x - 4y)(10w + 3x + 4y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(256m^8 - 1\)
qs.s: Factoring iteratively as a difference of squares yields \((16m^4 + 1)(16m^4 - 1) = (16m^4 + 1)(4m^2 + 1)(4m^2 - 1) = (16m^4 + 1)(4m^2 + 1)(2m + 1)(2m - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^8 - 256\)
Factor completely: \(u^8v^8 - 1\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \((uv)^8 - 1\) and apply difference of squares three times to obtain \((u^4v^4 + 1)(u^2v^2 + 1)(uv + 1)(uv - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(a^8 - b^8\)
qs.s: Apply the difference of squares repeatedly: \(a^8 - b^8 = (a^4 + b^4)(a^4 - b^4) = (a^4 + b^4)(a^2 + b^2)(a^2 - b^2) = (a^4 + b^4)(a^2 + b^2)(a + b)(a - b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(1 - y^8\)
qs.s: Factoring the difference of squares three times gives \(1 - y^8 = (1 + y^4)(1 - y^4) = (1 + y^4)(1 + y^2)(1 - y^2) = (1 + y^4)(1 + y^2)(1 + y)(1 - y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(5x^9 - 5x\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(5x\) to get \(5x(x^8 - 1)\), then factor \(x^8 - 1\) repeatedly into \(5x(x^4 + 1)(x^2 + 1)(x + 1)(x - 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely, where \(n\) is a positive integer: \(x^{8n} - 1\)
Factor completely: \(2a^9b - 512ab^9\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(2ab\) to get \(2ab(a^8 - 256b^8)\), then apply difference of squares three times to obtain \(2ab(a^4 + 16b^4)(a^2 + 4b^2)(a + 2b)(a - 2b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely, where \(n\) is a positive integer: \(256x^{8n} - y^{8n}\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(256x^{8n} - y^{8n}\) as \((16x^{4n})^2 - (y^{4n})^2\) and factor difference of squares three times to get \((16x^{4n} + y^{4n})(4x^{2n} + y^{2n})(2x^n + y^n)(2x^n - y^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(y^{16} - 1\)
qs.s: Because the exponent is 16, apply difference of squares four successive times to reach \((y^8 + 1)(y^4 + 1)(y^2 + 1)(y + 1)(y - 1)\).
Rewrite the expression as \((m^3 - 5n^3)^2 - (c^2 + 4d^2)^2\). Factoring the difference of squares results in \((m^3 - 5n^3 - c^2 - 4d^2)(m^3 - 5n^3 + c^2 + 4d^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^4 + 10x^2y^2 + 25y^4) - (w^6 - 6w^3z^3 + 9z^6)\)
qs.s: Write each trinomial as a square to obtain \((x^2 + 5y^2)^2 - (w^3 - 3z^3)^2\). Applying difference of squares gives \([(x^2 + 5y^2) - (w^3 - 3z^3)][(x^2 + 5y^2) + (w^3 - 3z^3)] = (x^2 + 5y^2 - w^3 + 3z^3)(x^2 + 5y^2 + w^3 - 3z^3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((u^6 + 6u^3v^3 + 9v^6) - (p^4 - 4p^2q^2 + 4q^4)\)
qs.s: Recognize the perfect square trinomials \((u^3 + 3v^3)^2 - (p^2 - 2q^2)^2\). Using the difference of squares identity yields \((u^3 + 3v^3 - p^2 + 2q^2)(u^3 + 3v^3 + p^2 - 2q^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a^6 - 8a^3b^3 + 16b^6) - (r^4 + 6r^2s^2 + 9s^4)\)
qs.s: Factor each trinomial as a perfect square: \((a^3 - 4b^3)^2 - (r^2 + 3s^2)^2\). Factoring the difference of squares gives \((a^3 - 4b^3 - r^2 - 3s^2)(a^3 - 4b^3 + r^2 + 3s^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^4 - 6x^2y^2 + 9y^4) - (a^6 + 4a^3b^3 + 4b^6)\)
qs.s: Factor each grouped trinomial as a perfect square to get \((x^2 - 3y^2)^2 - (a^3 + 2b^3)^2\). Applying the difference of squares gives \((x^2 - 3y^2 - a^3 - 2b^3)(x^2 - 3y^2 + a^3 + 2b^3)\).
Factor the non-monic trinomials as \((3x^3 - 4y^3)^2 - (5a^2 + 7b^2)^2\). Applying difference of squares gives \((3x^3 - 4y^3 - 5a^2 - 7b^2)(3x^3 - 4y^3 + 5a^2 + 7b^2)\).
Rewrite the expression as \((4x^4 - 5y^4)^2 - (6a^3 + 7b^3)^2\). Applying difference of squares yields \((4x^4 - 5y^4 - 6a^3 - 7b^3)(4x^4 - 5y^4 + 6a^3 + 7b^3)\).

First factor out the greatest common factor \(2\) to get \(2[(4x^6 + 20x^3y^3 + 25y^6) - (9a^4 - 24a^2b^2 + 16b^4)] = 2[(2x^3 + 5y^3)^2 - (3a^2 - 4b^2)^2]\). Applying difference of squares gives \(2(2x^3 + 5y^3 - 3a^2 + 4b^2)(2x^3 + 5y^3 + 3a^2 - 4b^2)\).
Factor out the monomial GCF \(3k^2\) to get \(3k^2[(x^3 - 6y^3)^2 - (a^2 + 5b^2)^2]\). Applying difference of squares gives \(3k^2(x^3 - 6y^3 - a^2 - 5b^2)(x^3 - 6y^3 + a^2 + 5b^2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(9^{2a}x^{2a} - 16^{2b}y^{2b}\)
qs.s: Recognize that \(9^{2a}x^{2a} = (9^a x^a)^2\) and \(16^{2b}y^{2b} = (16^b y^b)^2\). Applying the difference of squares formula gives \((9^a x^a + 16^b y^b)(9^a x^a - 16^b y^b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(49^{2u}p^{2u} - 4^{2v}q^{2v}\)
qs.s: Express each term as a square: \((49^u p^u)^2 - (4^v q^v)^2\). Factoring the difference of squares yields \((49^u p^u + 4^v q^v)(49^u p^u - 4^v q^v)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(81^{2k}w^{2k} - 64^{2m}z^{2m}\)
qs.s: Rewrite the binomial as a difference of squares: \((81^k w^k)^2 - (64^m z^m)^2\). Applying \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) produces \((81^k w^k + 64^m z^m)(81^k w^k - 64^m z^m)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(100^{2c}r^{2c} - 121^{2d}s^{2d}\)
qs.s: Identify each term as a square: \((100^c r^c)^2 - (121^d s^d)^2\). Factoring this difference of squares yields \((100^c r^c + 121^d s^d)(100^c r^c - 121^d s^d)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25^{2m}a^{2m} - 36^{2n}b^{2n}\)
qs.s: Rewrite the terms as perfect squares: \((25^m a^m)^2 - (36^n b^n)^2\). Using the difference of squares rule gives \((25^m a^m + 36^n b^n)(25^m a^m - 36^n b^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^{4m} - 81^{2n}y^{4n}\)
qs.s: First factor as a difference of squares to get \((x^{2m} + 81^n y^{2n})(x^{2m} - 81^n y^{2n})\). Since \(81^n y^{2n} = (9^n y^n)^2\), the second factor factors again to give \((x^{2m} + 81^n y^{2n})(x^m + 9^n y^n)(x^m - 9^n y^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^{8m} - 16^{2n}y^{8n}\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares repeatedly: first into \((x^{4m} + 16^n y^{4n})(x^{4m} - 16^n y^{4n})\), then factor \(x^{4m} - 16^n y^{4n}\) into \((x^{2m} + 4^n y^{2n})(x^{2m} - 4^n y^{2n})\), and finally factor \(x^{2m} - 4^n y^{2n}\) into \((x^m + 2^n y^n)(x^m - 2^n y^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(5w^2 x^{4m} - 80w^2 y^{4n}\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(5w^2\) to obtain \(5w^2(x^{4m} - 16y^{4n})\). Applying the difference of squares repeatedly to the binomial yields \(5w^2(x^{2m} + 4y^{2n})(x^m + 2y^n)(x^m - 2y^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^{4a}y^{4a} - 16^{2b}z^{4b}\)
Factor completely: \(16^{2m}a^{4m} - 81^{2n}b^{4n}\)
qs.s: Factoring the initial difference of squares gives \((16^m a^{2m} + 81^n b^{2n})(16^m a^{2m} - 81^n b^{2n})\). Factoring the second factor further as \((4^m a^m)^2 - (9^n b^n)^2\) yields \((16^m a^{2m} + 81^n b^{2n})(4^m a^m + 9^n b^n)(4^m a^m - 9^n b^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(16^{4y}r^{10y} - 25^{6y}s^{2y}\)
Factor completely: \(36^{6x}a^{4x} - 49^{4x}b^{6x}\)
qs.s: Write each term as a square: \((36^{3x}a^{2x})^2 - (49^{2x}b^{3x})^2\). Applying the difference of squares identity \(A^2 - B^2 = (A + B)(A - B)\) gives \((36^{3x}a^{2x} + 49^{2x}b^{3x})(36^{3x}a^{2x} - 49^{2x}b^{3x})\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(4^{8n}m^{2n} - 81^{4n}p^{6n}\)
qs.s: Express the expression as \((4^{4n}m^n)^2 - (81^{2n}p^{3n})^2\). Using the difference of squares identity yields \((4^{4n}m^n + 81^{2n}p^{3n})(4^{4n}m^n - 81^{2n}p^{3n})\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(100^{4w}c^{6w} - 4^{6w}d^{10w}\)
qs.s: Identify each term as a square: \((100^{2w}c^{3w})^2 - (4^{3w}d^{5w})^2\). Factoring as a difference of squares results in \((100^{2w}c^{3w} + 4^{3w}d^{5w})(100^{2w}c^{3w} - 4^{3w}d^{5w})\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2a^{4n+1} - 32a b^{4n}\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(2a\) to get \(2a(a^{4n} - 16b^{4n})\). Then factor the remaining binomial repeatedly using the difference of squares identity to obtain \(2a(a^{2n} + 4b^{2n})(a^n + 2b^n)(a^n - 2b^n)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(81^{4x} a^{8x} y^{4x} - 16^{4x} b^{8x} z^{4x}\)
qs.s: Factoring the difference of squares initially produces \((81^{2x} a^{4x} y^{2x} + 16^{2x} b^{4x} z^{2x})(81^{2x} a^{4x} y^{2x} - 16^{2x} b^{4x} z^{2x})\). Factoring the second factor again as a difference of squares yields \((81^{2x} a^{4x} y^{2x} + 16^{2x} b^{4x} z^{2x})(81^x a^{2x} y^x + 16^x b^{2x} z^x)(81^x a^{2x} y^x - 16^x b^{2x} z^x)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x + y)^{4n} - 16^{4n} z^{4n}\)
qs.s: Treat \((x+y)\) as a single base and factor as a difference of squares to get \([(x + y)^{2n} + 16^{2n} z^{2n}][(x + y)^{2n} - 16^{2n} z^{2n}]\). Factoring the second factor again gives \([(x + y)^{2n} + 16^{2n} z^{2n}][(x + y)^n + 16^n z^n][(x + y)^n - 16^n z^n]\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(a^{8n} b^{8n} - 16^{8n} c^{8n}\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares three times consecutively: first into exponents of \(4n\), then the negative factor into exponents of \(2n\), and finally that negative factor into exponents of \(n\), yielding four binomial factors.

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x y^{4n+1} - 243x y z^{4n}\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(3xy\) to arrive at \(3xy(y^{4n} - 81z^{4n})\). Factoring the difference of squares twice gives \(3xy(y^{2n} + 9z^{2n})(y^n + 3z^n)(y^n - 3z^n)\).

exercises.name: Factor difference of squares of grouped trinomials

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 + 2xy + y^2) - 4(x^2 + 4xy + 4y^2)\)
qs.s: Rewrite as \((x + y)^2 - [2(x + 2y)]^2\) and apply the difference of squares to get \([(x + y) + 2(x + 2y)][(x + y) - 2(x + 2y)] = (3x + 5y)(-x - 3y) = -(x + 3y)(3x + 5y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((a^2 - 2ab + b^2) - 9(a^2 - 4ab + 4b^2)\)
qs.s: Express as \((a - b)^2 - [3(a - 2b)]^2\) and apply the difference of squares: \([(a - b) + 3(a - 2b)][(a - b) - 3(a - 2b)] = (4a - 7b)(-2a + 5b) = -(2a - 5b)(4a - 7b)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 + 6xy + 9y^2) - 16(x^2 + 2xy + y^2)\)
qs.s: Rewrite as \((x + 3y)^2 - [4(x + y)]^2\) and factor using difference of squares to obtain \([(x + 3y) + 4(x + y)][(x + 3y) - 4(x + y)] = (5x + 7y)(-3x - y) = -(3x + y)(5x + 7y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 + 4xy + 4y^2) - 9(x^2 + 2xy + y^2)\)
qs.s: Write the expression as \((x + 2y)^2 - [3(x + y)]^2\) and use the difference of squares: \([(x + 2y) + 3(x + y)][(x + 2y) - 3(x + y)] = (4x + 5y)(-2x - y) = -(2x + y)(4x + 5y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((x^2 - 10xy + 25y^2) - 4(x^2 - 2xy + y^2)\)
Factor completely: \(9(9x^2 + 6xy + y^2) - 16(x^2 - 4xy + 4y^2)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \([3(3x + y)]^2 - [4(x - 2y)]^2 = (9x + 3y)^2 - (4x - 8y)^2\). Applying the difference of squares yields \([(9x + 3y) + (4x - 8y)][(9x + 3y) - (4x - 8y)] = (13x - 5y)(5x + 11y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2(x^2 + 8xy + 16y^2) - 18(x^2 - 2xy + y^2)\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(2\) to get \(2[(x + 4y)^2 - 9(x - y)^2]\), then apply the difference of squares: \(2[(x + 4y) + 3(x - y)][(x + 4y) - 3(x - y)] = 2(4x + y)(-2x + 7y) = -2(2x - 7y)(4x + y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \((4x^2 + 12xy + 9y^2) - 16(x^2 - 2xy + y^2)\)
qs.s: Recognize \((2x + 3y)^2 - [4(x - y)]^2\) and use the difference of squares: \([(2x + 3y) + 4(x - y)][(2x + 3y) - 4(x - y)] = (6x - y)(-2x + 7y) = -(2x - 7y)(6x - y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(25(4x^2 + 12xy + 9y^2) - 4(9x^2 - 12xy + 4y^2)\)
qs.s: Express as \([5(2x + 3y)]^2 - [2(3x - 2y)]^2 = (10x + 15y)^2 - (6x - 4y)^2\). Factoring via difference of squares gives \([(10x + 15y) + (6x - 4y)][(10x + 15y) - (6x - 4y)] = (16x + 11y)(4x + 19y)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^{-2} - 7x^{-3} + 2x^{-4}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power of \(x\), which is \(x^{-4}\), to get \(x^{-4}(3x^2 - 7x + 2)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial yields \(x^{-4}(3x - 1)(x - 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2x^{-1} + 7x^{-2} + 3x^{-3}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power of \(x\), which is \(x^{-3}\), leaving \(x^{-3}(2x^2 + 7x + 3)\). Factoring the quadratic gives \(x^{-3}(2x + 1)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2x^{-2} - 5x^{-3} - 7x^{-4}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power \(x^{-4}\) to write the expression as \(x^{-4}(2x^2 - 5x - 7)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(x^{-4}(2x - 7)(x + 1)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(3x^{-3} - 10x^{-4} + 3x^{-5}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power \(x^{-5}\) to obtain \(x^{-5}(3x^2 - 10x + 3)\). Then factor the quadratic expression to get \(x^{-5}(3x - 1)(x - 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(2x^{-2} + 5x^{-3} - 3x^{-4}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power \(x^{-4}\) to get \(x^{-4}(2x^2 + 5x - 3)\). Factoring the remaining trinomial produces \(x^{-4}(2x - 1)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(6x^{-2} + 26x^{-3} + 24x^{-4}\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(2x^{-4}\) to obtain \(2x^{-4}(3x^2 + 13x + 12)\). Then factor the quadratic trinomial to obtain \(2x^{-4}(3x + 4)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(12x^{-2} - 23x^{-3} + 10x^{-4}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power \(x^{-4}\) to get \(x^{-4}(12x^2 - 23x + 10)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(x^{-4}(3x - 2)(4x - 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(48x^{-2} - 75x^{-4}\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(3x^{-4}\) to get \(3x^{-4}(16x^2 - 25)\). Then factor using the difference of squares to get \(3x^{-4}(4x - 5)(4x + 5)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^{-1} - 81x^{-5}\)
qs.s: Factor out the lowest power \(x^{-5}\) to obtain \(x^{-5}(x^4 - 81)\). Factoring the difference of squares twice yields \(x^{-5}(x^2 + 9)(x^2 - 9) = x^{-5}(x^2 + 9)(x + 3)(x - 3)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(-6x^{-3} + 9x^{-4} + 42x^{-5}\)
qs.s: Factor out the greatest common factor \(-3x^{-5}\), leaving \(-3x^{-5}(2x^2 - 3x - 14)\). Factoring the quadratic trinomial gives \(-3x^{-5}(2x - 7)(x + 2)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{y^4}{16} - 1\)
qs.s: Recognize the expression as a difference of squares: \(\frac{y^4}{16} - 1 = \left(\frac{y^2}{4} + 1\right)\left(\frac{y^2}{4} - 1\right)\). Factoring the difference of squares \(\frac{y^2}{4} - 1\) gives the complete factorization \(\left(\frac{y^2}{4} + 1\right)\left(\frac{y}{2} + 1\right)\left(\frac{y}{2} - 1\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{a^4}{256} - 1\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares to obtain \(\left(\frac{a^2}{16} + 1\right)\left(\frac{a^2}{16} - 1\right)\). Factoring the difference of squares \(\frac{a^2}{16} - 1\) again gives \(\left(\frac{a^2}{16} + 1\right)\left(\frac{a}{4} + 1\right)\left(\frac{a}{4} - 1\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(x^4 - \frac{1}{81}\)
qs.s: Factor as a difference of squares to get \(\left(x^2 + \frac{1}{9}\right)\left(x^2 - \frac{1}{9}\right)\). Then factor the second factor further to get \(\left(x^2 + \frac{1}{9}\right)\left(x + \frac{1}{3}\right)\left(x - \frac{1}{3}\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{z^4}{81} - 16\)
qs.s: First factor as a difference of squares to get \(\left(\frac{z^2}{9} + 4\right)\left(\frac{z^2}{9} - 4\right)\). Then factor \(\frac{z^2}{9} - 4\) to obtain \(\left(\frac{z^2}{9} + 4\right)\left(\frac{z}{3} + 2\right)\left(\frac{z}{3} - 2\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(1 - \frac{m^4}{16}\)
qs.s: Factoring the difference of squares yields \(\left(1 + \frac{m^2}{4}\right)\left(1 - \frac{m^2}{4}\right)\). Factoring the second factor again gives \(\left(1 + \frac{m^2}{4}\right)\left(1 + \frac{m}{2}\right)\left(1 - \frac{m}{2}\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{x^5}{81} - \frac{x}{16}\)
qs.s: First factor out the greatest common factor \(x\) to get \(x\left(\frac{x^4}{81} - \frac{1}{16}\right)\). Factoring the difference of squares twice gives \(x\left(\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{1}{4}\right)\left(\frac{x}{3} + \frac{1}{2}\right)\left(\frac{x}{3} - \frac{1}{2}\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{16a^4}{81} - \frac{b^4}{625}\)
qs.s: Factoring the difference of squares gives \(\left(\frac{4a^2}{9} + \frac{b^2}{25}\right)\left(\frac{4a^2}{9} - \frac{b^2}{25}\right)\). Factoring \(\frac{4a^2}{9} - \frac{b^2}{25}\) completely yields \(\left(\frac{4a^2}{9} + \frac{b^2}{25}\right)\left(\frac{2a}{3} + \frac{b}{5}\right)\left(\frac{2a}{3} - \frac{b}{5}\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{a^4 b^4}{81} - 16c^4\)
qs.s: The expression factors first as the difference of squares \(\left(\frac{a^2 b^2}{9} + 4c^2\right)\left(\frac{a^2 b^2}{9} - 4c^2\right)\). Factoring the second factor again as a difference of squares yields \(\left(\frac{a^2 b^2}{9} + 4c^2\right)\left(\frac{ab}{3} + 2c\right)\left(\frac{ab}{3} - 2c\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely, where \(n\) is a positive integer: \(\frac{x^{4n}}{81} - y^{4n}\)
qs.s: Using the difference of squares formula, factor \(\frac{x^{4n}}{81} - y^{4n}\) as \(\left(\frac{x^{2n}}{9} + y^{2n}\right)\left(\frac{x^{2n}}{9} - y^{2n}\right)\). Factoring the second factor again as a difference of squares yields \(\left(\frac{x^{2n}}{9} + y^{2n}\right)\left(\frac{x^n}{3} + y^n\right)\left(\frac{x^n}{3} - y^n\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(\frac{x^8}{256} - 1\)
qs.s: Applying the difference of squares repeatedly yields \(\left(\frac{x^4}{16} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x^4}{16} - 1\right) = \left(\frac{x^4}{16} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x^2}{4} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x^2}{4} - 1\right)\). Factoring the final difference of squares gives \(\left(\frac{x^4}{16} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x^2}{4} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x}{2} + 1\right)\left(\frac{x}{2} - 1\right)\).

qs.q: Factor completely: \(y^4 - 625\)
