qs.s: Factor out common monomials first to get \(\frac{3x^a(x^{2a}-x^a-12)}{2x^a(x^{2a}-9)} = \frac{3x^a(x^a-4)(x^a+3)}{2x^a(x^a-3)(x^a+3)}\). Dividing out the common factor \(x^a(x^a+3)\) leaves \(\frac{3(x^a-4)}{2(x^a-3)}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{3x^{2a+1} - 7x^{a+1} + 2x}{9x^{2a+1} - x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) to get \(\frac{x(3x^a - 1)(x^a - 2)}{x(3x^a - 1)(3x^a + 1)}\). Cancel the common factor \(x(3x^a - 1)\) to obtain \(\frac{x^a - 2}{3x^a + 1}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{a^{2p+2} + 3a^{p+2} + 2a^2}{a^{2p+2} - 4a^2}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(a^2\) to express the fraction as \(\frac{a^2(a^p + 1)(a^p + 2)}{a^2(a^p - 2)(a^p + 2)}\). Dividing out the common factor \(a^2(a^p + 2)\) gives \(\frac{a^p + 1}{a^p - 2}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{3x^{2n+1} + 4x^{n+1} + x}{9x^{2n+1} - x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) from both the numerator and the denominator to get \(\frac{x(3x^n + 1)(x^n + 1)}{x(3x^n + 1)(3x^n - 1)}\). Dividing out the common factor \(x(3x^n + 1)\) leaves \(\frac{x^n + 1}{3x^n - 1}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{2y^{2m+1} - 5y^{m+1} - 3y}{4y^{2m+1} - y}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(y\) from the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{y(2y^m + 1)(y^m - 3)}{y(2y^m + 1)(2y^m - 1)}\). Canceling the common factor \(y(2y^m + 1)\) leaves \(\frac{y^m - 3}{2y^m - 1}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{2k+1} - 5x^{k+1} + 6x}{x^{2k+1} - 4x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) to obtain \(\frac{x(x^k - 2)(x^k - 3)}{x(x^k - 2)(x^k + 2)}\). Dividing both numerator and denominator by \(x(x^k - 2)\) results in \(\frac{x^k - 3}{x^k + 2}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{4x^{2m+3} + 8x^{m+3} - 5x^3}{6x^{2m+3} + 19x^{m+3} + 10x^3}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x^3\) from the numerator and denominator, then factor each quadratic-form trinomial to get \(\frac{x^3(2x^m - 1)(2x^m + 5)}{x^3(3x^m + 2)(2x^m + 5)}\). Dividing by the common factor \(x^3(2x^m + 5)\) yields \(\frac{2x^m - 1}{3x^m + 2}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{3n+1} - 2x^{2n+1} - x^{n+1} + 2x}{x^{3n+1} + x^{2n+1} - 4x^{n+1} - 4x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) and then factor each four-term polynomial by grouping to obtain \(\frac{x(x^n - 2)(x^n - 1)(x^n + 1)}{x(x^n + 1)(x^n - 2)(x^n + 2)}\). Dividing out the common factor \(x(x^n - 2)(x^n + 1)\) leaves \(\frac{x^n - 1}{x^n + 2}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2a+1}y - 5x^{a+1}y^{b+1} - 3xy^{2b+1}}{4x^{2a+1}y - xy^{2b+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor out the common monomial \(xy\) and factor the quadratic-form expressions to get \(\frac{xy(2x^a + y^b)(x^a - 3y^b)}{xy(2x^a - y^b)(2x^a + y^b)}\). Canceling \(xy(2x^a + y^b)\) gives \(\frac{x^a - 3y^b}{2x^a - y^b}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{3x^{2a+2}y^b - 5x^{a+2}y^{2b} - 2x^2y^{3b}}{9x^{2a+2}y^b - x^2y^{3b}}\)
qs.s: Factor out the common factor \(x^2y^b\) to get \(\frac{x^2y^b(3x^a + y^b)(x^a - 2y^b)}{x^2y^b(3x^a + y^b)(3x^a - y^b)}\). Dividing out the common factor \(x^2y^b(3x^a + y^b)\) leaves \(\frac{x^a - 2y^b}{3x^a - y^b}\).

qs.q: Simplify the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2k+1} + 5x^{k+1} - 3x}{x + 2x^{k+1} - 8x^{2k+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) from the numerator and \(-x\) from the denominator to obtain \(\frac{x(2x^k - 1)(x^k + 3)}{-x(2x^k - 1)(4x^k + 1)}\). Canceling the common factor \(x(2x^k - 1)\) simplifies the expression to \(-\frac{x^k + 3}{4x^k + 1}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{m^{2p+3}-m^3}{m^{p+3}+m^3}\)
qs.s: Factor \(m^3\) from the numerator and denominator to obtain \(\frac{m^3(m^{2p}-1)}{m^3(m^p+1)}\). Factoring \(m^{2p}-1\) as \((m^p-1)(m^p+1)\) and canceling \(m^3(m^p+1)\) yields \(m^p - 1\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{2m+1}-4x}{x^{m+1}-2x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) to rewrite the expression as \(\frac{x(x^{2m}-4)}{x(x^m-2)} = \frac{x(x^m-2)(x^m+2)}{x(x^m-2)}\). Canceling the common factor \(x(x^m-2)\) leaves \(x^m + 2\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{y^{2k+1}-y}{y^{k+1}+y}\)
qs.s: Factor \(y\) from both the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{y(y^{2k}-1)}{y(y^k+1)}\). Since \(y^{2k}-1=(y^k-1)(y^k+1)\), cancel \(y(y^k+1)\) to obtain \(y^k - 1\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{c^{2n+1}-9c}{c^{n+1}+3c}\)
qs.s: Factor \(c\) from both terms to get \(\frac{c(c^{2n}-9)}{c(c^n+3)} = \frac{c(c^n-3)(c^n+3)}{c(c^n+3)}\). Dividing both numerator and denominator by \(c(c^n+3)\) results in \(c^n - 3\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{a^{2n+2}-a^2}{a^{n+2}-a^2}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(a^2\) from the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{a^2(a^{2n}-1)}{a^2(a^n-1)}\). Factoring the numerator as \(a^2(a^n-1)(a^n+1)\) and dividing out \(a^2(a^n-1)\) gives \(a^n + 1\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2m+1} - 5x^{m+1} - 3x}{4x^{2m+1} - x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) from the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{x(2x^{2m}-5x^m-3)}{x(4x^{2m}-1)}\). Factoring both parts yields \(\frac{x(2x^m+1)(x^m-3)}{x(2x^m-1)(2x^m+1)}\), which simplifies to \(\frac{x^m-3}{2x^m-1}\) after canceling \(x(2x^m+1)\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{3n+1} - 2x^{2n+1} - x^{n+1} + 2x}{x^{2n+1} - 3x^{n+1} + 2x}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x\) from the numerator and factor by grouping to get \(x(x^{2n}-1)(x^n-2) = x(x^n-1)(x^n+1)(x^n-2)\). Factoring the denominator gives \(x(x^{2n}-3x^n+2) = x(x^n-1)(x^n-2)\), so canceling the common factors leaves \(x^n+1\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{2n+1} + 5x^{n+1} + 6x}{x^{2n+1} + 7x^{n+1} + 12x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x\) from the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{x(x^{2n}+5x^n+6)}{x(x^{2n}+7x^n+12)}\). Factoring the trinomials gives \(\frac{x(x^n+2)(x^n+3)}{x(x^n+3)(x^n+4)}\), which reduces to \(\frac{x^n+2}{x^n+4}\) after canceling \(x(x^n+3)\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{2n+2} - 2x^{n+2} - 15x^2}{x^{2n+2} - 25x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor out \(x^2\) from both the numerator and denominator to obtain \(\frac{x^2(x^{2n}-2x^n-15)}{x^2(x^{2n}-25)}\). Factoring the numerator as a trinomial and the denominator as a difference of squares gives \(\frac{x^2(x^n-5)(x^n+3)}{x^2(x^n-5)(x^n+5)} = \frac{x^n+3}{x^n+5}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{2a+1}y - x y^{2b+1}}{x^{a+1}y - x y^{b+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the common monomial factor \(xy\) from the numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{xy(x^{2a}-y^{2b})}{xy(x^a-y^b)}\). Factoring the difference of squares in the numerator gives \(\frac{xy(x^a-y^b)(x^a+y^b)}{xy(x^a-y^b)} = x^a + y^b\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2n+2} + 7x^{n+2} + 3x^2}{3x + 5x^{n+1} - 2x^{2n+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \(x^2(2x^n+1)(x^n+3)\) and the denominator as \(-x(2x^n+1)(x^n-3)\). Dividing numerator and denominator by the common factor \(x(2x^n+1)\) gives \(-\frac{x(x^n+3)}{x^n-3}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{y^{2k+2} - 4y^{k+2} + 3y^2}{3y - y^{k+1} - 2y^{2k+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \(y^2(y^k-1)(y^k-3)\) and the denominator as \(-y(y^k-1)(2y^k+3)\). Canceling the common factor \(y(y^k-1)\) yields \(-\frac{y(y^k-3)}{2y^k+3}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2a+3} + x^{a+3} - 6x^3}{6x - x^{a+1} - 2x^{2a+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^3\) from the numerator to obtain \(x^3(2x^{2a}+x^a-6)\) and \(-x\) from the denominator to obtain \(-x(2x^{2a}+x^a-6)\). Canceling the common quadratic trinomial leaves \(\frac{x^3}{-x} = -x^2\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{4x^{2a+3} + 8x^{a+3} - 5x^3}{10x^2 - 16x^{a+2} - 8x^{2a+2}}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^3\) from the numerator to get \(x^3(4x^{2a}+8x^a-5)\), and factor \(-2x^2\) from the denominator to get \(-2x^2(4x^{2a}+8x^a-5)\). Dividing out the common factor \((4x^{2a}+8x^a-5)\) leaves \(\frac{x^3}{-2x^2} = -\frac{x}{2}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{3z^{2m+2} - 5z^{m+2} - 2z^2}{2z + 3z^{m+1} - 2z^{2m+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator into \(z^2(3z^m+1)(z^m-2)\) and the denominator into \(-z(2z^m+1)(z^m-2)\). Canceling the common factor \(z(z^m-2)\) leaves \(-\frac{z(3z^m+1)}{2z^m+1}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{3a+3} - 2x^{2a+3} - 9x^{a+3} + 18x^3}{18x + 9x^{a+1} - 2x^{2a+1} - x^{3a+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator by grouping as \(x^3(x^{2a}-9)(x^a-2)\) and the denominator by grouping as \(-x(x^{2a}-9)(x^a+2)\). Canceling the common factor \(x(x^{2a}-9)\) gives \(-\frac{x^2(x^a-2)}{x^a+2}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{6x^{2n+2}y^m - 7x^{n+2}y^{2m} - 5x^2y^{3m}}{10xy^{3m+1} - x^{n+1}y^{2m+1} - 3x^{2n+1}y^{m+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \(x^2y^m(2x^n+y^m)(3x^n-5y^m)\) and the denominator as \(-xy^{m+1}(3x^n-5y^m)(x^n+2y^m)\). Canceling the common factor \(xy^m(3x^n-5y^m)\) yields \(-\frac{x(2x^n+y^m)}{y(x^n+2y^m)}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{x^{4n+2} - 10x^{2n+2} + 9x^2}{x^{3n+1} - 3x^{2n+1} - x^{n+1} + 3x}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \(x^2(x^{2n}-1)(x^n-3)(x^n+3)\) and factor the denominator by grouping as \(x(x^{2n}-1)(x^n-3)\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \((x^{2n}-1)\), and \((x^n-3)\) leaves \(x(x^n+3)\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{2a+1}y - 5x^{a+1}y^{b+1} - 3xy^{2b+1}}{x^{2a}y^2 - 9y^{2b+2}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \(xy(2x^a+y^b)(x^a-3y^b)\) and the denominator as a difference of squares \(y^2(x^a-3y^b)(x^a+3y^b)\). Dividing numerator and denominator by \(y(x^a-3y^b)\) leaves \(\frac{x(2x^a+y^b)}{y(x^a+3y^b)}\).

qs.q: Reduce the rational expression: \(\frac{2x^{3a+2} + 3x^{2a+2} - 8x^{a+2} - 12x^2}{6x + x^{a+1} - 2x^{2a+1}}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator by grouping into \(x^2(2x^a+3)(x^a-2)(x^a+2)\) and the denominator into \(-x(2x^a+3)(x^a-2)\). Dividing out the common factor \(x(2x^a+3)(x^a-2)\) results in \(-x(x^a+2)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular prism is \((2x^2 + 9x + 10)(x + 1)\). If the height of the prism is \(2x + 5\), what is the area of the base of the prism in factored form?
The volume of a shipping crate is \((6x^2 - 7x - 5)(x + 6)\). If the height of the crate is \(3x - 5\), what is the area of the bottom of the crate in factored form?
qs.s: Factor the quadratic in the numerator to get \(\frac{(3x - 5)(2x + 1)(x + 6)}{3x - 5}\), then cancel the common factor \((3x - 5)\) to obtain \((2x + 1)(x + 6)\).

qs.q: The volume of a wooden chest is \((5x^2 - 13x - 6)(x - 2)\). If the height of the chest is \(5x + 2\), what is the area of the bottom of the chest in factored form?
qs.s: Dividing the volume by the height gives \(\frac{(5x + 2)(x - 3)(x - 2)}{5x + 2} = (x - 3)(x - 2)\).

qs.q: The volume of a box is \((4x^2 + 11x - 3)(x + 4)\). If the height of the box is \(4x - 1\), what is the area of the bottom of the box in factored form?
qs.s: Divide the volume by the height: \(\frac{(4x^2 + 11x - 3)(x + 4)}{4x - 1} = \frac{(4x - 1)(x + 3)(x + 4)}{4x - 1} = (x + 3)(x + 4)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular container is \((3x^2 + 14x - 5)(2x + 3)\). If the height of the container is \(x + 5\), what is the area of the base of the container in factored form?
qs.s: Factor \(3x^2 + 14x - 5\) as \((3x - 1)(x + 5)\), divide by the height \((x + 5)\), and cancel the common factor to leave \((3x - 1)(2x + 3)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular box is \((6x^2 + 7x - 20)(x + 2)\). If the height of the box is \(2x + 5\) and the width of the bottom is \(x + 2\), what is the perimeter of the bottom of the box?
qs.s: The base area is \(\frac{(2x + 5)(3x - 4)(x + 2)}{2x + 5} = (3x - 4)(x + 2)\), so the length is \(3x - 4\). The perimeter is \(2((3x - 4) + (x + 2)) = 8x - 4\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular prism is \((6x^2 - 7x - 3)(x + 4)\). If the area of its base is \(4x^2 - 9\), what is the height of the prism in simplest form?
qs.s: Factoring numerator and denominator gives \(\frac{(2x - 3)(3x + 1)(x + 4)}{(2x - 3)(2x + 3)}\). Cancelling the common factor \((2x - 3)\) gives \(\frac{(3x + 1)(x + 4)}{2x + 3}\).

qs.q: The area of a triangle is \(3x^2 + 11x - 4\). If the height of the triangle is \(x + 4\), what is the length of its base in simplest form?
qs.s: The base is \(\frac{2 \cdot \text{Area}}{\text{height}} = \frac{2(3x^2 + 11x - 4)}{x + 4} = \frac{2(3x - 1)(x + 4)}{x + 4} = 2(3x - 1) = 6x - 2\).

qs.q: A rectangular storage container has a volume of \(2x^2 + 13x + 15\) and a base area of \(2x^2 + 7x - 15\). What is the height of the container in simplest form?
qs.s: Divide volume by base area: \(\frac{2x^2 + 13x + 15}{2x^2 + 7x - 15} = \frac{(2x + 3)(x + 5)}{(2x - 3)(x + 5)} = \frac{2x + 3}{2x - 3}\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular prism is \((3x^3 - 12x)(2x^2 + 5x - 3)\). If the area of its base is \((x - 2)(2x - 1)\), what is the height of the prism in factored form?
qs.s: Factor completely to get \(\frac{3x(x - 2)(x + 2)(2x - 1)(x + 3)}{(x - 2)(2x - 1)}\), then cancel common factors \((x - 2)\) and \((2x - 1)\) to get \(3x(x + 2)(x + 3)\).

qs.q: The volume of a box is \((2x^{2a} + 5x^a + 2)(x^a - 3)\). If the height of the box is \(x^a + 2\), what is the area of the bottom of the box?
qs.s: Factoring the first expression gives \(2x^{2a} + 5x^a + 2 = (2x^a + 1)(x^a + 2)\). Dividing the volume by the height \(x^a + 2\) cancels the common factor, leaving \((2x^a + 1)(x^a - 3)\).

qs.q: The volume of a box is \((3x^{2m} + 7x^m + 2)(x^m - 5)\). If the height of the box is \(3x^m + 1\), what is the area of the bottom of the box?
qs.s: Factoring the trinomial gives \(3x^{2m} + 7x^m + 2 = (3x^m + 1)(x^m + 2)\). Dividing the volume by the height \(3x^m + 1\) leaves \((x^m + 2)(x^m - 5)\).

qs.q: The volume of a storage container is \((2y^{2k} - 3y^k - 2)(y^k - 1)\). If the height of the container is \(2y^k + 1\), what is the area of the bottom of the container?
qs.s: Factoring the quadratic trinomial yields \(2y^{2k} - 3y^k - 2 = (2y^k + 1)(y^k - 2)\). Dividing the volume by the height \(2y^k + 1\) leaves \((y^k - 2)(y^k - 1)\).

qs.q: The volume of a crate is \((x^{2a} + 6x^a + 8)(2x^a - 1)\). If the height of the crate is \(x^a + 4\), what is the area of the base of the crate?
qs.s: Factoring the trinomial gives \(x^{2a} + 6x^a + 8 = (x^a + 2)(x^a + 4)\). Dividing the volume by the height \(x^a + 4\) cancels the common factor and yields \((x^a + 2)(2x^a - 1)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular prism is \((3x^{2n} - 5x^n - 2)(x^n + 4)\). If the height of the prism is \(x^n - 2\), what is the area of the base of the prism?
qs.s: Factoring the trinomial yields \(3x^{2n} - 5x^n - 2 = (3x^n + 1)(x^n - 2)\). Dividing the volume by the height \(x^n - 2\) gives the base area \((3x^n + 1)(x^n + 4)\).

qs.q: The volume of a storage chest is \((3x^{2a} - 10x^a + 8)(4x^{2a} - 1)\). If the area of the bottom of the chest is \(2x^{2a} - 3x^a - 2\), what is the height of the chest?
qs.s: Factoring the volume produces \((3x^a - 4)(x^a - 2)(2x^a - 1)(2x^a + 1)\), and factoring the bottom area produces \((2x^a + 1)(x^a - 2)\). Dividing volume by area cancels the common factors, leaving \((3x^a - 4)(2x^a - 1)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular box is \(2x^{3a} + 3x^{2a} - 8x^a - 12\). If the height of the box is \(x^a + 2\), what is the area of the bottom of the box?
qs.s: Factoring the volume by grouping yields \(x^{2a}(2x^a + 3) - 4(2x^a + 3) = (x^a - 2)(x^a + 2)(2x^a + 3)\). Dividing by the height \(x^a + 2\) leaves the bottom area \((x^a - 2)(2x^a + 3)\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular crate is \(6x^{3n} - 7x^{2n} - 5x^n\). If the height of the crate is \(2x^n + 1\) and the length is \(x^n\), what is the width of the crate?
qs.s: Factoring out the greatest common factor and factoring the remaining trinomial gives the volume \(x^n(2x^n + 1)(3x^n - 5)\). Dividing by the product of the length and height, \(x^n(2x^n + 1)\), yields the width \(3x^n - 5\).

qs.q: The volume of a rectangular prism is \((6x^{2a} - 7x^a - 3)(x^{2a} - 16)\). If the area of the base of the prism is \((2x^a - 3)(x^a - 4)\), what is the height of the prism?
qs.s: Completely factoring the volume gives \((2x^a - 3)(3x^a + 1)(x^a - 4)(x^a + 4)\). Dividing by the base area \((2x^a - 3)(x^a - 4)\) cancels both common factors, giving the height \((3x^a + 1)(x^a + 4)\).

qs.q: The volume of a box is \((4x^{2k} - 9)(3x^{2k} + 8x^k - 3)\). If the length of the box is \(2x^k - 3\) and the width is \(x^k + 3\), what is the height of the box?
qs.s: Factoring the two polynomials in the volume gives \((2x^k - 3)(2x^k + 3)(3x^k - 1)(x^k + 3)\). Dividing by the length \((2x^k - 3)\) and width \((x^k + 3)\) leaves the height \((2x^k + 3)(3x^k - 1)\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) and \(\frac{c}{d}\) are rational expressions with \(b, c, d \neq 0\), then \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: To divide two rational expressions, multiply the first expression by the reciprocal of the second: \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d}{c} = \frac{ad}{bc}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) is a non-zero rational expression with \(a, b \neq 0\), then its reciprocal is \(\underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: The reciprocal of any non-zero rational expression \(\frac{a}{b}\) is formed by interchanging the numerator and denominator, which gives \(\frac{b}{a}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

To multiply two rational expressions, multiply the numerators together and multiply the ______ together.
qs.s: The rule for multiplying rational expressions states that the product is the product of the numerators divided by the product of the denominators.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) is a rational expression with \(b \neq 0\) and \(c\) is a polynomial, then \(c \cdot \frac{a}{b} = \underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: Writing the polynomial \(c\) as \(\frac{c}{1}\), the product is \(\frac{c}{1} \cdot \frac{a}{b} = \frac{ac}{b}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

To divide two rational expressions, multiply the first expression by the ______ of the second expression.
qs.s: By definition, the quotient of two rational expressions is found by multiplying the first expression by the reciprocal of the second.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\), \(\frac{c}{d}\), and \(\frac{e}{f}\) are rational expressions with \(b, d, f \neq 0\), then \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{c}{d} \cdot \frac{e}{f} = \underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: To multiply three rational expressions, multiply all numerators together and all denominators together: \(\frac{a \cdot c \cdot e}{b \cdot d \cdot f} = \frac{ace}{bdf}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) and \(\frac{c}{d}\) are rational expressions with \(a, b, c, d \neq 0\), then the reciprocal of the quotient \(\left(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\right)\) is \(\underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: First calculate the quotient \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{ad}{bc}\), and then take the reciprocal of that result to get \(\frac{bc}{ad}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\), \(\frac{c}{d}\), and \(\frac{e}{f}\) are rational expressions with \(b, d, e, f \neq 0\), then \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{c}{d} \div \frac{e}{f} = \underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: Convert the division into multiplication by the reciprocal of the divisor: \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{c}{d} \cdot \frac{f}{e} = \frac{acf}{bde}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

For the division of rational expressions \(\frac{P}{Q} \div \frac{R}{S}\) to be defined, the three polynomials that cannot equal zero are \(Q\), \(S\), and \(\underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: The denominators \(Q\) and \(S\) cannot be zero, and because dividing by \(\frac{R}{S}\) involves multiplying by \(\frac{S}{R}\), the numerator \(R\) also becomes a denominator and cannot equal zero.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) is a rational expression with \(a, b \neq 0\), then \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{b}{a} = \underline{\quad}\)
qs.s: Dividing by \(\frac{b}{a}\) is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal \(\frac{a}{b}\), giving \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{a}{b} = \frac{a^2}{b^2}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

For the division \(\frac{x}{y} \div \frac{z}{w}\) to be defined, the polynomials that cannot equal zero are \(y\), \(w\), and ______.
qs.s:
Both original denominators must be non-zero (\(y 
eq 0\), \(w 
eq 0\)), and the divisor fraction cannot be zero, which requires its numerator \(z 
eq 0\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{A}{B}\) is a rational expression and \(C\) is a non-zero polynomial, with \(B \neq 0\), then \(\frac{A}{B} \div C = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Write \(C\) as \(\frac{C}{1}\) and multiply by its reciprocal: \(\frac{A}{B} \cdot \frac{1}{C} = \frac{A}{BC}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(P\) is a polynomial and \(\frac{Q}{R}\) is a rational expression with \(Q, R \neq 0\), then \(P \div \frac{Q}{R} = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Write \(P\) as \(\frac{P}{1}\) and multiply by the reciprocal of \(\frac{Q}{R}\): \(\frac{P}{1} \cdot \frac{R}{Q} = \frac{PR}{Q}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

When dividing two rational expressions, the quotient is found by multiplying the first expression by the ______ of the second expression.
qs.s: By definition of dividing rational expressions, division is performed by multiplying the first expression by the reciprocal of the second expression.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{p}{q}\) and \(\frac{r}{s}\) are rational expressions with \(q, s \neq 0\), then \(\frac{p}{q} \cdot \frac{r}{s} = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: To multiply two rational expressions, multiply the numerators together and the denominators together, resulting in \(\frac{pr}{qs}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{x}{y}\) and \(\frac{z}{w}\) are rational expressions with \(y, z, w \neq 0\), then \(\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^2 \div \frac{z}{w} = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Square the first expression to get \(\frac{x^2}{y^2}\), then multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{x^2}{y^2} \cdot \frac{w}{z} = \frac{x^2 w}{y^2 z}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{p}{q}\), \(\frac{r}{s}\), and \(\frac{t}{u}\) are rational expressions with \(q, s, t, u \neq 0\), then \(\frac{p}{q} \cdot \frac{r}{s} \div \frac{t}{u} = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Multiply the first two fractions to obtain \(\frac{pr}{qs}\), then multiply by the reciprocal of the third fraction: \(\frac{pr}{qs} \cdot \frac{u}{t} = \frac{pru}{qst}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{a}{b}\), \(\frac{c}{d}\), and \(\frac{e}{f}\) are rational expressions with \(b, c, d, e, f \neq 0\), then \(\frac{a}{b} \div \left(\frac{c}{d} \div \frac{e}{f}\right) = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Evaluate inside the parentheses first: \(\frac{c}{d} \div \frac{e}{f} = \frac{cf}{de}\). Then \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{cf}{de} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{de}{cf} = \frac{ade}{bcf}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{a}{b}\) and \(\frac{c}{d}\) are rational expressions with \(a, b, c, d \neq 0\), then the reciprocal of the quotient \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\) is \(\underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: The quotient is \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{ad}{bc}\). Inverting the numerator and denominator gives its reciprocal, \(\frac{bc}{ad}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true:

If \(\frac{a}{b}\), \(\frac{c}{d}\), and \(\frac{e}{f}\) are rational expressions with \(b, c, d, e, f \neq 0\), then \(\left(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\right) \div \frac{e}{f} = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: First compute \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{ad}{bc}\). Then divide by \(\frac{e}{f}\) by multiplying by its reciprocal: \(\frac{ad}{bc} \cdot \frac{f}{e} = \frac{adf}{bce}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of the polynomial \(2x - 3\) is ______.
qs.s: Writing the polynomial as \(\frac{2x - 3}{1}\) and swapping the numerator and denominator gives \(\frac{1}{2x - 3}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: If \(\frac{a}{b}\) and \(\frac{c}{d}\) are rational expressions with nonzero denominators, then \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: Dividing by a rational expression is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal, so we multiply by \(\frac{d}{c}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The product of the rational expression \(\frac{x - 4}{x + 7}\) and its reciprocal is ______.
qs.s: By definition, the product of any nonzero rational expression and its reciprocal is \(\frac{x - 4}{x + 7} \cdot \frac{x + 7}{x - 4} = 1\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of the rational expression \(\frac{3x - 1}{x + 5}\) is ______.
qs.s: The reciprocal of \(\frac{A}{B}\) is found by inverting the expression to \(\frac{B}{A}\), which gives \(\frac{x + 5}{3x - 1}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The ______ of \(\frac{a + 2b}{a - 2b}\) is \(\frac{a - 2b}{a + 2b}\).
qs.s: Interchanging the numerator and denominator of a rational expression gives its reciprocal.

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of the product \(\frac{x - 2}{x + 5} \cdot \frac{x + 5}{x + 3}\) is ______.
qs.s: Multiplying gives \(\frac{x - 2}{x + 3}\), and taking its reciprocal yields \(\frac{x + 3}{x - 2}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of \(\frac{5 - x}{x^2 - 25}\) in simplest form is ______.
Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of \(\frac{x^2 - 16}{x^2 + 7x + 12}\) in fully simplified form is ______.
qs.s: Inverting the expression gives \(\frac{x^2 + 7x + 12}{x^2 - 16} = \frac{(x + 3)(x + 4)}{(x - 4)(x + 4)}\), which reduces to \(\frac{x + 3}{x - 4}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: If \(\frac{2x - 6}{x^2 - 25} \cdot P = 1\), then the rational expression \(P\) in factored form is ______.
qs.s: Because their product is \(1\), \(P\) is the reciprocal of the given expression: \(\frac{x^2 - 25}{2x - 6} = \frac{(x - 5)(x + 5)}{2(x - 3)}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: In the division \(\frac{3x}{x + 2} \div \frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 2x}\), the reciprocal of the divisor in factored form is ______.
qs.s: The divisor is \(\frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 2x}\), so its reciprocal is \(\frac{x^2 + 2x}{x^2 - 9} = \frac{x(x + 2)}{(x - 3)(x + 3)}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: According to the rule for multiplying rational expressions, \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{c}{d} = \underline{\quad}\), where \(b \neq 0\) and \(d \neq 0\).
qs.s: To multiply two rational expressions, multiply their numerators together and multiply their denominators together: \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{c}{d} = \frac{a \cdot c}{b \cdot d}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The reciprocal of the rational expression \(\frac{x - 4}{x + 7}\) is ______.
qs.s: The reciprocal of a rational expression is formed by interchanging its numerator and denominator, giving \(\frac{x + 7}{x - 4}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: To divide one rational expression by another, multiply the first expression by the ______ of the second expression.
qs.s: By definition, dividing by a rational expression is equivalent to multiplying the first expression by the reciprocal of the second expression.

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: The product of any non-zero rational expression and its reciprocal is always equal to ______.
qs.s: For any non-zero rational expression \(\frac{P}{Q}\), multiplying by its reciprocal gives \(\frac{P}{Q} \cdot \frac{Q}{P} = 1\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: When dividing rational expressions, the division \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\) is converted to the multiplication \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: Dividing by a rational expression is performed by multiplying by its reciprocal, which inverts \(\frac{c}{d}\) to \(\frac{d}{c}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: Written as a single rational expression, \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} \div \frac{e}{f} = \underline{\quad}\), assuming all denominators are non-zero.
qs.s: Working from left to right, dividing by \(\frac{c}{d}\) multiplies by \(\frac{d}{c}\), and dividing by \(\frac{e}{f}\) multiplies by \(\frac{f}{e}\), yielding \(\frac{a \cdot d \cdot f}{b \cdot c \cdot e}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: For the division \(\frac{x + 1}{x - 4} \div \frac{x - 3}{x + 6}\) to be defined, the three values of \(x\) that are restricted are \(x = 4\), \(x = -6\), and \(x = \underline{\quad}\).
qs.s: A division \(\frac{A}{B} \div \frac{C}{D}\) is undefined when \(B = 0\), \(D = 0\), or \(C = 0\); setting the divisor's numerator \(x - 3 = 0\) gives the restriction \(x = 3\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: Written as a single rational expression, \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} \cdot \frac{e}{f} = \underline{\quad}\), assuming all denominators are non-zero.
qs.s: Working from left to right, first invert the divisor \(\frac{c}{d}\) to multiply by \(\frac{d}{c}\), giving \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d}{c} \cdot \frac{e}{f} = \frac{a \cdot d \cdot e}{b \cdot c \cdot f}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: For any non-zero polynomials \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\), the division \(A \div \frac{B}{C}\) expressed as a single fraction is ______.
qs.s: Dividing by the rational expression \(\frac{B}{C}\) is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal \(\frac{C}{B}\), which gives \(A \cdot \frac{C}{B} = \frac{A \cdot C}{B}\).

qs.q: Fill in the blank to make the statement true: In the product \(\frac{x - 5}{y} \cdot \frac{y^2}{5 - x}\), the factor \((x - 5)\) divided by \((5 - x)\) simplifies to ______ (assuming \(x \neq 5\) and \(y \neq 0\)).
qs.s: Because \((5 - x) = -(x - 5)\), dividing the opposite factors gives \(\frac{x - 5}{-(x - 5)} = -1\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

According to the rule for dividing rational expressions, \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: Dividing by a rational expression is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal, so \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d}{c}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

For any non-zero rational expression \(\frac{P}{Q}\), its reciprocal is ______.
qs.s: The reciprocal of a non-zero rational expression \(\frac{P}{Q}\) is found by interchanging its numerator and denominator, yielding \(\frac{Q}{P}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

In the division of rational expressions \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\), the first expression \(\frac{a}{b}\) is called the ______.
qs.s: In any division problem, the quantity being divided is the dividend, while the quantity divided by is the divisor.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

The result obtained from dividing one rational expression by another is called the ______.
qs.s: In mathematics, the result of a division operation is defined as the quotient.

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

When dividing two rational expressions \(\frac{A}{B} \div \frac{C}{D}\), non-permissible values for the variable arise when \(B = 0\), \(D = 0\), or ______ \(= 0\).
qs.s: Because \(\frac{A}{B} \div \frac{C}{D} = \frac{A}{B} \cdot \frac{D}{C}\), the term \(C\) ends up in the denominator of the product, meaning \(C\) cannot equal \(0\) in addition to \(B \neq 0\) and \(D \neq 0\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

To divide the rational expressions \(\frac{x + 5}{x - 2} \div \frac{x^2 - 25}{x^2 - 4}\), the operation is rewritten as the product \(\frac{x + 5}{x - 2} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: To divide by a rational expression, multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor, which inverts \(\frac{x^2 - 25}{x^2 - 4}\) to \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x^2 - 25}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

Evaluating from left to right, the chain division \(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d} \div \frac{e}{f}\) can be rewritten as the single multiplication \(\frac{a}{b} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: Working from left to right, \(\left(\frac{a}{b} \div \frac{c}{d}\right) \div \frac{e}{f} = \left(\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d}{c}\right) \cdot \frac{f}{e} = \frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d \cdot f}{c \cdot e}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

To divide the rational expression \(\frac{3x - 1}{x + 4}\) by the polynomial \((x^2 - 9)\), the problem is rewritten as the product \(\frac{3x - 1}{x + 4} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: Any polynomial expression can be written with a denominator of \(1\), so the reciprocal of \((x^2 - 9)\) is \(\frac{1}{x^2 - 9}\).

qs.q:
Fill in the blank to make the statement true.

To divide the rational expression \(\frac{2x}{x - 1}\) by the unit fraction \(\frac{1}{x^2 + 5x + 6}\), the problem is rewritten as the product \(\frac{2x}{x - 1} \cdot\) ______.
qs.s: The reciprocal of the unit fraction \(\frac{1}{x^2 + 5x + 6}\) is \(\frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{1} = x^2 + 5x + 6\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{25a^2}{12} \cdot \frac{4}{15a}\)
qs.s: Simplify the coefficients and variables: \(\frac{25}{15} = \frac{5}{3}\), \(\frac{4}{12} = \frac{1}{3}\), and \(\frac{a^2}{a} = a\), which gives \(\frac{5a}{9}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{12y^2}{35} \cdot \frac{7}{6y}\)
qs.s: Divide out common factors between the numerators and denominators: \(\frac{12}{6} = 2\), \(\frac{7}{35} = \frac{1}{5}\), and \(\frac{y^2}{y} = y\), giving \(\frac{2y}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{18p^2}{25} \cdot \frac{5}{6p}\)
qs.s: Divide by common factors: \(\frac{18}{6} = 3\), \(\frac{5}{25} = \frac{1}{5}\), and \(\frac{p^2}{p} = p\), leaving \(\frac{3p}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{14x^2}{15} \cdot \frac{5}{7x}\)
qs.s: Multiply the numerators and denominators and cancel common factors: \(\frac{14}{7} = 2\), \(\frac{5}{15} = \frac{1}{3}\), and \(\frac{x^2}{x} = x\), resulting in \(\frac{2x}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 4} \cdot \frac{x + 2}{2x - 1}\)
qs.s: Factor \(2x^2 + 5x - 3\) into \((2x - 1)(x + 3)\) and \(x^2 - 4\) into \((x - 2)(x + 2)\), then cancel the common factors \((2x - 1)\) and \((x + 2)\) to obtain \(\frac{x + 3}{x - 2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 4x}{10} \cdot \frac{15}{2x - 8}\)
qs.s: Factor out common factors to write the product as \(\frac{x(x - 4)}{10} \cdot \frac{15}{2(x - 4)}\), cancel the common binomial \((x - 4)\), and simplify \(\frac{15x}{20}\) to \(\frac{3x}{4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{x^2 - 4} \cdot \frac{x - 2}{x + 1}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to get \(\frac{(x + 2)(x + 3)}{(x - 2)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{x - 2}{x + 1}\), then cancel the common factors \((x + 2)\) and \((x - 2)\) to leave \(\frac{x + 3}{x + 1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 9}{4x^2} \cdot \frac{8x}{x + 3}\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares as \((x - 3)(x + 3)\), then cancel the common factor \((x + 3)\) and simplify \(\frac{8x}{4x^2} = \frac{2}{x}\) to obtain \(\frac{2(x - 3)}{x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 25}{2x - 6} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 3x}{5 - x}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to get \(\frac{(x - 5)(x + 5)}{2(x - 3)} \cdot \frac{x(x - 3)}{-(x - 5)}\), cancel \((x - 3)\) and \((x - 5)\), and apply the negative sign to obtain \(-\frac{x(x + 5)}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{10(p+2)}{3q} \cdot \frac{6q}{4(p+2)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply to get \(\frac{60q(p+2)}{12q(p+2)^2}\), then cancel the common factor \(12q(p+2)\) to leave \(\frac{5}{p+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{15(x-5)^2}{4y} \cdot \frac{2y}{5(x-5)}\)
qs.s: Multiply across to obtain \(\frac{30y(x-5)^2}{20y(x-5)}\). Dividing out common factors of \(10\), \(y\), and \((x-5)\) yields \(\frac{3(x-5)}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{14(x+4)}{3y^2} \cdot \frac{9y^2}{7(x+4)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply across to get \(\frac{126y^2(x+4)}{21y^2(x+4)^2}\). Cancel \(21y^2(x+4)\) from the numerator and denominator to arrive at \(\frac{6}{x+4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{6(a+3)}{b} \cdot \frac{5b}{10(a+3)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{30b(a+3)}{10b(a+3)^2}\). Canceling the common factors \(10\), \(b\), and \((a+3)\) gives \(\frac{3}{a+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{4m}{9(n+1)} \cdot \frac{3(n+1)^2}{8m}\)
qs.s: Multiply the expressions to obtain \(\frac{12m(n+1)^2}{72m(n+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \(12\), \(m\), and \((n+1)\) leaves \(\frac{n+1}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 25}{5 - x} \cdot \frac{3x}{x^2 + 8x + 15}\)

Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x+1}{x-2} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 4}{x^2 + 2x + 1} \cdot \frac{x^2 + x}{x + 2}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{x+1}{x-2} \cdot \frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+1)^2} \cdot \frac{x(x+1)}{x+2}\). Canceling \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and both factors of \((x+1)\) leaves only \(x\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 16}{2x} \cdot \frac{6x^2}{3x - 12}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - 16\) as \((x-4)(x+4)\) and \(3x - 12\) as \(3(x-4)\) to get \(\frac{(x-4)(x+4)}{2x} \cdot \frac{6x^2}{3(x-4)}\). Canceling common factors \(6x\) and \((x-4)\) simplifies the product to \(x(x+4)\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 9} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 3x}{4x^2 - 1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to obtain \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x(x-3)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-1)\), \((x+3)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{x}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{x^2 - 4} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 2x}{x^2 + 7x + 12}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x(x-2)}{(x+3)(x+4)}\). Canceling common factors \((x+2)\), \((x-2)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x}{x+4}\).

qs.q:

\(\frac{4}{5x+20} \cdot \frac{x+4}{8}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(5x + 20 = 5(x + 4)\) and cancel the common factor \((x + 4)\). Then simplify \(\frac{4}{5 \cdot 8} = \frac{4}{40} = \frac{1}{10}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2}{3x-12} \cdot \frac{x-4}{8}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(3x - 12 = 3(x - 4)\) and cancel the common factor \((x - 4)\). Then simplify \(\frac{2}{3 \cdot 8} = \frac{2}{24} = \frac{1}{12}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x-2}{12} \cdot \frac{4}{3x-6}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(3x - 6 = 3(x - 2)\) and cancel the common factor \((x - 2)\). Then simplify \(\frac{4}{12 \cdot 3} = \frac{4}{36} = \frac{1}{9}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{7}{4x+28} \cdot \frac{x+7}{14}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(4x + 28 = 4(x + 7)\) and cancel the common factor \((x + 7)\). Then simplify \(\frac{7}{4 \cdot 14} = \frac{7}{56} = \frac{1}{8}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{5}{3x-15} \cdot \frac{x-5}{10}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(3x - 15 = 3(x - 5)\) and divide out the common factor \((x - 5)\). Then simplify \(\frac{5}{3 \cdot 10} = \frac{5}{30} = \frac{1}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-x-12}{2x+6} \cdot \frac{8}{4-x}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to get \(\frac{(x-4)(x+3)}{2(x+3)} \cdot \frac{8}{-(x-4)}\). Cancel \((x+3)\) and \((x-4)\) to get \(\frac{8}{-2} = -4\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-16}{3x-6} \cdot \frac{6x-12}{x+4}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-4)(x+4)}{3(x-2)} \cdot \frac{6(x-2)}{x+4}\). Canceling common factors \((x+4)\) and \((x-2)\), and simplifying \(\frac{6}{3} = 2\), gives \(2(x-4)\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{x-3}{2x^2-x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x-3}{x(2x-1)}\). Canceling common factors \((2x-1)\), \((x+3)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2+5x+6}{x^2-4} \cdot \frac{x^2-2x}{x^2+4x+3}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x(x-2)}{(x+1)(x+3)}\). Canceling \((x+2)\), \((x-2)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-9y^2}{2x+4y} \cdot \frac{x^2+2xy}{x^2+3xy}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(x-3y)(x+3y)}{2(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{x(x+2y)}{x(x+3y)}\). Canceling \((x+3y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \(x\) leaves \(\frac{x-3y}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{10x+15}{3x-12} \cdot \frac{6x-24}{4x+6}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{5(2x+3)}{3(x-4)} \cdot \frac{6(x-4)}{2(2x+3)}\). Canceling \((2x+3)\) and \((x-4)\) leaves \(\frac{5 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2} = \frac{30}{6} = 5\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{9x+18}{8x-32} \cdot \frac{2x-8}{3x+6}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{9(x+2)}{8(x-4)} \cdot \frac{2(x-4)}{3(x+2)}\). Canceling \((x+2)\) and \((x-4)\) leaves \(\frac{9 \cdot 2}{8 \cdot 3} = \frac{18}{24} = \frac{3}{4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{12x-16}{2x+10} \cdot \frac{5x+25}{9x-12}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{4(3x-4)}{2(x+5)} \cdot \frac{5(x+5)}{3(3x-4)}\). Canceling \((3x-4)\) and \((x+5)\) leaves \(\frac{4 \cdot 5}{2 \cdot 3} = \frac{20}{6} = \frac{10}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{6x-12}{4x+20} \cdot \frac{2x+10}{9x-18}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{6(x-2)}{4(x+5)} \cdot \frac{2(x+5)}{9(x-2)}\). Canceling common binomial factors \((x-2)\) and \((x+5)\) gives \(\frac{6 \cdot 2}{4 \cdot 9} = \frac{12}{36} = \frac{1}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{14x-21}{5x+10} \cdot \frac{15x+30}{4x-6}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{7(2x-3)}{5(x+2)} \cdot \frac{15(x+2)}{2(2x-3)}\). Canceling \((2x-3)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{7 \cdot 15}{5 \cdot 2} = \frac{21}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-9}{x^2+5x+6} \cdot \frac{2x+4}{3-x}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{2(x+2)}{-(x-3)}\). Canceling \((x+3)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{2}{-1} = -2\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2-4} \cdot \frac{x-2}{2x-1}\)
qs.s: Factor the quadratic expressions: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x-2}{2x-1}\). Canceling common factors \((2x-1)\) and \((x-2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2-8}{x^2-4x+4} \cdot \frac{x^2-2x}{4x+8}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{2(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-2)^2} \cdot \frac{x(x-2)}{4(x+2)}\). Canceling \((x-2)^2\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{2x}{4} = \frac{x}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-25}{x+3} \cdot \frac{x^2-9}{x^2+5x} \cdot \frac{x}{x-5}\)
qs.s: Factor all expressions: \(\frac{(x-5)(x+5)}{x+3} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{x(x+5)} \cdot \frac{x}{x-5}\). Canceling common factors \((x-5)\), \((x+5)\), \((x+3)\), and \(x\) leaves \(x-3\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-4}{x^2+3x+2} \cdot \frac{x^2+5x+4}{x^2-x-2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+1)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+1)(x+4)}{(x-2)(x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and one factor of \((x+1)\) leaves \(\frac{x+4}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{y-3}{10} \cdot \frac{15}{3-y}\)
qs.s: Factor \(-1\) from the denominator so that \(3-y = -(y-3)\). Canceling the common factor \((y-3)\) and reducing \(-\frac{15}{10}\) yields \(-\frac{3}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{m-4}{9} \cdot \frac{12}{4-m}\)
qs.s: Factor \(-1\) from \(4-m\) to obtain \(-(m-4)\). Canceling the common binomial factor \((m-4)\) and simplifying \(-\frac{12}{9}\) gives \(-\frac{4}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3-2x}{6} \cdot \frac{4}{2x-3}\)
qs.s: Factor \(-1\) from \(2x-3\) to get \(-(3-2x)\). Canceling \((3-2x)\) and reducing \(-\frac{4}{6}\) results in \(-\frac{2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{15}{8-t} \cdot \frac{t-8}{20}\)
qs.s: Express \(8-t\) as \(-(t-8)\) and cancel \((t-8)\) from the numerator and denominator. Reducing \(-\frac{15}{20}\) gives \(-\frac{3}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4}{7-a} \cdot \frac{a-7}{14}\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(7-a\) as \(-(a-7)\) and cancel the common factor \((a-7)\). Simplifying \(-\frac{4}{14}\) gives \(-\frac{2}{7}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2-8}{x^2+5x+6} \cdot \frac{3x+9}{4-2x}\)
qs.s: Factor all expressions: \(\frac{2(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{3(x+3)}{-2(x-2)}\). Canceling all common binomial factors leaves \(\frac{6}{-2} = -3\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x-5}{2x+4} \cdot \frac{x^2-4}{25-x^2} \cdot \frac{6x}{x-2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial completely: \(2x+4 = 2(x+2)\), \(x^2-4 = (x-2)(x+2)\), and \(25-x^2 = -(x-5)(x+5)\). Canceling the common factors \((x-5)\), \((x-2)\), and \((x+2)\) and reducing \(\frac{6x}{-2(x+5)}\) yields \(-\frac{3x}{x+5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2-5x-3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{3-x}{2x+1}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to obtain \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{-(x-3)}{2x+1}\). Canceling common factors \((2x+1)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(-\frac{x-3}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x-4}{x^2-x-6} \cdot \frac{x^2-9}{16-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(x^2-x-6 = (x-3)(x+2)\), \(x^2-9 = (x-3)(x+3)\), and \(16-x^2 = -(x-4)(x+4)\). Cancel the common factors \((x-4)\) and \((x-3)\) to obtain \(-\frac{x+3}{(x+2)(x+4)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-9}{5x} \cdot \frac{10}{3-x}\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares \(x^2-9 = (x-3)(x+3)\) and rewrite \(3-x\) as \(-(x-3)\). Cancel \((x-3)\) and simplify \(\frac{10}{-5x}\) to get \(-\frac{2(x+3)}{x}\).

\(\frac{x^2-4x}{x^2-2x-8} \cdot \frac{x^2+3x+2}{2x-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials to get \(\frac{x(x-4)}{(x-4)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+1)}{x(2-x)}\). Canceling common factors \(x\), \((x-4)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+1}{2-x}\).

\(\frac{16-x^2}{6x+12} \cdot \frac{9x+18}{2x-8}\)

Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3x^2-12}{x^2+5x+6} \cdot \frac{x^2-9}{6-3x}\)
qs.s: Factor to obtain \(\frac{3(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{-3(x-2)}\). Canceling common factors leaves \(\frac{3(x-3)}{-3} = -(x-3) = 3-x\).

qs.q:

\(\frac{2x^2-5x-3}{4x^2-1} \cdot \frac{2x-1}{9-x^2}\)

Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2m - 5n}{14} \cdot \frac{7}{5n - 2m}\)
qs.s: Since \(5n - 2m = -(2m - 5n)\), the opposite binomials cancel leaving a factor of \(-1\). Multiplying by \(\frac{7}{14}\) yields \(-\frac{1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4u - 3v}{9} \cdot \frac{6}{3v - 4u}\)
qs.s: Since \(3v - 4u = -(4u - 3v)\), canceling the opposite binomials leaves \(-1\). Multiplying gives \(\frac{6(-1)}{9} = -\frac{2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{12}{7 - 2x} \cdot \frac{2x - 7}{16}\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(2x - 7\) as \(-(7 - 2x)\). Canceling the binomials leaves \(-1\), giving \(\frac{12(-1)}{16} = -\frac{3}{4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3a - b}{8} \cdot \frac{2}{b - 3a}\)
qs.s: Factor \(-1\) from the denominator to write \(b - 3a = -(3a - b)\). Canceling \((3a - b)\) and simplifying \(\frac{2}{-8}\) gives \(-\frac{1}{4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{5}{4x - y} \cdot \frac{y - 4x}{15}\)
qs.s: Rewrite \(y - 4x\) as \(-(4x - y)\). The common binomial factor cancels to leave \(-1\), giving \(\frac{5(-1)}{15} = -\frac{1}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2 - 7x + 3}{5x^2 - 45} \cdot \frac{x + 3}{1 - 2x}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x-3)}{5(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x+3}{-(2x-1)}\). Canceling all binomial factors leaves \(\frac{1}{-5} = -\frac{1}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 4x}{x^2 - 2x - 8} \cdot \frac{x^2 - x - 6}{3x - x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all terms to get \(\frac{x(x-4)}{(x-4)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{-x(x-3)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \((x-4)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{-1} = -1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - y^2}{2x + 4} \cdot \frac{x + 2}{y - x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - y^2 = (x-y)(x+y)\) and \(2x+4 = 2(x+2)\), then rewrite \(y-x = -(x-y)\). Canceling \((x-y)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(-\frac{x+y}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2 - 4b^2}{3a + 9b} \cdot \frac{a + 3b}{2b - a}\)
qs.s: Factor \(a^2 - 4b^2 = (a-2b)(a+2b)\) and \(3a+9b = 3(a+3b)\), and rewrite \(2b-a = -(a-2b)\). Canceling \((a-2b)\) and \((a+3b)\) results in \(-\frac{a+2b}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 25}{x^2 + 3x - 10} \cdot \frac{6 - 3x}{x - 5}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-5)(x+5)}{(x+5)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{-3(x-2)}{x-5}\). Canceling \((x-5)\), \((x+5)\), and \((x-2)\) leaves \(-3\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{35}{7x - 3y} \cdot \frac{3y - 7x}{42}\)
qs.s: Notice that \(\frac{3y - 7x}{7x - 3y} = -1\). Multiplying by \(\frac{35}{42} = \frac{5}{6}\) gives \(-\frac{5}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{14}{2a - 5b} \cdot \frac{5b - 2a}{21}\)
qs.s: Since \(5b - 2a = -(2a - 5b)\), the binomials cancel to leave \(-1\). Multiplying by \(\frac{14}{21} = \frac{2}{3}\) yields \(-\frac{2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4m - n}{30} \cdot \frac{18}{n - 4m}\)
qs.s: Since \(4m - n = -(n - 4m)\), the binomials divide to give \(-1\). Simplifying \(\frac{18}{30} \cdot (-1)\) yields \(-\frac{3}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{20}{3x - 4y} \cdot \frac{4y - 3x}{25}\)
qs.s: The factor \(4y - 3x\) equals \(-(3x - 4y)\), so the binomial factors cancel to \(-1\). Reducing \(\frac{20}{25}\) to \(\frac{4}{5}\) gives \(-\frac{4}{5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{27}{5u - 2v} \cdot \frac{2v - 5u}{18}\)
qs.s: Factoring out \(-1\) gives \(2v - 5u = -(5u - 2v)\), so the binomials cancel to \(-1\). Then \(\frac{27}{18} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{3}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2 - 7x + 3}{x^2 - 9} \cdot \frac{x + 3}{1 - 2x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(2x^2 - 7x + 3 = (2x - 1)(x - 3)\) and \(x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3)\). Since \(1 - 2x = -(2x - 1)\), all factors cancel out to leave \(-1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x^2 + 4x + 3} \cdot \frac{x + 3}{2 - x}\)

Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 4y^2}{x^2 - 3xy + 2y^2} \cdot \frac{y - x}{3x^2 + 6xy}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(x - 2y)(x + 2y)}{(x - y)(x - 2y)} \cdot \frac{-(x - y)}{3x(x + 2y)}\). Canceling \((x - 2y)\), \((x + 2y)\), and \((x - y)\) leaves \(-\frac{1}{3x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2 - 25}{3a + 9} \cdot \frac{6}{5 - a}\)
qs.s: Factor \(a^2 - 25 = (a - 5)(a + 5)\), \(3a + 9 = 3(a + 3)\), and rewrite \(5 - a = -(a - 5)\). Canceling \((a - 5)\) and reducing \(\frac{6}{3}\) leaves \(-\frac{2(a + 5)}{a + 3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 9}{2x + 10} \cdot \frac{x^2 + 5x}{x^2 - 4x + 3} \cdot \frac{4 - 4x}{x^2 + 3x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely to get \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{2(x+5)} \cdot \frac{x(x+5)}{(x-3)(x-1)} \cdot \frac{-4(x-1)}{x(x+3)}\). All variable factors cancel, leaving \(\frac{-4}{2} = -2\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{4(a^2 - 16)}{21(a + 4)} \cdot \frac{7a}{6(a - 4)}\)
qs.s: Factor \(a^2 - 16\) as \((a - 4)(a + 4)\) and cancel common binomial factors \((a - 4)\) and \((a + 4)\). Reducing \(\frac{4 \cdot 7a}{21 \cdot 6} = \frac{28a}{126}\) results in \(\frac{2a}{9}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{11(x^2 - 64)}{16(x + 8)} \cdot \frac{8x}{33(x - 8)}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - 64\) into \((x - 8)(x + 8)\) and cancel \((x - 8)\) and \((x + 8)\) with the denominators. Reducing the remaining fraction \(\frac{11 \cdot 8x}{16 \cdot 33}\) gives \(\frac{x}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{7(y^2 - 1)}{20(y - 1)} \cdot \frac{15y}{14(y + 1)}\)
qs.s: Factor \(y^2 - 1\) as \((y - 1)(y + 1)\) and divide out the common factors \((y - 1)\) and \((y + 1)\). Simplify the fraction \(\frac{7 \cdot 15y}{20 \cdot 14} = \frac{3y}{8}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2(x^2 - 25)}{15(x + 5)} \cdot \frac{25x^2}{4(x - 5)}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - 25\) as \((x - 5)(x + 5)\) and cancel the common factors \((x - 5)\) and \((x + 5)\). Reduce the remaining numerical coefficients \(\frac{2 \cdot 25}{15 \cdot 4} = \frac{5}{6}\) to obtain \(\frac{5x^2}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5(x^2 - 9)}{18(x - 3)} \cdot \frac{6x}{7(x + 3)}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - 9\) as \((x - 3)(x + 3)\), then cancel the common binomial factors \((x - 3)\) and \((x + 3)\). Simplify the numerical coefficients \(\frac{5 \cdot 6}{18 \cdot 7} = \frac{5}{21}\) to get \(\frac{5x}{21}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 16}{x^2 - 2x - 3} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 4x} \cdot \frac{2x}{x - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor all terms: \(\frac{(x-4)(x+4)}{(x-3)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{x(x+4)} \cdot \frac{2x}{x-4}\). Canceling common factors \((x-4)\), \((x+4)\), \((x-3)\), and \(x\) yields \(\frac{2(x+3)}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 4}{3 - x}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{-(x-3)}\). Dividing out common factors leaves \(\frac{x-2}{-1} = 2 - x\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - x - 6}{2x^2 + 8x} \cdot \frac{x^2 + 4x}{x^2 - 9}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{2x(x+4)} \cdot \frac{x(x+4)}{(x-3)(x+3)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-3)\), \(x\), and \((x+4)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{2(x+3)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 4} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 2x}{2x^2 - x}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x(x-2)}{x(2x-1)}\). Canceling common factors \((2x-1)\), \((x-2)\), and \(x\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 - 4y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2 + xy - 6y^2}{x^2 + 4xy + 3y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(x-2y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(x+3y)(x-2y)}{(x+y)(x+3y)}\). Dividing out common factors \((x+y)\), \((x-2y)\), and \((x+3y)\) gives \(\frac{x-y}{x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-5x+6}{x+4} \cdot \frac{5x+20}{3x-9}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(x-2)(x-3)}{x+4} \cdot \frac{5(x+4)}{3(x-3)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+4)\) and \((x-3)\) results in \(\frac{5(x-2)}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+3x-4}{x-2} \cdot \frac{2x-4}{4x+16}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{(x+4)(x-1)}{x-2} \cdot \frac{2(x-2)}{4(x+4)}\). Canceling common factors \((x+4)\) and \((x-2)\), and reducing \(\frac{2}{4}\), leaves \(\frac{x-1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2x-8}{3x-15} \cdot \frac{x-5}{2x-8}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(x-4)(x+2)}{3(x-5)} \cdot \frac{x-5}{2(x-4)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-4)\) and \((x-5)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+6x+8}{x+1} \cdot \frac{4x+4}{3x+12}\)
qs.s: Factoring the expressions gives \(\frac{(x+2)(x+4)}{x+1} \cdot \frac{4(x+1)}{3(x+4)}\). Canceling \((x+1)\) and \((x+4)\) leaves \(\frac{4(x+2)}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x+10}{x-1} \cdot \frac{x^2-4x+3}{6x+30}\)
qs.s: Factoring each polynomial yields \(\frac{2(x+5)}{x-1} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x-3)}{6(x+5)}\). Canceling \((x+5)\) and \((x-1)\) and simplifying \(\frac{2}{6}\) gives \(\frac{x-3}{3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-5x-3}{9-x^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+3x}{2x+1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial, noting that \(9-x^2 = -(x-3)(x+3)\), giving \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{-(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x(x+3)}{2x+1}\). Canceling common factors leaves \(\frac{x}{-1} = -x\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4y^2}{2x^2+xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{2x+3y}{x+2y}\)
qs.s: Factoring the expressions yields \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(2x+3y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{2x+3y}{x+2y}\). Canceling the common binomials \((x+2y)\) and \((2x+3y)\) leaves \(\frac{x-2y}{x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-16}{x^2-x-12} \cdot \frac{x^2+2x-3}{x^2+5x+4}\)
qs.s: Factor all four quadratics: \(\frac{(x-4)(x+4)}{(x-4)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+3)(x-1)}{(x+4)(x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-4)\), \((x+4)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x-1}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+2x} \cdot \frac{x^2-4}{x^2-x-2} \cdot \frac{3x}{x-1}\)
qs.s: Factoring all expressions gives \(\frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{x(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-2)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{3x}{x-1}\). Canceling all common binomial factors and the variable \(x\) leaves \(3\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{3x+9}{4x-2}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{3(x+3)}{2(2x-1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-1)\) and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{3(x+3)}{2(x-3)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2x-15}{x^2-8x+15} \cdot \frac{x-2}{x+3}\)
qs.s: Factor the first fraction to \(\frac{(x-5)(x+3)}{(x-5)(x-3)}\). Canceling \((x-5)\) and \((x+3)\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{x-2}{x-3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-x-6}{x^2-5x+6} \cdot \frac{x-1}{x+2}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to get \(\frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{(x-3)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{x-1}{x+2}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-3)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x-1}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+3x-10}{x^2-4x+4} \cdot \frac{x+6}{x+5}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions into \(\frac{(x+5)(x-2)}{(x-2)^2} \cdot \frac{x+6}{x+5}\). Canceling \((x+5)\) and one factor of \((x-2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+6}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-9x+14}{x^2-4x-21} \cdot \frac{x-1}{x-2}\)
qs.s: Factoring yields \(\frac{(x-7)(x-2)}{(x-7)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x-1}{x-2}\). Canceling \((x-7)\) and \((x-2)\) results in \(\frac{x-1}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+2x-8}{x^2+7x+12} \cdot \frac{x+5}{x-2}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to obtain \(\frac{(x+4)(x-2)}{(x+4)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x+5}{x-2}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+4)\) and \((x-2)\) gives \(\frac{x+5}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-1}{x^2-4} \cdot \frac{x^2+5x+6}{x^2+2x+1} \cdot \frac{x-2}{x^2+2x-3}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator: \(\frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x+1)^2} \cdot \frac{x-2}{(x+3)(x-1)}\). Canceling all common factors leaves \(\frac{1}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2x-8}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{3-x}{x-4}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to get \(\frac{(x-4)(x+2)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{-(x-3)}{x-4}\). Canceling \((x-4)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(-\frac{x+2}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2-4} \cdot \frac{x^2-2x}{2x^2-x}\)
qs.s: Factor each term: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x(x-2)}{x(2x-1)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \((2x-1)\), and \((x-2)\) gives \(\frac{x+3}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-x-12}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{x^2+5x+6}{x^2-2x-8}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators: \(\frac{(x-4)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x-4)(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-4)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{x-3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume the denominator does not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+7x+3}{2x^2-x-1} \cdot \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+6x+9}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(2x+1)(x+3)}{(2x+1)(x-1)} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{(x+3)^2}\). Canceling \((2x+1)\), \((x-1)\), and one factor of \((x+3)\) yields \(\frac{x+1}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{p^2+4p+3}{p^2-2p-15} \cdot \frac{p-5}{p-1}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to obtain \(\frac{(p+1)(p+3)}{(p-5)(p+3)} \cdot \frac{p-5}{p-1}\). Dividing out the common factors \((p+3)\) and \((p-5)\) leaves \(\frac{p+1}{p-1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{a^2-a-6}{a^2+7a+12} \cdot \frac{a+3}{a-3}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{(a-3)(a+2)}{(a+3)(a+4)} \cdot \frac{a+3}{a-3}\). Canceling the common factors \((a-3)\) and \((a+3)\) gives \(\frac{a+2}{a+4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{m^2-4m-5}{m^2-9} \cdot \frac{m-3}{m+1}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to get \(\frac{(m-5)(m+1)}{(m-3)(m+3)} \cdot \frac{m-3}{m+1}\). Canceling the common factors \((m+1)\) and \((m-3)\) yields \(\frac{m-5}{m+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{x^2+5x+6}{x^2-5x+6} \cdot \frac{x-3}{x+2}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to obtain \(\frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x-3)} \cdot \frac{x-3}{x+2}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+2)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{t^2-7t+12}{t^2-t-6} \cdot \frac{t+2}{t+1}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic expression to get \(\frac{(t-3)(t-4)}{(t-3)(t+2)} \cdot \frac{t+2}{t+1}\). Canceling the common factors \((t-3)\) and \((t+2)\) results in \(\frac{t-4}{t+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{3x^2-10x-8}{2x^2-7x-4} \cdot \frac{2x^2+9x+4}{3x^2+8x+4}\)
qs.s: Factor each non-monic quadratic into \(\frac{(3x+2)(x-4)}{(2x+1)(x-4)} \cdot \frac{(2x+1)(x+4)}{(3x+2)(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((3x+2)\), \((x-4)\), and \((2x+1)\) yields \(\frac{x+4}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{x^2-3xy+2y^2}{x^2-4y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+2xy}{x^2+xy}\)
qs.s: Factor the two-variable polynomials and common factors to get \(\frac{(x-y)(x-2y)}{(x-2y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{x(x+2y)}{x(x+y)}\). Canceling \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \(x\) leaves \(\frac{x-y}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{x^2-4}{x^2+3x-10} \cdot \frac{25-x^2}{x^2+7x+10}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial, writing \(25-x^2 = -(x-5)(x+5)\), to get \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-2)(x+5)} \cdot \frac{-(x-5)(x+5)}{(x+2)(x+5)}\). Canceling \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x+5)\) leaves \(-\frac{x-5}{x+5} = \frac{5-x}{x+5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{a^2-9}{a^2-a-6} \cdot \frac{a^2+4a+4}{2a+6} \cdot \frac{a-3}{a^2-4}\)
qs.s: Factor all terms to obtain \(\frac{(a-3)(a+3)}{(a-3)(a+2)} \cdot \frac{(a+2)^2}{2(a+3)} \cdot \frac{a-3}{(a-2)(a+2)}\). Canceling \((a-3)\), \((a+3)\), and \((a+2)^2\) leaves \(\frac{a-3}{2(a-2)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{x^2-2x-3}{2x^2-x}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial completely into \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+1)}{x(2x-1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-1)\), \((x+3)\), and \((x-3)\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{x+1}{x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2y^2+5y-3}{2y^2+7y+3} \cdot \frac{2y^2-7y-4}{4y^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor the polynomials to get \(\frac{(2y-1)(y+3)}{(2y+1)(y+3)} \cdot \frac{(2y+1)(y-4)}{(2y-1)(2y+1)}\). Canceling common factors \((2y-1)\), \((y+3)\), and \((2y+1)\) leaves \(\frac{y-4}{2y+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3a^2-a-2}{3a^2+5a+2} \cdot \frac{a^2+3a+2}{a^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factoring each expression gives \(\frac{(3a+2)(a-1)}{(3a+2)(a+1)} \cdot \frac{(a+1)(a+2)}{(a-1)(a+1)}\). Canceling common factors \((3a+2)\), \((a-1)\), and \((a+1)\) results in \(\frac{a+2}{a+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2k^2+k-1}{2k^2-5k+2} \cdot \frac{k^2-4k+4}{k^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to obtain \(\frac{(2k-1)(k+1)}{(2k-1)(k-2)} \cdot \frac{(k-2)^2}{(k-1)(k+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2k-1)\), \((k+1)\), and \((k-2)\) yields \(\frac{k-2}{k-1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2p^2+5p+2}{2p^2-5p+3} \cdot \frac{2p^2+p-6}{4p^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(2p+1)(p+2)}{(2p-3)(p-1)} \cdot \frac{(2p-3)(p+2)}{(2p+1)(2p-1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2p+1)\) and \((2p-3)\) yields \(\frac{(p+2)^2}{(2p-1)(p-1)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^3-7x^2-3x}{4x^3-9x} \cdot \frac{2x^2+7x+6}{3x^2-5x-2}\)
qs.s: Factor out the common monomial \(x\) and factor the quadratics to obtain \(\frac{x(2x-3)(3x+1)}{x(2x-3)(2x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x+3)(x+2)}{(3x+1)(x-2)}\). Canceling \(x\), \((2x-3)\), \((3x+1)\), and \((2x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{ab-2a+3b-6}{2a^2+5a-3} \cdot \frac{4a^2-1}{b^2-4}\)
qs.s: Factor the first numerator by grouping and factor the remaining quadratics to get \(\frac{(a+3)(b-2)}{(2a-1)(a+3)} \cdot \frac{(2a-1)(2a+1)}{(b-2)(b+2)}\). Canceling \((a+3)\), \((b-2)\), and \((2a-1)\) gives \(\frac{2a+1}{b+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5xy+2y^2}{4x^2-y^2} \cdot \frac{6x-3y}{x^2+xy-2y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-y^2}{3x+6y}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(2x+y)(x+2y)}{(2x-y)(2x+y)} \cdot \frac{3(2x-y)}{(x+2y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{3(x+2y)}\). Canceling common factors across all terms simplifies to \(\frac{x+y}{x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4}{x^2+5x+6} \cdot \frac{3x+9}{2-x} \cdot \frac{x^2-x-12}{3x^2-12x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely, noting \(2 - x = -(x - 2)\), to get \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{3(x+3)}{-(x-2)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x+3)}{3x(x-4)}\). Canceling all common factors leaves \(-\frac{x+3}{x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-11x-10}{4x^2-25} \cdot \frac{2x^2+9x+10}{6x^2+7x+2} \cdot \frac{6x^2-x-2}{2x^2+3x-2}\)
qs.s: Factor all six quadratic expressions to get \(\frac{(3x+2)(2x-5)}{(2x-5)(2x+5)} \cdot \frac{(2x+5)(x+2)}{(3x+2)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{(2x+1)(3x-2)}{(2x-1)(x+2)}\). Canceling \((3x+2)\), \((2x-5)\), \((2x+5)\), \((2x+1)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{3x-2}{2x-1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2+8x}{20x^2-5x} \cdot \frac{8x^2+18x-5}{3x^2-5x-12}\)
qs.s: Factoring completely gives \(\frac{2x(3x+4)}{5x(4x-1)} \cdot \frac{(4x-1)(2x+5)}{(3x+4)(x-3)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \(3x+4\), and \(4x-1\) results in \(\frac{2(2x+5)}{5(x-3)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-5x}{6x^2+2x} \cdot \frac{9x^2-3x-2}{8x^2-14x-15}\)
qs.s: Factoring each numerator and denominator gives \(\frac{x(2x-5)}{2x(3x+1)} \cdot \frac{(3x+1)(3x-2)}{(2x-5)(4x+3)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \(2x-5\), and \(3x+1\) leaves \(\frac{3x-2}{2(4x+3)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5x^2-2x}{6x^2+9x} \cdot \frac{2x^2-5x-12}{15x^2-11x+2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{x(5x-2)}{3x(2x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x+3)(x-4)}{(5x-2)(3x-1)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \(5x-2\), and \(2x+3\) yields \(\frac{x-4}{3(3x-1)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-2x}{4x^2+8x} \cdot \frac{2x^2+7x+6}{3x^2+13x-10}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{x(3x-2)}{4x(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x+3)(x+2)}{(3x-2)(x+5)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \(3x-2\), and \(x+2\) leaves \(\frac{2x+3}{4(x+5)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+x}{3x^2-6x} \cdot \frac{4x^2-11x+6}{6x^2+7x+2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{x(2x+1)}{3x(x-2)} \cdot \frac{(4x-3)(x-2)}{(2x+1)(3x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\), \(2x+1\), and \(x-2\) gives \(\frac{4x-3}{3(3x+2)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4}{2x^2-5x+2} \cdot \frac{2x^2-x}{x^2+3x} \cdot \frac{x^2+5x+6}{x^2+6x+8}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(2x-1)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{x(2x-1)}{x(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(x+2)(x+4)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-2)\), \((2x-1)\), \(x\), \((x+3)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x+4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-7xy+3y^2}{x^2-9y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2+6xy}{y-2x}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(2x-y)(x-3y)}{(x-3y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{2x(x+3y)}{-(2x-y)}\). Canceling \((x-3y)\), \((x+3y)\), and \((2x-y)\) simplifies the product to \(\frac{2x}{-1} = -2x\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2+7xy-3y^2}{4x^2-9y^2} \cdot \frac{6x^2-7xy-3y^2}{9x^2-6xy+y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring completely gives \(\frac{(3x-y)(2x+3y)}{(2x-3y)(2x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(3x+y)(2x-3y)}{(3x-y)^2}\). Canceling \((2x+3y)\), \((2x-3y)\), and one factor of \((3x-y)\) leaves \(\frac{3x+y}{3x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-5x-3}{2x^2-7x+3} \cdot \frac{4x^2-1}{x^2+4x} \cdot \frac{x^2-16}{2x^2+5x+2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{(2x-1)(x-3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{x(x+4)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x+4)}{(2x+1)(x+2)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-3)\), \((2x-1)\), \((x+4)\), and one factor of \((2x+1)\) leaves \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-4)}{x(x+2)}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+2x-8}{4x^2-1} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2+x-6}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator: \(\frac{(x+4)(x-2)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x+3)(x-2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2)\), \((2x-1)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x+4}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:

\(\displaystyle \frac{w^2+w-6}{4w^2-49} \cdot \frac{2w^2-9w+7}{w^2+2w-3}\)

Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{p^2-2p-8}{9p^2-16} \cdot \frac{3p^2+11p-20}{p^2+p-20}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic expression: \(\frac{(p+2)(p-4)}{(3p-4)(3p+4)} \cdot \frac{(3p-4)(p+5)}{(p-4)(p+5)}\). Canceling \((p-4)\), \((3p-4)\), and \((p+5)\) results in \(\frac{p+2}{3p+4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+5x-6}{4x^2-25} \cdot \frac{2x^2-x-15}{x^2+3x-18}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(x-1)(x+6)}{(2x-5)(2x+5)} \cdot \frac{(2x+5)(x-3)}{(x+6)(x-3)}\). Canceling \((x+6)\), \((2x+5)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{x-1}{2x-5}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{m^2-8m+15}{9m^2-4} \cdot \frac{3m^2+5m+2}{m^2-4m-5}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators: \(\frac{(m-3)(m-5)}{(3m-2)(3m+2)} \cdot \frac{(3m+2)(m+1)}{(m-5)(m+1)}\). Canceling \((m-5)\), \((3m+2)\), and \((m+1)\) gives \(\frac{m-3}{3m-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-9}{2x^2+7x+3} \cdot \frac{2x^2-3x-2}{x^2-4} \cdot \frac{x^2+4x+4}{x^2-2x-3}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(2x+1)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x+1)(x-2)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)^2}{(x-3)(x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), \((2x+1)\), \((x-2)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5x^2-28x-12}{6x^2-37x+6} \cdot \frac{6x^2+23x-4}{5x^2+17x-12}\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomials: \(\frac{(5x+2)(x-6)}{(6x-1)(x-6)} \cdot \frac{(6x-1)(x+4)}{(5x-3)(x+4)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-6)\), \((6x-1)\), and \((x+4)\) leaves \(\frac{5x+2}{5x-3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-7x+3}{x^3-9x} \cdot \frac{x^2+3x}{1-2x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x-3)}{x(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x(x+3)}{-(2x-1)}\). Since \((1-2x) = -(2x-1)\), all common factors cancel leaving only \(-1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3+2x^2-9x-18}{2x^2+7x+6} \cdot \frac{4x^2-9}{x^2-9}\)
qs.s: Factor the first numerator by grouping as \((x^2-9)(x+2)\) and the other polynomials: \(\frac{(x^2-9)(x+2)}{(2x+3)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x-3)(2x+3)}{x^2-9}\). Canceling \((x^2-9)\), \((x+2)\), and \((2x+3)\) leaves \(2x-3\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-xy-2y^2}{4x^2-4xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5xy-12y^2}{3x^2+14xy+8y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each two-variable quadratic: \(\frac{(3x-2y)(2x+y)}{(2x-3y)(2x+y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-3y)(x+4y)}{(3x+2y)(x+4y)}\). Canceling \((2x+y)\), \((2x-3y)\), and \((x+4y)\) leaves \(\frac{3x-2y}{3x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2 + 7a + 10}{a^2 + 2a - 15} \cdot \frac{2a^2 - 5a - 3}{4a^2 - 1}\)
