qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(a+2)(a+5)}{(a+5)(a-3)} \cdot \frac{(2a+1)(a-3)}{(2a-1)(2a+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((a+5)\), \((a-3)\), and \((2a+1)\) leaves \(\frac{a+2}{2a-1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3w^2 + 10w + 8}{9w^2 - 16} \cdot \frac{3w^2 - w - 4}{w^2 + 4w + 4}\)
qs.s: Factoring each numerator and denominator yields \(\frac{(3w+4)(w+2)}{(3w-4)(3w+4)} \cdot \frac{(3w-4)(w+1)}{(w+2)(w+2)}\). Canceling \((3w+4)\), \((3w-4)\), and one \((w+2)\) leaves \(\frac{w+1}{w+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2y^2 - 7y + 3}{y^2 - 8y + 15} \cdot \frac{y^2 - 25}{4y^2 - 1}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator completely: \(\frac{(2y-1)(y-3)}{(y-3)(y-5)} \cdot \frac{(y-5)(y+5)}{(2y-1)(2y+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2y-1)\), \((y-3)\), and \((y-5)\) leaves \(\frac{y+5}{2y+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{m^2 - 4}{2m^2 + 7m + 6} \cdot \frac{2m^2 - m - 6}{m^2 - 5m + 6}\)
qs.s: Factoring all polynomials gives \(\frac{(m-2)(m+2)}{(2m+3)(m+2)} \cdot \frac{(2m+3)(m-2)}{(m-2)(m-3)}\). Canceling \((m+2)\), \((2m+3)\), and one \((m-2)\) leaves \(\frac{m-2}{m-3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - x - 12}{9x^2 - 1} \cdot \frac{3x^2 + 5x - 2}{x^2 - 2x - 8}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator: \(\frac{(x-4)(x+3)}{(3x-1)(3x+1)} \cdot \frac{(3x-1)(x+2)}{(x-4)(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-4)\), \((3x-1)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{3x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 4}{x^2 + 3x} \cdot \frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 - x - 2} \cdot \frac{x^2 + x}{x^2 - 5x + 6}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{x(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{x(x+1)}{(x-2)(x-3)}\). Canceling common factors \(x\), \((x+3)\), \((x+1)\), \((x-3)\), and one \((x-2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5xy + 2y^2}{4x^2 - y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2 - 3xy + y^2}{x^2 - 4y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor the two-variable polynomials: \(\frac{(2x+y)(x+2y)}{(2x-y)(2x+y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-y)(x-y)}{(x-2y)(x+2y)}\). Canceling \((2x+y)\), \((2x-y)\), and \((x+2y)\) leaves \(\frac{x-y}{x-2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2 - 7x - 5}{4x^2 - 1} \cdot \frac{10x^2 - 9x + 2}{15x^2 - 19x - 10}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic expression: \(\frac{(2x+1)(3x-5)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(5x-2)}{(3x-5)(5x+2)}\). Canceling \((2x+1)\), \((2x-1)\), and \((3x-5)\) yields \(\frac{5x-2}{5x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3 - 12x}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \cdot \frac{9 - x^2}{6x^2 - 12x}\)
qs.s: Factor out common monomials and note that \(9 - x^2 = -(x-3)(x+3)\): \(\frac{3x(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{-(x-3)(x+3)}{6x(x-2)}\). Canceling \(3x\), \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{-(x-3)}{2} = \frac{3-x}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - y^2}{2x^2 + 3xy + y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2 - xy - y^2}{x^2 - 2xy + y^2} \cdot \frac{x + y}{2x + y}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(2x+y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(2x+y)(x-y)}{(x-y)^2} \cdot \frac{x+y}{2x+y}\). Combining factors in the numerator gives \((x-y)^2(x+y)^2(2x+y)\) and in the denominator gives \((x-y)^2(x+y)(2x+y)^2\), which cancels to \(\frac{x+y}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-7xy+6y^2}{x^2+3xy-4y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+2xy-8y^2}{x^2-xy-30y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each trinomial to obtain \(\frac{(x-y)(x-6y)}{(x-y)(x+4y)} \cdot \frac{(x+4y)(x-2y)}{(x-6y)(x+5y)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-y)\), \((x+4y)\), and \((x-6y)\) simplifies to \(\frac{x-2y}{x+5y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+3xy-10y^2}{x^2+2xy-8y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+3xy-4y^2}{x^2+2xy-3y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(x+5y)(x-2y)}{(x+4y)(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{(x+4y)(x-y)}{(x+3y)(x-y)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2y)\), \((x+4y)\), and \((x-y)\) leaves \(\frac{x+5y}{x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-7xy+12y^2}{x^2+xy-20y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+7xy+10y^2}{x^2-4xy+3y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each trinomial to get \(\frac{(x-4y)(x-3y)}{(x+5y)(x-4y)} \cdot \frac{(x+5y)(x+2y)}{(x-3y)(x-y)}\). After canceling \((x-4y)\), \((x+5y)\), and \((x-3y)\), the product simplifies to \(\frac{x+2y}{x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2-2ab-8b^2}{a^2-3ab-10b^2} \cdot \frac{a^2-4ab-5b^2}{a^2-7ab+12b^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{(a-4b)(a+2b)}{(a-5b)(a+2b)} \cdot \frac{(a-5b)(a+b)}{(a-4b)(a-3b)}\). Canceling the common factors \((a+2b)\), \((a-5b)\), and \((a-4b)\) leaves \(\frac{a+b}{a-3b}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+7xy+6y^2}{x^2+3xy+2y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-xy-6y^2}{x^2+2xy-24y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring each polynomial yields \(\frac{(x+6y)(x+y)}{(x+2y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x-3y)(x+2y)}{(x+6y)(x-4y)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((x+6y)\) leaves \(\frac{x-3y}{x-4y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2+xy-2y^2}{6x^2-5xy-6y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5xy-12y^2}{2x^2-5xy+2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic expression: \(\frac{(2x-y)(3x+2y)}{(2x-3y)(3x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-3y)(x+4y)}{(2x-y)(x-2y)}\). Canceling \((2x-y)\), \((3x+2y)\), and \((2x-3y)\) leaves \(\frac{x+4y}{x-2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4y^2}{x^2+3xy+2y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-y^2}{x^2-5xy+6y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-2xy-3y^2}{x^2+xy-2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring all expressions gives \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(x+2y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(x-2y)(x-3y)} \cdot \frac{(x-3y)(x+y)}{(x+2y)(x-y)}\). Canceling all identical factors leaves \(\frac{x+y}{x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^3+4x^2y-6xy^2}{x^2-y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+4xy+3y^2}{2x^2+6xy}\)
qs.s: Factor out common monomials and factor the quadratics: \(\frac{2x(x+3y)(x-y)}{(x-y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x+3y)(x+y)}{2x(x+3y)}\). Canceling \(2x\), \((x-y)\), \((x+y)\), and \((x+3y)\) leaves \(x+3y\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5xy-3y^2}{3x^2+8xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{3x^2-7xy+2y^2}{4x^2-y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(2x-y)(x+3y)}{(3x-y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(3x-y)(x-2y)}{(2x-y)(2x+y)}\). Canceling \((2x-y)\), \((x+3y)\), and \((3x-y)\) leaves \(\frac{x-2y}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer if possible. Assume all denominators are nonzero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+xy-3y^2}{4x^2-9y^2} \cdot \frac{3y-2x}{x^2-y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each term, noting \(3y-2x = -(2x-3y)\): \(\frac{(2x+3y)(x-y)}{(2x-3y)(2x+3y)} \cdot \frac{-(2x-3y)}{(x-y)(x+y)}\). Canceling \((2x+3y)\), \((x-y)\), and \((2x-3y)\) leaves \(-\frac{1}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-xy-12y^2}{x^2+2xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-y^2}{x^2-16y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring the expressions yields \(\frac{(x-4y)(x+3y)}{(x+3y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(x-4y)(x+4y)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-4y)\), \((x+3y)\), and \((x-y)\) leaves \(\frac{x+y}{x+4y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+xy-6y^2}{x^2-xy-2y^2} \cdot \frac{y^2-x^2}{x^2+4xy+3y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring each polynomial gives \(\frac{(x+3y)(x-2y)}{(x-2y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{-(x-y)(x+y)}{(x+3y)(x+y)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+3y)\), \((x-2y)\), and \((x+y)\) leaves \(-\frac{x-y}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+5xy+6y^2}{x^2-4y^2} \cdot \frac{2y-x}{x^2+6xy+9y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring each expression gives \(\frac{(x+2y)(x+3y)}{(x-2y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{-(x-2y)}{(x+3y)^2}\). Canceling \((x+2y)\), \((x-2y)\), and one factor of \((x+3y)\) leaves \(-\frac{1}{x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4y^2}{x^2+3xy-10y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+7xy+10y^2}{x^2+4xy+4y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring each polynomial yields \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(x-2y)(x+5y)} \cdot \frac{(x+2y)(x+5y)}{(x+2y)^2}\). Canceling all identical factors in the numerator and denominator simplifies the entire product to \(1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2xy-15y^2}{x^2-6xy+5y^2} \cdot \frac{y^2-x^2}{x^2+4xy+3y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring the numerators and denominators gives \(\frac{(x-5y)(x+3y)}{(x-5y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{-(x-y)(x+y)}{(x+3y)(x+y)}\). All binomial factors cancel, leaving \(-1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{4x^2-y^2}{2x^2+7xy+3y^2} \cdot \frac{3x^2+9xy}{4x^2-4xy+y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(2x-y)(2x+y)}{(2x+y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{3x(x+3y)}{(2x-y)^2}\). Canceling \((2x+y)\), \((x+3y)\), and one copy of \((2x-y)\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{3x}{2x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5xy+2y^2}{2x^2-xy-y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-y^2}{2x^2+3xy-2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring the non-monic quadratics and difference of squares gives \(\frac{(2x+y)(x+2y)}{(2x+y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(2x-y)(x+2y)}\). Canceling \((2x+y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((x-y)\) leaves \(\frac{x+y}{2x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3-12xy^2}{x^2+4xy+4y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-2xy-8y^2}{3x^2-12xy}\)
qs.s: Factoring out common monomials and factoring polynomials gives \(\frac{3x(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(x+2y)^2} \cdot \frac{(x-4y)(x+2y)}{3x(x-4y)}\). Canceling \(3x\), \((x-4y)\), and \((x+2y)^2\) leaves \(x-2y\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-7xy+3y^2}{x^2-y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+2xy+y^2}{2x^2-5xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{y-x}{2x-y}\)
qs.s: Factoring all terms gives \(\frac{(2x-y)(x-3y)}{(x-y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x+y)^2}{(2x+y)(x-3y)} \cdot \frac{-(x-y)}{2x-y}\). Canceling \((2x-y)\), \((x-3y)\), \((x-y)\), and one factor of \((x+y)\) leaves \(-\frac{x+y}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-10xy+3y^2}{6x^2-5xy+y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5xy-3y^2}{9y^2-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(3x-y)(x-3y)}{(3x-y)(2x-y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-y)(x+3y)}{-(x-3y)(x+3y)}\). Every factor cancels between the numerator and denominator, leaving \(-1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2-36}{a^2-4a-12} \cdot \frac{a^2+7a+10}{a^2+11a+30}\)
qs.s: Factoring completely gives \(\frac{(a-6)(a+6)}{(a-6)(a+2)} \cdot \frac{(a+2)(a+5)}{(a+5)(a+6)}\). All linear factors cancel out, leaving \(1\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{m^2-1}{m^2-4m+3} \cdot \frac{m^2-9}{m^2+5m+4}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator to get \(\frac{(m-1)(m+1)}{(m-1)(m-3)} \cdot \frac{(m-3)(m+3)}{(m+1)(m+4)}\). Canceling common factors \((m-1)\), \((m-3)\), and \((m+1)\) leaves \(\frac{m+3}{m+4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{y^2+2y-8}{y^2-4} \cdot \frac{y^2-y-6}{y^2+5y+4}\)
qs.s: Factor all quadratics into \(\frac{(y+4)(y-2)}{(y-2)(y+2)} \cdot \frac{(y-3)(y+2)}{(y+4)(y+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((y+4)\), \((y-2)\), and \((y+2)\) yields \(\frac{y-3}{y+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-25}{x^2+8x+15} \cdot \frac{x^2-x-12}{x^2-7x+10}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(x-5)(x+5)}{(x+3)(x+5)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x+3)}{(x-5)(x-2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-5)\), \((x+5)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x-4}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{t^2-49}{t^2-5t-14} \cdot \frac{t^2+6t+8}{t^2+5t-14}\)
qs.s: Factoring each quadratic gives \(\frac{(t-7)(t+7)}{(t-7)(t+2)} \cdot \frac{(t+2)(t+4)}{(t+7)(t-2)}\). Canceling \((t-7)\), \((t+7)\), and \((t+2)\) results in \(\frac{t+4}{t-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-17x+12}{3x^2+2x-8} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5x+2}{2x^2+7x+3}\)
qs.s: Factor each non-monic quadratic: \(\frac{(2x-3)(3x-4)}{(3x-4)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x+1)(x+2)}{(2x+1)(x+3)}\). Canceling the common factors \((3x-4)\), \((x+2)\), and \((2x+1)\) yields \(\frac{2x-3}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+3x-4}{2x^2+2x} \cdot \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+2x-8} \cdot \frac{4x^2-8x}{x^2-2x+1}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{(x+4)(x-1)}{2x(x+1)} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{(x+4)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{4x(x-2)}{(x-1)^2}\). All linear factors cancel out, leaving \(\frac{4x}{2x} = 2\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{x^2+4x+3} \cdot \frac{x^2-1}{4x^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x+1)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-1)\), \((x+3)\), and \((x+1)\) leaves \(\frac{x-1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4y^2}{2x^2+5xy+2y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2-xy-y^2}{x^2-xy-2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each two-variable expression: \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(2x+y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(2x+y)(x-y)}{(x-2y)(x+y)}\). Canceling \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((2x+y)\) leaves \(\frac{x-y}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply. Simplify your answer completely. Assume denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-12x}{x^2-x-12} \cdot \frac{x^2-9}{6x-2x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor out common factors and negatives: \(\frac{3x(x-4)}{(x-4)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{-2x(x-3)}\). Canceling all variable factors leaves \(\frac{3}{-2} = -\frac{3}{2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x-6}{x+2} \cdot \frac{x^2-x-6}{x^2-8x+12}\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomials to write the expression as \(\frac{x-6}{x+2} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{(x-6)(x-2)}\). Dividing out the common factors \((x-6)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{x-3}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x+5}{x+2} \cdot \frac{x^2-7x+12}{x^2+2x-15}\)
qs.s: Factor the quadratics to get \(\frac{x+5}{x+2} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x-3)}{(x+5)(x-3)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x+5)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{x-4}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x+1}{x+6} \cdot \frac{x^2-8x+15}{x^2-4x-5}\)
qs.s: Factor the quadratics to obtain \(\frac{x+1}{x+6} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x-5)}{(x+1)(x-5)}\). After canceling \((x+1)\) and \((x-5)\), the simplified product is \(\frac{x-3}{x+6}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x-2}{x-5} \cdot \frac{x^2-3x-10}{x^2+x-6}\)
qs.s: Factoring the numerators and denominators gives \(\frac{x-2}{x-5} \cdot \frac{(x-5)(x+2)}{(x+3)(x-2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2)\) and \((x-5)\) results in \(\frac{x+2}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x-4}{x+1} \cdot \frac{x^2+7x+10}{x^2-2x-8}\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomials to obtain \(\frac{x-4}{x+1} \cdot \frac{(x+5)(x+2)}{(x-4)(x+2)}\). Canceling \((x-4)\) and \((x+2)\) yields \(\frac{x+5}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-7x+3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{x^2+5x+6}{2x^2+x-1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x-3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{(2x-1)(x+1)}\). Canceling \((2x-1)\), \((x-3)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-10x+3}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{6x^2-x-1}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(3x-1)(x-3)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(3x+1)(2x-1)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), and \((2x-1)\) yields \(\frac{3x-1}{3x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x-6}{x^2-1} \cdot \frac{x^2+2x-3}{9-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor the terms, noting that \(9-x^2 = -(x-3)(x+3)\): \(\frac{2(x-3)}{(x-1)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{(x+3)(x-1)}{-(x-3)(x+3)}\). Canceling \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), and \((x-1)\) leaves \(-\frac{2}{x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4}{x^2+3x} \cdot \frac{x^2-9}{x^2-x-2} \cdot \frac{x^2+x}{x^2-5x+6}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators completely to obtain \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{x(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{x(x+1)}{(x-2)(x-3)}\). Canceling common factors \(x\), \((x-2)\), \((x+3)\), \((x-3)\), and \((x+1)\) leaves \(\frac{x+2}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-y^2}{x^2+3xy+2y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+xy-6y^2}{x^2-3xy+2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor the two-variable polynomials: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(x+y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(x+3y)(x-2y)}{(x-y)(x-2y)}\). Canceling \((x-y)\), \((x+y)\), and \((x-2y)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3y}{x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{3n^2-8n-3}{3n^2+7n+2} \cdot \frac{n^2-4}{n^2-3n}\)
qs.s: Factoring yields \(\frac{(3n+1)(n-3)}{(3n+1)(n+2)} \cdot \frac{(n-2)(n+2)}{n(n-3)}\). Dividing out \((3n+1)\), \((n+2)\), and \((n-3)\) leaves \(\frac{n-2}{n}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2+10x+3}{3x^2+7x+2} \cdot \frac{x^2-4}{x^2-2x}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(3x+1)(x+3)}{(3x+1)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{x(x-2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((3x+1)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x-2)\) leaves \(\frac{x+3}{x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2w^2+7w+6}{w^2-4} \cdot \frac{w^2-2w}{2w^2+w-3}\)
qs.s: Factor each numerator and denominator to obtain \(\frac{(2w+3)(w+2)}{(w-2)(w+2)} \cdot \frac{w(w-2)}{(2w+3)(w-1)}\). Canceling \((2w+3)\), \((w+2)\), and \((w-2)\) yields \(\frac{w}{w-1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2m^2-7m+3}{2m^2-9m+4} \cdot \frac{m^2-16}{m^2+4m}\)
qs.s: Factoring completely gives \(\frac{(2m-1)(m-3)}{(2m-1)(m-4)} \cdot \frac{(m-4)(m+4)}{m(m+4)}\). Canceling common factors \((2m-1)\), \((m-4)\), and \((m+4)\) results in \(\frac{m-3}{m}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-5x-3}{2x^2+7x+3} \cdot \frac{x^2+3x}{x^2-9}\)
qs.s: Factoring gives \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{(2x+1)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+3)}\). Canceling \((2x+1)\), \((x-3)\), and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{x}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-x-12}{12x^2+13x-4} \cdot \frac{16x^2-1}{4x^2-4x-3}\)
qs.s: Factor each non-monic polynomial: \(\frac{(2x-3)(3x+4)}{(4x-1)(3x+4)} \cdot \frac{(4x-1)(4x+1)}{(2x-3)(2x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-3)\), \((3x+4)\), and \((4x-1)\) gives \(\frac{4x+1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{xy-2x+3y-6}{2x^2+7x+3} \cdot \frac{4x^2-4x+1}{2xy-4x-y+2}\)
qs.s: Factor by grouping and trinomial factoring: \(\frac{(x+3)(y-2)}{(2x+1)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)^2}{(2x-1)(y-2)}\). Canceling \((x+3)\), \((y-2)\), and one factor of \((2x-1)\) leaves \(\frac{2x-1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-x-6}{x^2-9} \cdot \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{2x^2+3x-2} \cdot \frac{4x^2-1}{2x^2+5x+2}\)
qs.s: Factoring all six polynomials gives \(\frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{(x-3)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(2x-1)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(2x+1)(x+2)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), \((2x-1)\), \((2x+1)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{2x-1}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3-12x}{4x^2+2x-12} \cdot \frac{6x^2-7x-3}{6x^2-10x-4}\)
qs.s: First factor out the GCF from each polynomial, then factor the remaining quadratics: \(\frac{3x(x-2)(x+2)}{2(2x-3)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x-3)(3x+1)}{2(3x+1)(x-2)}\). Canceling all common binomial factors leaves \(\frac{3x}{2 \cdot 2} = \frac{3x}{4}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2a^2+5ab-3b^2}{a^2-9b^2} \cdot \frac{3b-a}{2a^2-ab}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(2a-b)(a+3b)}{(a-3b)(a+3b)} \cdot \frac{-(a-3b)}{a(2a-b)}\). Canceling \((2a-b)\), \((a+3b)\), and \((a-3b)\) leaves \(\frac{-1}{a} = -\frac{1}{a}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+4xy-21y^2}{x^2-2xy-3y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-5xy-6y^2}{x^2-3xy-18y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x+7y)(x-3y)}{(x-3y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x-6y)(x+y)}{(x-6y)(x+3y)}\). Cancel the common factors \((x-3y)\), \((x+y)\), and \((x-6y)\) to obtain \(\frac{x+7y}{x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2xy-24y^2}{x^2+2xy-8y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-7xy+10y^2}{x^2+2xy-35y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-6y)(x+4y)}{(x+4y)(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{(x-5y)(x-2y)}{(x+7y)(x-5y)}\). Cancel common factors \((x+4y)\), \((x-2y)\), and \((x-5y)\) to arrive at \(\frac{x-6y}{x+7y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+3xy-10y^2}{x^2+xy-6y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-xy-12y^2}{x^2-2xy-8y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x+5y)(x-2y)}{(x+3y)(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{(x-4y)(x+3y)}{(x-4y)(x+2y)}\). Cancel the common factors \((x-2y)\), \((x+3y)\), and \((x-4y)\) to get \(\frac{x+5y}{x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-2xy-8y^2}{x^2+3xy-18y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2+5xy-6y^2}{x^2+xy-2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(x-4y)(x+2y)}{(x+6y)(x-3y)} \cdot \frac{(x+6y)(x-y)}{(x+2y)(x-y)}\). Cancel \((x+2y)\), \((x+6y)\), and \((x-y)\) to get \(\frac{x-4y}{x-3y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+7xy-8y^2}{x^2-6xy+5y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2-2xy-15y^2}{x^2+7xy+12y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(x+8y)(x-y)}{(x-5y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{(x-5y)(x+3y)}{(x+4y)(x+3y)}\). Cancel \((x-y)\), \((x-5y)\), and \((x+3y)\) to obtain \(\frac{x+8y}{x+4y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2 - 7xy - 3y^2}{4x^2 - 9y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2 + 7xy + 6y^2}{3x^2 + 5xy - 2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(3x+y)(2x-3y)}{(2x-3y)(2x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(2x+3y)(x+2y)}{(3x-y)(x+2y)}\). Cancel the common factors \((2x-3y)\), \((2x+3y)\), and \((x+2y)\) to arrive at \(\frac{3x+y}{3x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+7xy-4y^2}{2x^2-xy-6y^2} \cdot \frac{3x^2-5xy-2y^2}{6x^2-xy-y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic: \(\frac{(2x-y)(x+4y)}{(2x+3y)(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{(3x+y)(x-2y)}{(2x-y)(3x+y)}\). Cancel the common factors \((2x-y)\), \((x-2y)\), and \((3x+y)\) to get \(\frac{x+4y}{2x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2y - 8y^3}{3x^2 + 15xy + 18y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2 + 4xy + 3y^2}{4x^2 - 8xy}\)
qs.s: Factor out common monomials and factor the remaining polynomials: \(\frac{2y(x-2y)(x+2y)}{3(x+2y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(x+y)(x+3y)}{4x(x-2y)}\). Cancel common factors \(2\), \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((x+3y)\) to obtain \(\frac{y(x+y)}{6x}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 - 5xy + 2y^2}{x^2 - y^2} \cdot \frac{x^2 + 2xy + y^2}{2x^2 + 3xy - 2y^2} \cdot \frac{3x + 6y}{x - 2y}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators: \(\frac{(2x-y)(x-2y)}{(x-y)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(x+y)^2}{(2x-y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{3(x+2y)}{x-2y}\). Cancel \((2x-y)\), \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((x+y)\) to leave \(\frac{3(x+y)}{x-y}\).

qs.q:
Multiply and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5xy - 3y^2}{3x^2 + 11xy + 6y^2} \cdot \frac{2x^2 - 3xy - 20y^2}{5y^2 - 8xy - 4x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{(2x-y)(x+3y)}{(3x+2y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(2x+5y)(x-4y)}{-(2x-y)(2x+5y)}\). Cancel \((x+3y)\), \((2x+5y)\), and \((2x-y)\) to get \(-\frac{x-4y}{3x+2y} = \frac{4y-x}{3x+2y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4x^3}{15} \div \frac{8x^5}{25}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction to get \(\frac{4x^3}{15} \cdot \frac{25}{8x^5}\), then simplify the numerical coefficients and subtract exponents to get \(\frac{5}{6x^2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{9m^5}{16} \div \frac{15m^2}{28}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{9m^5}{16} \cdot \frac{28}{15m^2}\), then simplify coefficients and subtract the exponents of \(m\) to get \(\frac{21m^3}{20}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{14n^3}{33} \div \frac{21n^9}{22}\)
qs.s: Multiply the first expression by the reciprocal of the second: \(\frac{14n^3}{33} \cdot \frac{22}{21n^9} = \frac{14 \cdot 22 \cdot n^3}{33 \cdot 21 \cdot n^9} = \frac{4}{9n^6}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{6y^4}{35} \div \frac{9y^7}{14}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{6y^4}{35} \cdot \frac{14}{9y^7}\), then divide out common factors to obtain \(\frac{4}{15y^3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{8a^2}{21} \div \frac{12a^7}{35}\)
qs.s: Rewrite as multiplication by the reciprocal, \(\frac{8a^2}{21} \cdot \frac{35}{12a^7}\), and simplify common factors to arrive at \(\frac{10}{9a^5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 25}{6x} \div \frac{2x + 10}{9x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^2 - 25\) as \((x - 5)(x + 5)\) and \(2x + 10\) as \(2(x + 5)\), multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{9x}{2(x + 5)}\), and cancel common factors to find \(\frac{3(x - 5)}{4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{27a^4 b^2}{14c^5} \div \frac{45a^7 b^2}{28c^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{28c^2}{45a^7 b^2}\); the \(b^2\) terms cancel entirely while simplifying the coefficients and other variables yields \(\frac{6}{5a^3 c^3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{6x - 18}{25x^3} \div \frac{9x - 27}{20x^7}\)
qs.s: Factor the numerators to obtain \(\frac{6(x - 3)}{25x^3} \cdot \frac{20x^7}{9(x - 3)}\), cancel the common binomial factor \((x - 3)\), and simplify to get \(\frac{8x^4}{15}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 + 3x - 10}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{x + 5}{x - 2}\)
qs.s: Factor all quadratics to get \(\frac{(x + 5)(x - 2)}{(x - 2)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{x - 2}{x + 5}\), then cancel common factors \((x + 5)\) and \((x - 2)\) to leave \(\frac{x - 2}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{16x^3 y}{25z^4} \div \frac{24x^5 y^4}{35z^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{16x^3 y}{25z^4} \cdot \frac{35z^2}{24x^5 y^4}\), then simplify the numerical coefficients and cancel powers of \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\) to obtain \(\frac{14}{15x^2 y^3 z^2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{24}{5m - 2n} \div \frac{18}{2n - 5m}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{24}{5m - 2n} \cdot \frac{2n - 5m}{18}\). Since \(2n - 5m = -(5m - 2n)\), simplifying gives \(\frac{24}{18} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{14}{2a - 7b} \div \frac{21}{7b - 2a}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{14}{2a - 7b} \cdot \frac{7b - 2a}{21}\). Since \(7b - 2a = -(2a - 7b)\), simplifying gives \(\frac{14}{21} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{18}{5 - 2w} \div \frac{12}{2w - 5}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{18}{5 - 2w} \cdot \frac{2w - 5}{12}\). Since \(2w - 5 = -(5 - 2w)\), simplifying gives \(\frac{18}{12} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{3}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{15}{4x - 1} \div \frac{20}{1 - 4x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{15}{4x - 1} \cdot \frac{1 - 4x}{20}\). Since \(1 - 4x = -(4x - 1)\), simplifying gives \(\frac{15}{20} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{3}{4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{8}{3x - 5y} \div \frac{20}{5y - 3x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{8}{3x - 5y} \cdot \frac{5y - 3x}{20}\). Since \(5y - 3x = -(3x - 5y)\), simplifying gives \(\frac{8}{20} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{2}{5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 - 5x - 3}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{3 - x}{x - 2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x + 1)(x - 3)}{(x - 2)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{x - 2}{-(x - 3)}\). Canceling \((x - 3)\) and \((x - 2)\) results in \(-\frac{2x + 1}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{9x^2 - 4y^2}{5x + 10} \div \frac{2y - 3x}{x^2 - 4}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to obtain \(\frac{(3x - 2y)(3x + 2y)}{5(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{-(3x - 2y)}\). Canceling \((3x - 2y)\) and \((x + 2)\) results in \(-\frac{(3x + 2y)(x - 2)}{5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 4x + 3}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \div \frac{3 - x}{x^2 - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x - 1)(x - 3)}{(x + 2)(x + 3)} \cdot \frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{-(x - 3)}\). Canceling \((x - 3)\) and \((x + 2)\) leaves \(-\frac{(x - 1)(x - 2)}{x + 3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x - 6}{x^2 - 25} \div \frac{9 - 3x}{2x + 10}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to obtain \(\frac{2(x - 3)}{(x - 5)(x + 5)} \cdot \frac{2(x + 5)}{-3(x - 3)}\). Canceling common factors \((x - 3)\) and \((x + 5)\) yields \(-\frac{4}{3(x - 5)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 9}{2x + 10} \div \frac{3 - x}{x^2 + 8x + 15}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{2(x + 5)} \cdot \frac{(x + 3)(x + 5)}{-(x - 3)}\). Canceling \((x - 3)\) and \((x + 5)\) gives \(-\frac{(x + 3)^2}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-6x}{x} \div (5x-15)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the division as multiplication by the reciprocal: \(\frac{2x(x-3)}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{5(x-3)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\) and \(x-3\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{2}{5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-7x}{x} \div (2x-14)\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{x(x-7)}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{2(x-7)}\). Canceling \(x\) and \(x-7\) leaves \(\frac{1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2+12x}{x} \div (x+4)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3x(x+4)}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{x+4}\). Canceling \(x\) and \(x+4\) yields \(3\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+2x}{x} \div (4x+8)\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{x(x+2)}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{4(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \(x\) and \(x+2\) gives \(\frac{1}{4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+5x}{5x} \div (3x+15)\)
qs.s: Rewrite as multiplication by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{x(x+5)}{5x} \cdot \frac{1}{3(x+5)}\). Canceling \(x\) and \(x+5\) leaves \(\frac{1}{5 \cdot 3} = \frac{1}{15}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5x-3}{4x^2-1} \div (x+3)\)
qs.s: Factor the trinomial and difference of squares: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{1}{x+3}\). Canceling \((2x-1)\) and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4}{x^2+x-6} \div \frac{x^2+2x}{x^2-9}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+3)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{x(x+2)}\). Canceling \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x+3)\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{x-3}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-25}{x^2-3x} \div \frac{2x+10}{x^2-9}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor: \(\frac{(x-5)(x+5)}{x(x-3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{2(x+5)}\). Canceling \((x+5)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{(x-5)(x+3)}{2x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-9}{x^2+5x+6} \div (2x-6)\)
qs.s: Factor each expression and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{1}{2(x-3)}\). Canceling \((x-3)\) and \((x+3)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{2(x+2)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-x-6}{3x+6} \div (9-x^2)\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+2)}{3(x+2)} \cdot \frac{1}{-(x-3)(x+3)}\). Canceling \((x+2)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(-\frac{1}{3(x+3)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4x - 12}{x + 5} \div \frac{2x - 6}{3}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{4(x - 3)}{x + 5} \cdot \frac{3}{2(x - 3)}\). Canceling the common factor \((x - 3)\) and reducing \(\frac{12}{2}\) yields \(\frac{6}{x + 5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2b + 8}{b - 3} \div \frac{b + 4}{7}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{2(b + 4)}{b - 3} \cdot \frac{7}{b + 4}\). Canceling \((b + 4)\) leaves \(\frac{14}{b - 3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{7y - 21}{y + 1} \div \frac{2y - 6}{5}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{7(y - 3)}{y + 1} \cdot \frac{5}{2(y - 3)}\). Canceling the common factor \((y - 3)\) leaves \(\frac{35}{2(y + 1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3a + 15}{a - 4} \div \frac{6a + 30}{5}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{3(a + 5)}{a - 4} \cdot \frac{5}{6(a + 5)}\). Canceling \((a + 5)\) and simplifying \(\frac{15}{6}\) gives \(\frac{5}{2(a - 4)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3x - 9}{4} \div \frac{5x - 15}{x + 2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{3(x - 3)}{4} \cdot \frac{x + 2}{5(x - 3)}\). Canceling \((x - 3)\) leaves \(\frac{3(x + 2)}{20}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x - 8}{x^2 - x - 6} \div \frac{4 - x}{x^2 - 9}\)
qs.s: Factoring and noting that \(4 - x = -(x - 4)\) gives \(\frac{2(x - 4)}{(x - 3)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{-(x - 4)}\). Canceling \((x - 4)\) and \((x - 3)\) leaves \(-\frac{2(x + 3)}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{2x - 1}{x - 2}\)
qs.s: Factoring the numerator and denominators gives \(\frac{(2x - 1)(x + 3)}{(x - 2)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{x - 2}{2x - 1}\). Canceling \((2x - 1)\) and \((x - 2)\) results in \(\frac{x + 3}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3x^2 - 10x + 3}{x^2 - 9} \div \frac{3x - 1}{x^2 + 3x}\)
qs.s: Factoring all expressions yields \(\frac{(3x - 1)(x - 3)}{(x - 3)(x + 3)} \cdot \frac{x(x + 3)}{3x - 1}\). Canceling the factors \((3x - 1)\), \((x - 3)\), and \((x + 3)\) leaves \(x\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x^2 + 3x} \div \frac{x^2 - x - 2}{x^2 + 4x + 3}\)
qs.s: Factoring all expressions gives \(\frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x(x + 3)} \cdot \frac{(x + 1)(x + 3)}{(x - 2)(x + 1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x - 2)\), \((x + 3)\), and \((x + 1)\) leaves \(\frac{x + 2}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \div \frac{2x - 6}{x + 2}\)
qs.s: Factoring each term yields \(\frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{(x + 2)(x + 3)} \cdot \frac{x + 2}{2(x - 3)}\). Canceling \((x - 3)\), \((x + 3)\), and \((x + 2)\) simplifies completely to \(\frac{1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{5w+15}{5w-20} \div (w^2+3w)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the expression as \(\frac{5(w+3)}{5(w-4)} \cdot \frac{1}{w(w+3)}\). Canceling the common factors \(5\) and \((w+3)\) results in \(\frac{1}{w(w-4)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2m-6}{4m-8} \div (m^2-3m)\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{2(m-3)}{4(m-2)} \cdot \frac{1}{m(m-3)}\). Canceling \((m-3)\) and simplifying \(\frac{2}{4}\) gives \(\frac{1}{2m(m-2)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{4y-8}{4y+12} \div (y^2-2y)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the division as multiplication by the reciprocal: \(\frac{4(y-2)}{4(y+3)} \cdot \frac{1}{y(y-2)}\). Canceling the common factors \(4\) and \((y-2)\) gives \(\frac{1}{y(y+3)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3t-12}{6t+6} \div (t^2-4t)\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3(t-4)}{6(t+1)} \cdot \frac{1}{t(t-4)}\). Canceling \((t-4)\) and simplifying \(\frac{3}{6}\) to \(\frac{1}{2}\) leaves \(\frac{1}{2t(t+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3x+6}{3x-9} \div (x^2+2x)\)
qs.s: Rewrite the division as multiplication by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3(x+2)}{3(x-3)} \cdot \frac{1}{x(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \(3\) and \((x+2)\) yields \(\frac{1}{x(x-3)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3y^2-10y+3}{9y^2-1} \div (y^2-2y-3)\)
qs.s: Factor and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(3y-1)(y-3)}{(3y-1)(3y+1)} \cdot \frac{1}{(y-3)(y+1)}\). Canceling \((3y-1)\) and \((y-3)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{(3y+1)(y+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-4}{x^2+5x+6} \div \frac{x^2-3x+2}{x^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor all terms and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{(x-1)(x-2)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x-1)\) gives \(\frac{x+1}{x+3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2-5x-3}{x^2-4} \div \frac{2x^2+x}{x^2+2x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{x(x+2)}{x(2x+1)}\). Canceling \(x\), \((2x+1)\), and \((x+2)\) yields \(\frac{x-3}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2-9}{2x^2+7x+3} \div (3-x)\)
qs.s: Factor to obtain \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(2x+1)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{1}{3-x}\). Since \(\frac{x-3}{3-x} = -1\) and \((x+3)\) cancels, the simplified result is \(-\frac{1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2-4b^2}{a^2-ab-6b^2} \div \frac{2a+4b}{a-3b}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(a-2b)(a+2b)}{(a-3b)(a+2b)} \cdot \frac{a-3b}{2(a+2b)}\). Canceling \((a-3b)\) and \((a+2b)\) leaves \(\frac{a-2b}{2(a+2b)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2 - 4a}{12} \div \frac{a - 4}{4a}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor: \(\frac{a(a - 4)}{12} \cdot \frac{4a}{a - 4} = \frac{4a^2}{12} = \frac{a^2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3n^2 + 12n}{8} \div \frac{n + 4}{2n}\)
qs.s: Factor the first numerator and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3n(n + 4)}{8} \cdot \frac{2n}{n + 4} = \frac{6n^2}{8} = \frac{3n^2}{4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{b^2 - 2b}{6} \div \frac{3b - 6}{2b}\)
qs.s: Factor each binomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{b(b - 2)}{6} \cdot \frac{2b}{3(b - 2)} = \frac{2b^2}{18} = \frac{b^2}{9}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 + 5x}{10} \div \frac{x + 5}{2x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{x(x + 5)}{10} \cdot \frac{2x}{x + 5} = \frac{2x^2}{10} = \frac{x^2}{5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 - 4x + 3} \div \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{x - 1}\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials: \(\frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{(x - 1)(x - 3)} \cdot \frac{x - 1}{(x + 2)(x + 3)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x - 3)\), \((x + 3)\), and \((x - 1)\) gives \(\frac{1}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2 - 16}{a^2 - 8a + 16} \div \frac{3a + 12}{a^2 - 4a}\)
qs.s: Factor all parts: \(\frac{(a - 4)(a + 4)}{(a - 4)^2} \cdot \frac{a(a - 4)}{3(a + 4)}\). Canceling \((a - 4)^2\) and \((a + 4)\) leaves \(\frac{a}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 + x - 2}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \div \frac{4 - 4x}{2x + 6}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions, noting \(4 - 4x = -4(x - 1)\): \(\frac{(x + 2)(x - 1)}{(x + 2)(x + 3)} \cdot \frac{2(x + 3)}{-4(x - 1)} = \frac{2}{-4} = -\frac{1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{y^2 - 4y}{y^2 - y - 12} \div \frac{y^2 - 16}{y^2 + 7y + 12}\)
qs.s: Factor and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{y(y - 4)}{(y - 4)(y + 3)} \cdot \frac{(y + 3)(y + 4)}{(y - 4)(y + 4)}\). Canceling \((y - 4)\), \((y + 3)\), and \((y + 4)\) simplifies to \(\frac{y}{y - 4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{(w+4)^2}{6w^2} \div \frac{w+4}{2w}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{(w+4)^2}{6w^2} \cdot \frac{2w}{w+4}\). Canceling \(2w\) and \((w+4)\) simplifies the expression to \(\frac{w+4}{3w}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{4x}{x+3} \div \frac{2x^2}{(x+3)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to get \(\frac{4x}{x+3} \cdot \frac{(x+3)^2}{2x^2}\). Canceling common factors of \(2x\) and \((x+3)\) yields \(\frac{2(x+3)}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{9k}{k-7} \div \frac{3k^3}{(k-7)^2}\)
qs.s: Rewrite as multiplication by the reciprocal: \(\frac{9k}{k-7} \cdot \frac{(k-7)^2}{3k^3}\). Dividing out common factors of \(3k\) and \((k-7)\) results in \(\frac{3(k-7)}{k^2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{12m^2}{m-1} \div \frac{4m}{(m-1)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to obtain \(\frac{12m^2}{m-1} \cdot \frac{(m-1)^2}{4m}\). Simplifying by canceling common factors of \(4m\) and \((m-1)\) gives \(3m(m-1)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5a}{a+1} \div \frac{15a^2}{(a+1)^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the second expression: \(\frac{5a}{a+1} \cdot \frac{(a+1)^2}{15a^2}\). Dividing out common factors of \(5a\) and \((a+1)\) leaves \(\frac{a+1}{3a}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 + 4x + 4} \div \frac{x^2 - 2x - 3}{x^2 - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials to get \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x+2)^2} \cdot \frac{(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-3)(x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-3)\) and \((x+2)\) yields \(\frac{(x+3)(x-2)}{(x+2)(x+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2 - 4b^2}{a^2 - ab - 6b^2} \div \frac{2a^2 + 4ab}{a^2 - 9b^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials: \(\frac{(a-2b)(a+2b)}{(a-3b)(a+2b)} \cdot \frac{(a-3b)(a+3b)}{2a(a+2b)}\). Canceling \((a+2b)\) in the first fraction and \((a-3b)\) across the terms results in \(\frac{(a-2b)(a+3b)}{2a(a+2b)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 - x}{x^2 - 6x + 9} \div \frac{x^2 + 2x + 1}{x^2 - 9}\)
qs.s: Factor completely to get \(\frac{x(x-1)(x+1)}{(x-3)^2} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x+1)^2}\). Canceling one factor of \((x+1)\) and one factor of \((x-3)\) leaves \(\frac{x(x-1)(x+3)}{(x-3)(x+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2 - 12x}{x^2 - 2x - 15} \div \frac{16 - x^2}{x^2 + x - 6}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions: \(\frac{3x(x-4)}{(x-5)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+3)(x-2)}{-(x-4)(x+4)}\). Canceling \((x+3)\) and noting \(\frac{x-4}{-(x-4)} = -1\) gives \(-\frac{3x(x-2)}{(x-5)(x+4)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify the answer if possible. Assume all denominators are non-zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 16} \div \frac{4x^2 - 1}{x^2 - 3x - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to obtain \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-4)(x+4)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x+1)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)}\). Canceling \((2x-1)\) and \((x-4)\) leaves \(\frac{(x+3)(x+1)}{(x+4)(2x+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5x-12}{x^2+2x-8} \div (2x^2-x-3)\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials to get \(\frac{(2x-3)(x+4)}{(x+4)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{1}{(2x-3)(x+1)}\). Cancelling the common factors \((2x-3)\) and \((x+4)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{(x-2)(x+1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5x^2+9x-2}{x^2+9x+14} \div (5x^2-16x+3)\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(5x-1)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+7)} \cdot \frac{1}{(5x-1)(x-3)}\). Cancelling the common factors \((5x-1)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{1}{(x+7)(x-3)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-9x-5}{x^2-9x+20} \div (2x^2+7x+3)\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to obtain \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-5)}{(x-5)(x-4)} \cdot \frac{1}{(2x+1)(x+3)}\). Cancelling \((2x+1)\) and \((x-5)\) results in \(\frac{1}{(x-4)(x+3)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-11x+6}{x^2+3x-18} \div (3x^2-5x+2)\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials to get \(\frac{(3x-2)(x-3)}{(x-3)(x+6)} \cdot \frac{1}{(3x-2)(x-1)}\). Cancelling the common factors \((3x-2)\) and \((x-3)\) yields \(\frac{1}{(x+6)(x-1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-10x-8}{x^2-16} \div (3x^2+17x+10)\)
qs.s: Factor completely to write \(\frac{(3x+2)(x-4)}{(x-4)(x+4)} \cdot \frac{1}{(3x+2)(x+5)}\). Cancelling \((3x+2)\) and \((x-4)\) gives \(\frac{1}{(x+4)(x+5)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2+7x-20}{4x^2-25} \div (16 - 4x - 6x^2)\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions: \(\frac{(3x-4)(2x+5)}{(2x-5)(2x+5)} \cdot \frac{1}{-2(3x-4)(x+2)}\). Cancelling \((2x+5)\) and \((3x-4)\) leaves \(-\frac{1}{2(2x-5)(x+2)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2-10xy+3y^2}{x^2-9y^2} \div \frac{9x^2-y^2}{3x^2+7xy+2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(3x-y)(x-3y)}{(x-3y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{(3x+y)(x+2y)}{(3x-y)(3x+y)}\). Cancelling \((x-3y)\), \((3x-y)\), and \((3x+y)\) yields \(\frac{x+2y}{x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 4y^2}{2x^2 - 5xy + 2y^2} \div \frac{x^2 + 2xy}{2y - 4x}\)
qs.s: Factor all expressions and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(2x-y)(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{-2(2x-y)}{x(x+2y)}\). Cancelling \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \((2x-y)\) simplifies to \(-\frac{2}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 + 2x^2 - 9x - 18}{2x^2 - 5x - 3} \div \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{4x^2 - 1}\)
qs.s: Factor by grouping and trinomial factoring: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)(x+2)}{(2x+1)(x-3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(x+2)(x+3)}\). Cancelling \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), \((x+2)\), and \((2x+1)\) leaves \(2x - 1\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-7x-15}{2x^2-6x-20} \div \frac{2x^2+x-3}{2x^2+3x-2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(2x+3)(x-5)}{2(x-5)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(x+2)}{(2x+3)(x-1)}\). Cancelling common factors \((2x+3)\), \((x-5)\), and \((x+2)\) leaves \(\frac{2x-1}{2(x-1)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6u^2+uv-2v^2}{2ux-vy-vx+2uy} \div (3u+2v)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \((3u+2v)(2u-v)\) and the denominator by grouping as \((x+y)(2u-v)\). Multiplying by the reciprocal \(\frac{1}{3u+2v}\) and canceling \((3u+2v)\) and \((2u-v)\) yields \(\frac{1}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5x^2+13xy-6y^2}{px-3qy+3py-qx} \div (5x-2y)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \((5x-2y)(x+3y)\) and the denominator by grouping as \((p-q)(x+3y)\). Multiply by \(\frac{1}{5x-2y}\) and cancel common factors to simplify to \(\frac{1}{p-q}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{4m^2-11mn+6n^2}{km-2ln-2kn+lm} \div (4m-3n)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator into \((4m-3n)(m-2n)\) and the denominator into \((k+l)(m-2n)\). Multiply by \(\frac{1}{4m-3n}\) and cancel \((4m-3n)\) and \((m-2n)\) to get \(\frac{1}{k+l}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3a^2-7ab+2b^2}{am+2bn-2bm-an} \div (3a-b)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \((3a-b)(a-2b)\) and the denominator by grouping as \((a-2b)(m-n)\). Multiplying by the reciprocal \(\frac{1}{3a-b}\) and canceling common factors leaves \(\frac{1}{m-n}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2+5xy-3y^2}{ax+3by+3ay+bx} \div (2x-y)\)
qs.s: Factor the numerator as \((2x-y)(x+3y)\) and the denominator by grouping as \((a+b)(x+3y)\). Multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{1}{2x-y}\) and cancel the common factors \((2x-y)\) and \((x+3y)\) to obtain \(\frac{1}{a+b}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6a^2-11ab-10b^2}{2am+2an-5bm-5bn} \div \frac{9a^2-4b^2}{3am-3an-2bm+2bn}\)
qs.s: Factor all four polynomials to obtain \(\frac{(3a+2b)(2a-5b)}{(2a-5b)(m+n)} \cdot \frac{(3a-2b)(m-n)}{(3a-2b)(3a+2b)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2a-5b)\), \((3a+2b)\), and \((3a-2b)\) gives \(\frac{m-n}{m+n}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2a^2-ab-3b^2}{ac+ad+bc+bd} \div \frac{3b-2a}{c^2-d^2}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to get \(\frac{(2a-3b)(a+b)}{(a+b)(c+d)} \cdot \frac{(c-d)(c+d)}{-(2a-3b)}\). After canceling common factors, \(\frac{c-d}{-1} = d-c\) remains.

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-7xy-3y^2}{ax-2bx+ay-2by} \div \frac{4x^2-9y^2}{2ax-4bx+3ay-6by}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions into \(\frac{(2x-3y)(3x+y)}{(a-2b)(x+y)} \cdot \frac{(a-2b)(2x+3y)}{(2x-3y)(2x+3y)}\). Canceling \((2x-3y)\), \((a-2b)\), and \((2x+3y)\) leaves \(\frac{3x+y}{x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3+2x^2y-xy^2-2y^3}{2x^2+3xy-2y^2} \div \frac{x^3-xy^2}{4x^2-y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor by grouping and differences of squares: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)(x+2y)}{(2x-y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-y)(2x+y)}{x(x-y)(x+y)}\). Canceling \((x+2y)\), \((2x-y)\), \((x-y)\), and \((x+y)\) leaves \(\frac{2x+y}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^3-8xy^2}{x^2y+3xy-2xy^2-6y^2} \div \frac{4x^2+8xy}{x^2+5x+6}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to rewrite the product as \(\frac{2x(x-2y)(x+2y)}{y(x-2y)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+3)}{4x(x+2y)}\). Canceling \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), \((x+3)\), and simplifying \(\frac{2x}{4x}\) yields \(\frac{x+2}{2y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{w^2-w-12}{w^2-16} \div \frac{w^2+5w+6}{16-w^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(w-4)(w+3)}{(w-4)(w+4)} \cdot \frac{-(w-4)(w+4)}{(w+2)(w+3)}\). Canceling \((w-4)\), \((w+4)\), and \((w+3)\) results in \(-\frac{w-4}{w+2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-7x+10}{x^2-4} \div \frac{x^2-3x-10}{4-x^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-2)(x-5)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{-(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-5)(x+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x-5)\) yields \(-\frac{x-2}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2+3a-10}{a^2-25} \div \frac{a^2-4}{25-a^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(a+5)(a-2)}{(a-5)(a+5)} \cdot \frac{-(a-5)(a+5)}{(a-2)(a+2)}\). Canceling the common factors \((a+5)\), \((a-5)\), and \((a-2)\) leaves \(-\frac{a+5}{a+2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{p^2-4p-21}{9-p^2} \div \frac{p^2-9p+14}{p^2-9}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(p-7)(p+3)}{-(p-3)(p+3)} \cdot \frac{(p-3)(p+3)}{(p-7)(p-2)}\). Canceling \((p-7)\), \((p+3)\), and \((p-3)\) yields \(-\frac{p+3}{p-2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{k^2+8k+15}{k^2-9} \div \frac{k^2-25}{9-k^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(k+3)(k+5)}{(k-3)(k+3)} \cdot \frac{-(k-3)(k+3)}{(k-5)(k+5)}\). Canceling \((k+3)\), \((k-3)\), and \((k+5)\) leaves \(-\frac{k+3}{k-5}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2-5x-3}{4x^2-1} \div \frac{x^2+x-12}{1-4x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x+1)(x-3)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{-(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(x+4)(x-3)}\). Canceling \((2x+1)\), \((2x-1)\), and \((x-3)\) simplifies to \(-\frac{2x+1}{x+4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3-12x^2+9x}{2x^2-8} \div \frac{6x^2-18x}{4-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor out common factors and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3x(x-1)(x-3)}{2(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{-(x-2)(x+2)}{6x(x-3)}\). Canceling common binomials and simplifying \(\frac{3x}{2 \cdot 6x}\) leaves \(-\frac{x-1}{4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4xy+3y^2}{x^2-9y^2} \div \frac{2x^2-xy-y^2}{9y^2-x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-y)(x-3y)}{(x-3y)(x+3y)} \cdot \frac{-(x-3y)(x+3y)}{(2x+y)(x-y)}\). Canceling \((x-y)\), \((x-3y)\), and \((x+3y)\) yields \(-\frac{x-3y}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-7x-3}{9-4x^2} \div \frac{3x^2-5x-2}{2x^2+7x+6}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x-3)(3x+1)}{-(2x-3)(2x+3)} \cdot \frac{(2x+3)(x+2)}{(3x+1)(x-2)}\). Canceling \((2x-3)\), \((2x+3)\), and \((3x+1)\) yields \(-\frac{x+2}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2+2x-3}{xy-2x+3y-6} \div \frac{1-x^2}{2y-4}\)
qs.s: Factor by grouping the denominator and factor the remaining terms, then multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x+3)(x-1)}{(x+3)(y-2)} \cdot \frac{2(y-2)}{-(x-1)(x+1)}\). Canceling \((x+3)\), \((x-1)\), and \((y-2)\) leaves \(-\frac{2}{x+1}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{m^2 - 8m + 16}{8 - 2m} \div \frac{m^4 - 4m^3}{m^7 - 16m^5}\)
qs.s: Rewrite division as multiplication by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(m-4)^2}{-2(m-4)} \cdot \frac{m^5(m-4)(m+4)}{m^3(m-4)}\). Canceling common factors results in \(-\frac{m^2(m-4)(m+4)}{2}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{x^2 - 4x + 4}{10 - 5x} \div \frac{x^3 - 2x^2}{x^5 - 4x^3}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to obtain \(\frac{(x-2)^2}{-5(x-2)} \cdot \frac{x^3(x-2)(x+2)}{x^2(x-2)}\). Canceling common factors of \((x-2)\) and \(x^2\) leaves \(-\frac{x(x-2)(x+2)}{5}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{t^2 - 2t + 1}{4 - 4t} \div \frac{t^3 - t^2}{t^5 - t^3}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor to obtain \(\frac{(t-1)^2}{-4(t-1)} \cdot \frac{t^3(t-1)(t+1)}{t^2(t-1)}\). Simplifying common factors leaves \(-\frac{t(t-1)(t+1)}{4}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{p^2 - 12p + 36}{18 - 3p} \div \frac{p^4 - 6p^3}{p^6 - 36p^4}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(p-6)^2}{-3(p-6)} \cdot \frac{p^4(p-6)(p+6)}{p^3(p-6)}\). Canceling common factors of \((p-6)\) and \(p^3\) results in \(-\frac{p(p-6)(p+6)}{3}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{y^2 - 10y + 25}{15 - 3y} \div \frac{y^3 - 5y^2}{y^6 - 25y^4}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(y-5)^2}{-3(y-5)} \cdot \frac{y^4(y-5)(y+5)}{y^2(y-5)}\). Factoring and canceling common factors gives \(-\frac{y^2(y-5)(y+5)}{3}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{6 - 2x} \div \frac{4x^2 - 1}{x^2 - 9}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{-2(x-3)} \cdot \frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)}\). Canceling the common factors \((2x-1)\) and \((x-3)\) yields \(-\frac{(x+3)^2}{2(2x+1)}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{x^2 - 3xy + 2y^2}{4y - 2x} \div \frac{x^2 - xy - 2y^2}{x^3y - 4xy^3}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(x-y)(x-2y)}{-2(x-2y)} \cdot \frac{xy(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(x-2y)(x+y)}\). Canceling factors of \((x-2y)\) simplifies the expression to \(-\frac{xy(x-y)(x+2y)}{2(x+y)}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{x^4 - 81}{3x^2 + 27} \div \frac{x^2 + 2x - 15}{15 - 5x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(x^4-81\) as \((x^2+9)(x-3)(x+3)\) and \(15-5x\) as \(-5(x-3)\), then multiply by the reciprocal. Canceling \((x^2+9)\) and \((x-3)\) leaves \(-\frac{5(x-3)(x+3)}{3(x+5)}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{6x^2 - 7x - 3}{6 - 4x} \div \frac{9x^2 - 1}{3x^2 + 8x - 3}\)
qs.s: Factor all polynomials to get \(\frac{(3x+1)(2x-3)}{-2(2x-3)} \cdot \frac{(3x-1)(x+3)}{(3x-1)(3x+1)}\). Canceling \((2x-3)\), \((3x-1)\), and \((3x+1)\) leaves \(-\frac{x+3}{2}\).

qs.q: Divide and simplify: \(\frac{x^3 - x^2 - 4x + 4}{6 - 3x} \div \frac{x^2 - 3x + 2}{x^4 - 4x^2}\)
qs.s: Factor the four-term numerator by grouping as \((x^2-4)(x-1)=(x-2)(x+2)(x-1)\), then multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor. Canceling \((x-1)\) and both \((x-2)\) factors leaves \(-\frac{x^2(x+2)^2}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 16}{x - x^3} \div \frac{16 - x^2}{x^3 - x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{x^2 - 16}{x - x^3} \cdot \frac{x^3 - x}{16 - x^2}\). Since \(16 - x^2 = -(x^2 - 16)\) and \(x^3 - x = -(x - x^3)\), the expression simplifies to \(\frac{-(x^2 - 16)(x - x^3)}{-(x - x^3)(x^2 - 16)} = 1\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3 - 12x}{x - x^4} \div \frac{x^3 - 4x}{x^4 - x}\)
qs.s: Factor \(3\) out of the first numerator and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{3(x^3 - 4x)}{x - x^4} \cdot \frac{x^4 - x}{x^3 - 4x}\). Cancelling \((x^3 - 4x)\) gives \(3 \cdot \frac{x^4 - x}{x - x^4} = 3(-1) = -3\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 - 25x}{x - x^3} \div \frac{x^3 - 25x}{x^3 - x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{x^3 - 25x}{x - x^3} \cdot \frac{x^3 - x}{x^3 - 25x}\). The factor \((x^3 - 25x)\) cancels out, leaving \(\frac{x^3 - x}{x - x^3} = \frac{-(x - x^3)}{x - x^3} = -1\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 - 4x}{2x - 2x^3} \div \frac{4x - x^3}{x^3 - x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{x^3 - 4x}{2(x - x^3)} \cdot \frac{x^3 - x}{4x - x^3}\). Substitute \(4x - x^3 = -(x^3 - 4x)\) and \(x^3 - x = -(x - x^3)\) to obtain \(\frac{x^3 - 4x}{2(x - x^3)} \cdot \frac{-(x - x^3)}{-(x^3 - 4x)} = \frac{1}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^4 - 9x^2}{x - x^3} \div \frac{9x - x^3}{x^3 - x}\)
qs.s: Factor each term and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{x^2(x^2 - 9)}{-x(x^2 - 1)} \cdot \frac{x(x^2 - 1)}{-x(x^2 - 9)}\). Cancelling \((x^2 - 9)\) and \((x^2 - 1)\) gives \(\frac{x^3}{x^2} = x\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 - 7x + 3}{4x^2 - 1} \div \frac{3 - x}{2x^2 + x}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x - 1)(x - 3)}{(2x - 1)(2x + 1)} \cdot \frac{x(2x + 1)}{-(x - 3)}\). Cancelling \((2x - 1)\), \((2x + 1)\), and \((x - 3)\) leaves \(\frac{x}{-1} = -x\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 - 8x^2 + 16x}{2x^2 - 8x} \div \frac{16 - x^2}{x^2 + 4x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{x(x - 4)^2}{2x(x - 4)} \cdot \frac{x(x + 4)}{-(x - 4)(x + 4)}\). Cancelling common factors \((x - 4)^2\), \((x + 4)\), and \(x\) yields \(-\frac{x}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3 - 2x^2 - x + 2}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{x^2 - 1}{x^2 + 5x + 6}\)
qs.s: Factor the first numerator by grouping as \((x^2 - 1)(x - 2)\) and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x^2 - 1)(x - 2)}{(x - 2)(x + 2)} \cdot \frac{(x + 2)(x + 3)}{x^2 - 1}\). Cancelling \((x^2 - 1)\), \((x - 2)\), and \((x + 2)\) leaves \(x + 3\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2 - 7xy + 2y^2}{x^2 - 4y^2} \div \frac{y - 3x}{2xy + 4y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(3x - y)(x - 2y)}{(x - 2y)(x + 2y)} \cdot \frac{2y(x + 2y)}{-(3x - y)}\). Cancelling \((3x - y)\), \((x - 2y)\), and \((x + 2y)\) leaves \(\frac{2y}{-1} = -2y\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2 - 7x - 3}{9 - 4x^2} \div \frac{9x^2 + 6x + 1}{6x^2 + 11x + 3}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x - 3)(3x + 1)}{-(2x - 3)(2x + 3)} \cdot \frac{(2x + 3)(3x + 1)}{(3x + 1)^2}\). Cancelling all matching binomial factors leaves \(\frac{1}{-1} = -1\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{a^2-b^2}{4a+4b} \div \frac{3b-3a}{12a^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(a-b)(a+b)}{4(a+b)} \cdot \frac{12a^2}{-3(a-b)} = \frac{12a^2}{-12} = -a^2\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2y-2x}{x+y} \div \frac{6x^2-6y^2}{x^2+xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{-2(x-y)}{x+y} \cdot \frac{x(x+y)}{6(x-y)(x+y)} = -\frac{2x}{6(x+y)} = -\frac{x}{3(x+y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{3y-3x}{10x^2y} \div \frac{x^2-y^2}{5xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{-3(x-y)}{10x^2y} \cdot \frac{5xy}{(x-y)(x+y)} = \frac{-15xy}{10x^2y(x+y)} = -\frac{3}{2x(x+y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{5n-5m}{15m^2n} \div \frac{m^2-n^2}{3m+3n}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{-5(m-n)}{15m^2n} \cdot \frac{3(m+n)}{(m-n)(m+n)} = \frac{-15}{15m^2n} = -\frac{1}{m^2n}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{6y-6x}{9y^4} \div \frac{x^2-y^2}{3x+3y}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{-6(x-y)}{9y^4} \cdot \frac{3(x+y)}{(x-y)(x+y)} = \frac{-18}{9y^4} = -\frac{2}{y^4}\).

qs.q:
Perform the operations and simplify. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{2x - 4} \cdot \frac{x + 2}{x - 3}\)
qs.s: Convert the division to multiplication by the reciprocal and factor all expressions: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{2(x-2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x+2}{x-3} = \frac{2}{x+2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^3 - 2x^2 - 9x + 18}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{x^2 - 2x - 3}{x^2 + 3x + 2}\)
qs.s: Factor the cubic by grouping as \((x-2)(x^2-9) = (x-2)(x-3)(x+3)\) and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-2)(x-3)(x+3)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)(x+1)}{(x-3)(x+1)} = x+3\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{2x^2 + x - 3}{x^2 - 16} \div \frac{2x^2 + 5x + 3}{x^2 - 3x - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor each quadratic expression and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x+3)(x-1)}{(x-4)(x+4)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)(x+1)}{(2x+3)(x+1)} = \frac{x-1}{x+4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{6x^2 - 7x - 3}{4 - 9x^2} \div \frac{4x^2 - 8x + 3}{6x^2 + x - 2}\)

Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\frac{x^2 - 4y^2}{2x^2 + 5xy + 2y^2} \div \frac{2x^2 - 3xy - 2y^2}{4x^2 - y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each two-variable polynomial and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{(2x+y)(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{(2x-y)(2x+y)}{(2x+y)(x-2y)} = \frac{2x-y}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2-9b^2}{4a^2+12ab} \div \frac{2a^2-5ab-3b^2}{4a^2-8a}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(a-3b)(a+3b)}{4a(a+3b)} \cdot \frac{4a(a-2)}{(2a+b)(a-3b)}\). Canceling \((a-3b)\), \((a+3b)\), and \(4a\) yields \(\frac{a-2}{2a+b}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{4x^2-y^2}{2x^2+xy} \div \frac{2x^2+5xy-3y^2}{x^2-5x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(2x-y)(2x+y)}{x(2x+y)} \cdot \frac{x(x-5)}{(2x-y)(x+3y)}\). Canceling \((2x-y)\), \((2x+y)\), and \(x\) gives \(\frac{x-5}{x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{m^2-16n^2}{2m^2+8mn} \div \frac{3m^2-11mn-4n^2}{2m^2-6m}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(m-4n)(m+4n)}{2m(m+4n)} \cdot \frac{2m(m-3)}{(3m+n)(m-4n)}\). Canceling \((m-4n)\), \((m+4n)\), and \(2m\) leaves \(\frac{m-3}{3m+n}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-4y^2}{2x^2+4xy} \div \frac{2x^2-3xy-2y^2}{2x^2+8x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-2y)(x+2y)}{2x(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{2x(x+4)}{(2x+y)(x-2y)}\). Canceling the common factors \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), and \(2x\) leaves \(\frac{x+4}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-y^2}{5x^2-5xy} \div \frac{2x^2+3xy+y^2}{5x^2+15x}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{5x(x-y)} \cdot \frac{5x(x+3)}{(2x+y)(x+y)}\). Canceling \((x-y)\), \((x+y)\), and \(5x\) gives \(\frac{x+3}{2x+y}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^3-2x^2-9x+18}{2x^2-3x-2} \div \frac{x^2-9}{4x^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor the cubic numerator by grouping to get \((x^2-9)(x-2) = (x-3)(x+3)(x-2)\), then multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)(x-2)}{(2x+1)(x-2)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(x-3)(x+3)}\). Canceling \((x-2)\), \((2x+1)\), and \((x-3)(x+3)\) leaves \(2x-1\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^3-8xy^2}{3x^2+3xy-6y^2} \div \frac{2x^2-xy-6y^2}{6y-6x}\)
qs.s: Factor each expression: \(\frac{2x(x-2y)(x+2y)}{3(x+2y)(x-y)} \cdot \frac{-6(x-y)}{(2x+3y)(x-2y)}\). Canceling common factors \((x-2y)\), \((x+2y)\), \((x-y)\) and simplifying \(\frac{2x(-6)}{3}\) leaves \(-\frac{4x}{2x+3y}\).

qs.q:
Perform the operations and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-9}{2x^2-x-1} \div \frac{x^2-2x-3}{2x^2-x} \cdot \frac{x^2-1}{x^2+3x}\)
qs.s: Rewrite the division as multiplication by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-3)(x+3)}{(2x+1)(x-1)} \cdot \frac{x(2x-1)}{(x-3)(x+1)} \cdot \frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{x(x+3)}\). Canceling \((x-3)\), \((x+3)\), \((x-1)\), \((x+1)\), and \(x\) leaves \(\frac{2x-1}{2x+1}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{6x^2-7xy-3y^2}{4x^3+8x^2y} \div \frac{6x^2-11xy+3y^2}{2x^2+4xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(3x+y)(2x-3y)}{4x^2(x+2y)} \cdot \frac{2x(x+2y)}{(2x-3y)(3x-y)}\). Canceling \((2x-3y)\), \((x+2y)\), and simplifying \(\frac{2x}{4x^2}\) to \(\frac{1}{2x}\) yields \(\frac{3x+y}{2x(3x-y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide and simplify. Assume all denominators are non-zero.
\(\displaystyle \frac{ax+2bx-3a-6b}{2x^2-5x-3} \div \frac{a^2-4b^2}{4x^2-1}\)
qs.s: Factor the four-term numerator by grouping as \((x-3)(a+2b)\) and multiply by the reciprocal of the second expression: \(\frac{(x-3)(a+2b)}{(2x+1)(x-3)} \cdot \frac{(2x-1)(2x+1)}{(a-2b)(a+2b)}\). Canceling \((x-3)\), \((a+2b)\), and \((2x+1)\) gives \(\frac{2x-1}{a-2b}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x - 2y}{4x^2 + 4xy + y^2} \div \frac{3}{2x + y}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator as \((2x + y)^2\), then multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{2x + y}{3}\) and cancel \((2x + y)\) to yield \(\frac{x - 2y}{3(2x + y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x + 7}{x^2 - 10x + 25} \div \frac{6}{x - 5}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator as \((x - 5)^2\), then multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{x - 5}{6}\) and simplify to \(\frac{2x + 7}{6(x - 5)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{5x + 1}{x^2 + 8x + 16} \div \frac{4}{x + 4}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator as \((x + 4)^2\), then multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{x + 4}{4}\) and cancel the common factor \((x + 4)\) to get \(\frac{5x + 1}{4(x + 4)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x - 5y}{x^2 - 6xy + 9y^2} \div \frac{3}{x - 3y}\)
qs.s: Factor the denominator \(x^2 - 6xy + 9y^2 = (x - 3y)^2\), then multiply by the reciprocal of the second expression: \(\frac{2x - 5y}{(x - 3y)^2} \cdot \frac{x - 3y}{3} = \frac{2x - 5y}{3(x - 3y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{4x + 3y}{x^2 - 4y^2} \div \frac{5}{x - 2y}\)
qs.s: Factor the difference of squares \(x^2 - 4y^2 = (x - 2y)(x + 2y)\), then multiply by the reciprocal \(\frac{x - 2y}{5}\) and cancel \((x - 2y)\) to obtain \(\frac{4x + 3y}{5(x + 2y)}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{4x^2 - 1} \div \frac{x^2 + 5x + 6}{2x^2 + 7x + 3}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial to get \(\frac{(2x - 1)(x + 3)}{(2x - 1)(2x + 1)} \cdot \frac{(2x + 1)(x + 3)}{(x + 2)(x + 3)}\), then cancel all common factors to arrive at \(\frac{x + 3}{x + 2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 4xy + 3y^2}{x^2 - y^2} \div \frac{x^2 - 2xy - 3y^2}{x^2 + 3xy + 2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all numerators and denominators to get \(\frac{(x - 3y)(x - y)}{(x - y)(x + y)} \cdot \frac{(x + y)(x + 2y)}{(x - 3y)(x + y)}\), then cancel common factors \((x - y)\), \((x - 3y)\), and \((x + y)\) to obtain \(\frac{x + 2y}{x + y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - x - 6}{x^2 + 4x} \div \frac{9 - x^2}{x^2 + 7x + 12}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial, noting that \(9 - x^2 = -(x - 3)(x + 3)\), to rewrite the quotient as \(\frac{(x - 3)(x + 2)}{x(x + 4)} \cdot \frac{(x + 3)(x + 4)}{-(x - 3)(x + 3)}\); canceling common factors yields \(-\frac{x + 2}{x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^2 - 12x}{x^2 - 6x + 8} \div \frac{9x^2}{x^2 - 4}\)
qs.s: Factor the expressions to get \(\frac{3x(x - 4)}{(x - 4)(x - 2)} \cdot \frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{9x^2}\), then divide out the common factors \((x - 4)\), \((x - 2)\), and \(3x\) to obtain \(\frac{x + 2}{3x}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 - xy - y^2}{x^2 - y^2} \div \frac{4x^2 - y^2}{2x^2 + 3xy + y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor all expressions to obtain \(\frac{(2x + y)(x - y)}{(x - y)(x + y)} \cdot \frac{(2x + y)(x + y)}{(2x - y)(2x + y)}\), then cancel common factors \((x - y)\), \((2x + y)\), and \((x + y)\) to find \(\frac{2x + y}{2x - y}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{a^2-25}{2b} \div \frac{5-a}{6ab}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(a-5)(a+5)}{2b} \cdot \frac{6ab}{-(a-5)}\). Cancelling \((a-5)\) and reducing \(\frac{6ab}{2b} = 3a\) gives \(-3a(a+5)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-1}{6y} \div \frac{1-x}{2xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-1)(x+1)}{6y} \cdot \frac{2xy}{-(x-1)}\). Cancelling \((x-1)\) and simplifying \(\frac{2xy}{6y} = \frac{x}{3}\) results in \(-\frac{x(x+1)}{3}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2-9}{3y} \div \frac{3-x}{12xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{x^2-9}{3y} \cdot \frac{12xy}{3-x}\). Factoring \(x^2-9 = (x-3)(x+3)\) and rewriting \(3-x = -(x-3)\) allows the common factors to cancel, leaving \(-4x(x+3)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{m^2-49}{5n} \div \frac{7-m}{15mn^2}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(m-7)(m+7)}{5n} \cdot \frac{15mn^2}{-(m-7)}\). Cancelling \((m-7)\) and reducing \(\frac{15mn^2}{5n} = 3mn\) gives \(-3mn(m+7)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{y^2-16}{4x} \div \frac{4-y}{8xy}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal to get \(\frac{(y-4)(y+4)}{4x} \cdot \frac{8xy}{-(y-4)}\). Cancelling \((y-4)\) and simplifying \(\frac{8xy}{4x} = 2y\) yields \(-2y(y+4)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{3x^3 - 12x}{x^2 + 5x + 6} \div \frac{6 - 3x}{x^2 + 3x}\)
qs.s: Factor completely: \(\frac{3x(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+2)(x+3)} \cdot \frac{x(x+3)}{-3(x-2)}\). Cancelling common factors \(3\), \((x-2)\), \((x+2)\), and \((x+3)\) simplifies the expression to \(-x^2\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 + 5x - 3}{x^2 - 16} \div \frac{1 - 2x}{x^2 - 8x + 16}\)
qs.s: Multiply by the reciprocal and factor: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x+3)}{(x-4)(x+4)} \cdot \frac{(x-4)^2}{-(2x-1)}\). Cancelling \((2x-1)\) and \((x-4)\) yields \(-\frac{(x+3)(x-4)}{x+4}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{2x^2 - 7x + 3}{4x^2 - 1} \div \frac{3 - x}{2x^2 + 3x + 1}\)
qs.s: Factor all parts and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(2x-1)(x-3)}{(2x-1)(2x+1)} \cdot \frac{(2x+1)(x+1)}{-(x-3)}\). Cancelling \((2x-1)\), \((2x+1)\), and \((x-3)\) leaves \(-(x+1)\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + 2xy + y^2} \div \frac{2y - 2x}{x^2 - xy - 2y^2}\)
qs.s: Factor each polynomial: \(\frac{(x-y)(x+y)}{(x+y)^2} \cdot \frac{(x-2y)(x+y)}{-2(x-y)}\). Cancelling \((x-y)\) and \((x+y)^2\) leaves \(-\frac{x-2y}{2}\).

qs.q:
Divide. Simplify answers if possible. Assume the denominators do not equal zero.

\(\displaystyle \frac{x^2 - 3x - 10}{x^2 - 4} \div \frac{5 - x}{x^2 + 4x + 4}\)
qs.s: Factor all quadratics and multiply by the reciprocal: \(\frac{(x-5)(x+2)}{(x-2)(x+2)} \cdot \frac{(x+2)^2}{-(x-5)}\). Cancelling \((x-5)\) and \((x+2)\) leaves \(-\frac{(x+2)^2}{x-2}\).

qs.q:
